fdroid:com.leadaxe.lxbox.name: L×Box: VPN & Proxy Client
fdroid:com.leadaxe.lxbox.summary: VPN client: 12+ protocols, subscriptions, app routing, balancing, traffic stats
fdroid:com.leadaxe.lxbox.description:
L×Box is a high-performance proxy client with no compromises.
You choose the servers. You set the rules. You control the traffic. L×Box does exactly what you told it to.
12+ protocols, your Tailscale network, advanced routing, full DNS control, detour chains, per-app split tunneling and built-in diagnostics.
THE CORE IS OURS
L×Box runs on sing-box-lx, our own fork of sing-box, developed together with the app. On top of stock sing-box the core adds:
• AmneziaWG 3.1 — obfuscated WireGuard;
• XHTTP — Xray transport, including stream-one;
• VLESS + ML-KEM-768 — post-quantum protection;
• MASQUE — Cloudflare WARP as a full node and a chain link.
And it is tuned for real life on a phone:
• DNS groups — several resolvers with failover;
• smart urltest — pools, sticky selection, lazy health checks;
• load balancing — connections spread across the pool;
• self-healing of stuck connections;
• idle tunnel sleep — less memory, less battery;
• observability — DNS, connections and chains visible from the app.
12+ PROTOCOLS
VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC v5, NaiveProxy, AnyTLS, SSH, SOCKS, WireGuard, Tailscale, AmneziaWG 3.1, MASQUE over QUIC/HTTP-3.
Cloudflare WARP in one tap: simple registration right in the app, the private key is generated on your device and never leaves it — Cloudflare receives only the public half. WireGuard or MASQUE.
Import any familiar format: subscriptions and links, Base64, Xray arrays, WireGuard URI/INI, Amnezia vpn://, sing-box JSON configs, local files, plain text.
TAILSCALE WITHOUT A SECOND APP
Android runs one VPN at a time, so a Tailscale app and a proxy client cannot run together. In L×Box the Tailscale node runs inside the core: the phone joins your tailnet, and the rest of the traffic follows your rules.
• devices answer by name through MagicDNS;
• exit to the internet through an exit node of your tailnet;
• sign-in, device list and ping with the path in the app;
• your own control server is supported.
SUBSCRIPTIONS WITHOUT MANUAL WORK
Add a subscription — L×Box parses it and creates nodes with no duplicates. Unwanted nodes can be switched off and stay off through every update, even if the provider renames them.
Processing rules with regex and capture groups rename, rewrite or disable nodes on every refresh — and show in advance which nodes a rule will hit.
ROUTING YOU ACTUALLY CONTROL
One device can host several environments at once: work, home, travel. Each with its own rules and its own route.
Conditions: domain, IP and CIDR, port, protocol, app, network type.
DNS UNDER YOUR CONTROL
Several resolvers at once. A separate DNS per rule. FakeIP.
FULL DIAGNOSTICS ON BOARD
Ping and speed-test a node, a folder or the whole subscription — with the tunnel up or down. One-way connections get flagged. Full log right in the app. In real time the built-in tools show: which app opened a connection, where to, how much it transferred, which DNS it used, which route it took. Speed and traffic per app and per connection.
AUTOMATION
Works with automation tools (such as Tasker or MacroDroid): start, stop, switch node, query state. Your phone reshapes the setup to your scenarios — at home, on the road, when Wi-Fi changes.
WE SEND YOUR DATA NOWHERE
No account. No ads, no analytics, no advertising ID, no crash reporters. L×Box connects only to the servers and update endpoints you configured. Full backup and restore moves your setup to a new device.
A CLIENT, NOT A VPN SERVICE
L×Box provides no servers and sells no access to anyone's network — you choose your servers and subscriptions.
L×Box is a professional tool for network security, routing and network health checks. Use is allowed only in strict compliance with the laws of the country where the tool is used. Full responsibility for compliance lies with the user.
OPEN SOURCE
Free software under GPLv3. English and Russian UI, light and dark themes.
GitHub: github.com/Leadaxe/LxBox

fdroid:com.nyxkn.meditation.name: Meditation
fdroid:com.nyxkn.meditation.description:
This is a meditation timer. Minimalistic, reliable, and truly elegant.
 Features 
* Simple, elegant, and intuitive
* No distractions - only the essential features
* Beautiful assortment of bell and gong sounds
* Custom volume adjustment of the bell sounds
* Reliable countdown timer
* Pre-meditation delay
* Intermediate meditation intervals
* Free and open-source software
 Description 
 Meditation is a truly minimalistic countdown timer for meditation, with a clean user interface and no clutter. The minimalism of the app embodies meditation's actual purpose.
A notable feature of the app is the ability to customize the volume of the notification bells independently of system volume. This allows you to set a predefined volume so that the sounds will reliably play at the same loudness every time. No more mid-meditation worrying that you remembered to turn the volume up!
Another important feature is for the timer to be as reliable as possible, to ensure an accurate meditation time and prompt ending sound notification.
This is achieved by starting a foreground service and disabling battery optimization.
Reliability is of extreme importance to a meditation tool in order to eliminate all possible worries about the timer not behaving correctly. Just press the button and start!

fdroid:de.huppke.questlog.name: Quest Log
fdroid:de.huppke.questlog.summary: Balance life's Main and Side Quests in a private, offline game-themed to-do app
fdroid:de.huppke.questlog.description:
I built Quest Log to help myself, and maybe you, keep a balance between the two kinds of things a life is made of: the important ones it demands of us (Main Quests), and the beautiful ones that make it worth living (Side Quests). The app keeps both in view and helps you pick a few to focus on each day.
Every quest can hold objectives, a trail of progress, and a dated journal of what you did, so finishing one feels like finishing a quest rather than ticking a box. Sort quests into your own categories, mark the recurring ones as habits, and build each day from them.
It's yours to shape: switch between game-inspired themes, adjust the look, and tune a wide range of settings until the app feels right for you. The playful design is there to bring a little joy to getting things done.
It's private by default: no accounts, no network, no telemetry, and it works fully offline. Every quest is a plain Markdown file you can export, back up, and re-import as a ZIP, so your data is always yours.
Quest Log is young and changing fast, and your feedback shapes it.

flathub:de.nagstamon.nagstamon.summary: The status monitor for the desktop
flathub:de.nagstamon.nagstamon.description:
Nagstamon is a status monitor for the desktop. It connects to multiple Nagios, Icinga, Opsview,
 Centreon, Op5 Monitor/Ninja, Check_MK Multisite and Thruk monitoring servers. It resides in systray,
 as a floating statusbar or fullscreen at the desktop showing a brief summary of critical, warning,
 unknown, unreachable and down hosts and services. It pops up a detailed status overview when being
 touched by the mouse pointer. Connections to displayed hosts and services are easily established
 by context menu via SSH, RDP, VNC or any self defined actions. Users can be notified by sound.
 Hosts and services can be filtered by category and regular expressions.

 it's your hidden superhero for online adventures, powered by TOR. Carburetor provides a local TOR
 proxy that hides your IP, ensuring your Internet activities remain encrypted, anonymized, and untraceable.
 Don't get your hands dirty with system files anymore – just tap into the app, keeping your online
 world safe and private. Customize settings if you want, but you don't have to. Carburetor is Free
 Software and puts you in control. No worries, just enjoy your anonymous browsing!

flathub:io.github.fabiangreffrath.Doom.name: Crispy Doom
flathub:io.github.fabiangreffrath.Doom.description:
Crispy Doom is a conservative, historically-accurate Doom source port, which is compatible with
 the thousands of mods and levels that were made before the Doom source code was released. Unlike
 other source ports, the goal is to preserve the original look, feel, limitations, and bugs of the
 original DOS executable.
 Full support for single- and multi-player games is provided, for all of the original Doom games,
 Chex Quest, and Hacx. Unlike the original executable, network play is implemented on the IP network
 stack, allowing it to function on modern LANs and the Internet.
 The easiest way to run Crispy Doom is to copy a supported game file (known as a "WAD") to the
 root of your home directory and launch the application. If you have trouble with the automatic
 game file detection or need to manage multiple WAD files, you can run the application from the
 command line with a path to the selected game file:
 flatpak run io.github.fabiangreffrath.Doom -iwad ~/PATH/TO/GAME.WAD

Gramps is a genealogy program that is both intuitive for hobbyists and feature-complete for professional genealogists.
 It gives you the ability to record the many details of the life of an individual as well as the complex relationships between various people, places and events.

flathub:org.luanti.luanti.name: Luanti

Luanti is a block-based sandbox game platform.
 Players can create and destroy various types of blocks in a three-dimensional open world. This
 allows forming structures in every possible creation, on multiplayer servers or in singleplayer.
 Luanti is designed to be simple, stable, and portable. It is lightweight enough to run on fairly
 old hardware.
 Luanti has many features, including:
 Ability to walk around, dig, and build in a near-infinite voxel world
 Crafting of items from raw materials
 A simple modding API that supports many additions and modifications to the game
 Multiplayer support via servers hosted by users
 Beautiful lightning-fast map generator

fedora-packages:cdparanoia/cdparanoia.name: cdparanoia
fedora-packages:cdparanoia/cdparanoia.summary: Compact Disc Digital Audio (CDDA) extraction tool (or ripper)
fedora-packages:cdparanoia/cdparanoia.description: Cdparanoia (Paranoia III) reads digital audio directly from a CD, then writes the data to a file or pipe in WAV, AIFC or raw 16 bit linear PCM format. Cdparanoia doesn't contain any extra features (like the ones included in the cdda2wav sampling utility). Instead, cdparanoia's strength lies in its ability to handle a variety of hardware, including inexpensive drives prone to misalignment, frame jitter and loss of streaming during atomic reads. Cdparanoia is also good at reading and repairing data from damaged CDs.

fedora-packages:chunkfs/chunkfs.name: chunkfs
fedora-packages:chunkfs/chunkfs.summary: FUSE based filesystem that allows you to mount an arbitrary file or block device
fedora-packages:chunkfs/chunkfs.description: ChunkFS is a FUSE based filesystem that allows you to mount an arbitrary file or block device as a directory tree of files that each represent a chunk of user-specified size of the mounted file. The chunk size is global per mount, but at mount time any value can be specified. (If the file size isn't a multiple of the specified chunk size, the last file in the tree simply will be smaller than the chunk size.) Only read access is supported at the moment. UnChunkFS is the inversion of ChunkFS—it allows you to mount a ChunkFS tree (or a copy of it, of course), and gives you a single file named image that has the same contents as the file or device you created the tree from by mounting it as a ChunkFS.

fedora-packages:drbdlinks/drbdlinks.name: drbdlinks
fedora-packages:drbdlinks/drbdlinks.summary: Program for managing links into a DRBD shared partition
fedora-packages:drbdlinks/drbdlinks.description: The drbdlinks program manages links into a DRBD partition which is shared among several machines. A simple configuration file, "/etc/drbdlinks.conf", specifies the links. This can be used to manage e.g. links for /etc/httpd, /var/lib/pgsql and other system directories that need to appear as if they are local to the system when running applications after the drbd shared partition has been mounted. When running drbdlinks with "start" as the mode, drbdlinks will rename the existing files/directories and then make symbolic links into the DRBD partition, "stop" does the reverse. fedora-packages:golang-github-aead-chach.description: ChaCha is a stream cipher family created by Daniel J. Bernstein. The most common ChaCha variant is ChaCha20 (20 rounds). This package provides implementations of three ChaCha versions: – ChaCha20 with a 64 bit nonce (can en/decrypt up to 2^64 * 64 bytes for one key-nonce combination) – ChaCha20 with a 96 bit nonce (can en/decrypt up to 2^32 * 64 bytes ~ 256 GB for one key-nonce combination) – XChaCha20 with a 192 bit nonce (can en/decrypt up to 2^64 * 64 bytes for one key-nonce combination) Furthermore the chacha sub package implements ChaCha20/12 and ChaCha20/8. These versions use 12 or 8 rounds inste -d of 20. But it's recommended to use ChaCha20 (with 20 rounds) - it will be fast enough for almost all purposes. fedora-packages:python-neo/python3-neo.name: python3-neo

The goal of Neo is to improve interoperability between Python tools for analyzing, visualizing and generating electrophysiology data (such as OpenElectrophy, NeuroTools, G-node, Helmholtz, PyNN) by providing a common, shared object model. In order to be as lightweight a dependency as possible, Neo is deliberately limited to representation of data, with no functions for data analysis or visualization. Neo implements a hierarchical data model well adapted to intracellular and extracellular electrophysiology and EEG data with support for multi-electrodes (for example tetrodes). Neos data objects build on the quantities_ package, which in turn builds on NumPy by adding support for physical dimensions. Thus neo objects behave just like normal NumPy arrays, but with additional metadata, checks for dimensional consistency and automatic unit conversion. Read the documentation at http://neo.readthedocs.io/

What does this mean? -------------------- It is now simpler to add custom functionality to Pandas DataFrames and Series. Import this package. Write a simple python function. Register the function using one of the following decorators. Why? ---- Pandas is super handy. Its general purpose is to be a "flexible and powerful data analysis/manipulation library". firefox-addons:2939877.name: Privacy Toggles
firefox-addons:2939877.summary: Proteggi la tua navigazione con un pannello semplice a toggle: blocca traccianti, nascondi cookie-wall, pulisci i link e riduci il fingerprinting.
firefox-addons:2939877.description:
Privacy Toggles – Protezione privacy 
Privacy Toggles ti permette di gestire in modo semplice e immediato le principali funzioni di privacy di Firefox.
Con un’interfaccia a interruttori chiari e visivi, puoi decidere cosa attivare o disattivare in tempo reale, senza dover scavare tra impostazioni avanzate o about:config.
🔹 Funzionalità principali:
 Anti-Fingerprinting (RFP): riduce la possibilità di identificazione tramite fingerprint unici del browser.
 First-Party Isolation: separa i cookie per dominio, impedendo correlazioni tra siti diversi.
 Tracking Protection avanzata: blocca tracker noti e cookie di terze parti.
 Referrer disabilitati: impedisce l’invio automatico dell’URL di provenienza.
 Hyperlink Auditing (ping) off: blocca i “ping” che tracciano i click.
 Predict/Prefetch off: disattiva caricamenti preventivi non richiesti.
 WebRTC bloccato: evita possibili leak dell’IP reale.
 URL Cleaner: rimuove in automatico parametri di tracciamento (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, ecc.) dai link.
 Cookie-Wall Block: nasconde banner e overlay invasivi che impediscono la lettura dei contenuti.
🔹 Controllo totale:
 Attiva/disattiva ogni modulo singolarmente.
 Usa il pulsante globale “Attiva tutto / Disattiva tutto”.
 Ricarica tutte le schede con un solo click per applicare le modifiche.
Privacy Toggles è pensato per chi vuole la protezione del livello di Brave o uBlock, ma con un’interfaccia semplice, modulare e sempre sotto controllo.
Non aggiunge permessi extra e non raccoglie alcun dato.

firefox-addons:3039588.name: Privacy Screen Overlay
firefox-addons:3039588.summary: Drop a solid, color- and opacity-adjustable privacy overlay over any tab. Toggle by shortcut or toolbar, and auto-cover your sensitive sites.
firefox-addons:3039588.description:
Working somewhere people can see your screen? Privacy Screen Overlay drops a solid layer over the current tab so nobody around you can read it — perfect for opening WhatsApp Web, email, or chats on a laptop in the office.
Features: 
• Solid overlay with adjustable opacity and any color you like (default black). 
• Toggle privacy on the current tab from the toolbar button or a keyboard shortcut. 
• Raise or lower the overlay opacity with keyboard shortcuts. 
• "Reveal while hovering" mode: the overlay clears while you're actively looking at the page and re-covers the instant you look away or switch tabs. 
• Sensitive sites list: add a domain (e.g. web.whatsapp.com ) and it's covered automatically every time it loads.
Default shortcuts (all changeable at about:addons → Manage Extension Shortcuts): 
• Toggle privacy — Ctrl+Shift+Y 
• More opaque — Ctrl+Shift+. 
• Less opaque — Ctrl+Shift+,
Your settings stay on your device. The extension collects nothing and sends no data anywhere.

firefox-addons:3029364.name: WhatsApp Blur - Privacidade
firefox-addons:3029364.summary: Proteja sua privacidade ao usar o WhatsApp Web em cafés, transportes públicos, escritórios ou qualquer lugar onde outras pessoas possam ver sua tela.
firefox-addons:3029364.description:
O que a extensão faz?
Aplica um efeito de desfoque sobre o conteúdo do WhatsApp Web. Para revelar qualquer elemento, basta passar o cursor do mouse sobre ele. É possível ativar e desativar todos os efeitos de uma vez com o atalho Alt+Shift+B ou pelo botão na barra de ferramentas do navegador.
Cada elemento pode ser controlado individualmente:
Texto das mensagens — borra o conteúdo das conversas abertas
Mídia — borra imagens, vídeos e stickers de forma independente
Nomes de contatos — borra os nomes na lista lateral de conversas
Preview de mensagens — borra o texto da última mensagem na lateral
Fotos de perfil — borra todos os avatares
Esta extensão não coleta absolutamente nenhum dado, e aqui está a prova:
A extensão não faz nenhuma requisição de rede. Ela não possui servidores, não se comunica com endereços externos e não envia nada para lugar nenhum. Você pode verificar isso abrindo as ferramentas de desenvolvedor do Firefox (F12 → aba Rede) enquanto a extensão está ativa: não aparecerá nenhuma requisição originada por ela.
As únicas informações armazenadas são suas preferências de configuração (quais elementos você escolheu borrar), e elas ficam salvas exclusivamente no armazenamento local do seu próprio navegador, usando a API padrão browser.storage.local. Esses dados nunca saem do seu computador, não são sincronizados com nenhum servidor e são apagados automaticamente se você desinstalar a extensão.
A extensão não lê, não processa e não tem acesso ao conteúdo das suas mensagens. Ela funciona aplicando classes CSS diretamente nos elementos visuais da página — o mesmo princípio de mudar a cor de um botão. Nenhum texto, imagem ou dado de conversa é capturado ou interpretado pelo código.

 Sem conexões externas
 Sem rastreamento ou analytics
 Sem acesso ao conteúdo das mensagens
 Configurações salvas apenas localmente no seu navegador

firefox-addons:15095.description:
Important announcement 
With Firefox Version 57 (Nov. 2017) the classic add-on support will be dropped. Only Web-Extensions will be allowed. As a result, some features will be lost and some will be crippled. Version 5 has (again) been heavily rewritten to work as web-extension.
 About the add-on 
The add-on uses dict.cc to translate words and phrases in any website, epub or pdf.
No add-on is faster, easier or more precise!
- Text selection is only required for phrases.
- Use rocker gestures or modifiers (for example ctrl+alt) and mouseclick to quickly translate the word under your cursor.
- Use the context menu to get more options.
- Quick search via toolbar button or Alt+Q shortcut.
- This is a word and phrase translation, it does not translate whole sentences.
- I'm not the author or owner of dict.cc , I just wrote this Firefox add-on.
All languages from dict.cc are supported, and if new ones arrive, you can just update the list of languages from within the add-on.
And now it's also possible to do a quick search using a combination of [ctrl,shift,alt] + click on a word.
Results can be shown as a pop-up or in a new tab or as an in-page translation layer.
 About dict.cc 
 dict.cc is a nice dictionary with mostly German English translations, but other languages are also available and growing. dict.cc shows quite a lot of different possible results, instead of just one, so you have a better chance of finding the correct one.
 Help 
If you have problems, questions or other feedback, please create an issue on GitHub.
If you like it, please write a review.
I've received suggestions on how to improve the add-on, which can't be done without changes on dict.cc (The website):
- Audio Playback support
- Vocabulary Trainer support
Until support for this has been added in the form of a RESTful API, there is little I can do.

firefox-addons:3070491.name: Auto-Cart Shopping Assistant
firefox-addons:3070491.summary: Adds items from a shopping list to your cart on Mercadona, Bonpreu/Esclat, and Día. Never completes checkout.
firefox-addons:3070491.description:
Paste your weekly shopping list, one item per line, with as much or as
little detail as you want — quantities, brand preferences, size ranges,
dietary notes ("no added sugar", "sin gluten") — and the assistant searches
each store, picks the best-matching product for every line, and adds it to
your cart. You always place the order yourself; the extension never
completes a purchase. 
Doing the same weekly supermarket order by hand — searching the same 20-30
items, picking the right pack size, adding each to cart — is repetitive.
This extension automates the tedious middle part (search → match → add) and
leaves the part that should stay a deliberate human decision (reviewing the
cart and paying) exactly where it belongs: with you, on the store's own
site.
 Plain-text shopping lists. Write your list the way you'd write it for
 yourself — 2x Yogur natural , Salmón congelado (sin piel, 250-500 g) ,
 # meat section as a comment to organize the list. Bullets ( - , * ,
 1. ), blank lines, and # comment lines are all handled automatically.
 Fuzzy, constraint-aware matching. Weight/size ranges and simple
 keyword constraints ("no added sugar", "sin gluten") are matched directly
 against each store's product data — including correctly distinguishing
 "250-500 g" for one yogurt from "250-500 g" for a whole multi-pack.
 AI disambiguation, only when genuinely needed. Most items resolve with
 plain rule-based matching. When a search returns several similarly-good
 candidates, one batched request (using your own Anthropic API key)
 disambiguates them using the item's own notes and any general shopping
 preferences you've set — never a per-item AI call.
 General shopping preferences. A separate notes field ("prefer the
 cheapest equivalent", "avoid products with additives") applies to every
 item in the run, not just one line.
 Multi-store in one run. Mercadona, Bonpreu/Esclat, and Día side by
 side — pick which stores to run against each time.
 Optional cart clearing. Empty each store's existing cart before adding
 your list, for a clean weekly re-run — using each store's own native
 "empty cart" mechanism, not slow one-by-one removal.
 Live progress and a clear results table. Every item's outcome is
 reported — added (with the actual product and price that landed in your
 cart), needs manual review, or failed — with the reason, so nothing
 silently disappears. Progress is also mirrored in the browser tab's
 title, so you can check how a run is going while browsing another tab.
 Cross-store comparison. Running against two or more stores in one go
 adds one extra, automatic summary at the end pointing out where the two
 carts differ — a cheaper match at one store, or an item that only one
 store's search could find.
 Daily health checks. A background check flags a red badge on the
 toolbar icon if a store's search stops working, so you find out before
 you start shopping, not partway through.
 Runs in your own logged-in session. No separate login, no credential
 storage — the extension acts inside your existing, already-logged-in
 browser tabs for each store.
 Open the extension (toolbar icon) and paste your list.
 Pick which stores to run against, and optionally check "Empty each
 store's cart first."
 Hit Run. The assistant opens a background tab per store if needed,
 searches for each item, filters by your constraints, and adds matches to
 cart — asking an AI model to pick between close candidates only when the
 rule-based match is genuinely ambiguous.
 If you ran 2+ stores, a short AI-written comparison appears once
 everything's done, calling out anything worth a second look between the
 carts.
 Review the results table, switch to each store's tab, and check out
 yourself whenever you're ready.
 The extension never completes checkout or handles payment. It only
 ever searches for products and adds them to cart — the final review and
 purchase step is always yours, on the store's own site.
 No data is collected by, or sent to, this extension's developer. 
 There is no backend server owned by this project. All persistent data
 (your list text, store selection, preferences, and a small cache of past
 item→product matches) is stored locally via the browser's own
 storage.local / storage.sync , the same mechanism any extension uses to
 remember its settings.
 AI disambiguation is opt-in and limited. If you set an Anthropic API
 key in the extension's settings, the item text and a short list of
 candidate product names/prices/sizes are sent directly from your browser
 to Anthropic's API for genuinely ambiguous items only — never for every
 item, and never to any server other than Anthropic's own API. Leave the
 key blank and no data leaves your browser at all; ambiguous items are
 simply flagged for you to resolve by hand.
 The cross-store comparison uses the same key and the same direct
 browser→Anthropic connection. When 2+ stores are run, one extra request
 sends that run's own results — item names, the product name/price/size
 that landed in each cart, and any failure reasons — so the model can
 summarize where the stores diverged. No new information is gathered for this beyond what
 the run already produced, and it's skipped entirely (silently, not a
 failure) without an API key.
 No credentials are touched. The extension relies entirely on your
 existing, already-logged-in session in your own browser tabs. It never
 asks for, stores, or transmits a password, payment method, or other
 account credential for any store.
 Mercadona ( tienda.mercadona.es )
 Bonpreu / Esclat (compraonline.bonpreuesclat.cat)
 Día ( dia.es )
More Spanish supermarket chains may be added if they support a compatible
online cart. (Some chains — Lidl, at the time of writing — don't offer
online grocery ordering at all, only in-store pickup for non-food goods, and
so can't be supported.)

firefox-addons:3085562.description:
Give LeetCode a complete makeover. Theme Studio adds dark mode themes, a matching code editor theme with its own syntax colors, and a custom background image behind the problem page. Pick one of eight handcrafted LeetCode themes, or turn any picture into one: an anime wallpaper, a photo you love, your desk setup. Text stays readable on every background, because the contrast is calculated from your picture.
It restyles the whole page, not just the editor: the problem description, the code editor and its syntax highlighting, the testcase console, the panels, the top bar and the fonts. Themes switch instantly in every open tab with no reload, and Off gives you the default look back.
ANIME STUDIO
• 18 scenes included, from moonlit shrines to city nights and dragons. Or add your own picture.
• A scene for each difficulty: a calm train window for Easy, a moonlit shrine for Medium, a crimson dragon for Hard. Choose your own for each.
• Panels turn into frosted glass over the scene, and syntax colors are generated from the art, with every token type in its own color.
• Readable by design: the glass is solved for each scene so text always clears strong contrast. No setting can make your code unreadable.
• Episode title cards: open an unsolved problem and it plays like an episode, 「第1話」 with the title and the arc.
• Verdict moments with sound effects for Accepted, passed tests, Wrong Answer and Time Limit Exceeded.
SHARE YOUR ACCEPTED SUBMISSIONS AND STREAK
After an Accepted submission you get a card with the problem, difficulty, your Beats %, language, runtime and your daily solve streak, ready to post on LinkedIn or X in one click. You can turn it off anytime.
EIGHT THEMES
• Anime Studio: 18 scenes or your own picture.
• Vintage Paper: crumpled kraft paper on a walnut desk, a warm light look.
• Sakura Night: petal pink and cold cyan on plum indigo.
• Grid: a dark drafting table with hard edges and monospace type.
• Orchid: silk velvet with rose-gold trim.
• Web Crawler: charcoal webs, crimson and electric blue, with spiders that drop in on your verdicts.
• Adventure: an RPG night realm with quests and loot.
• Pixel Art: an 8-bit world. Submit an Accepted answer and a pixel gunner blasts the page to pieces, then rewinds it.
FOCUS MODE FOR CONTESTS AND INTERVIEWS
One shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+.) hides the scene, the animations and the sound, so you can practice for coding interviews and weekly contests without distraction.
FAST AND PRIVATE
• No lag: scrolling and typing were measured and match the stock site.
• Nothing animates while you type.
• No account, no sign-in, no analytics and no network requests. Your settings and pictures stay in your browser.
• Runs only on problem pages.
Found a bug or want a new theme? Use the Report bug button in the popup.
Some scene artwork designed by Freepik – Magnific.com .
Theme Studio for LeetCode is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by LeetCode.

- Weekly XP Leaderboard: Check Your Total XP(+1 for every correct answer) and join in on Weekly XP Competitions - where Players with the most XP points from All Game Modes at the End of the Week(Sunday at 11:59pm EST) Win a Gold, Silver, or Bronze Trophy

bluejetty:00115555:android.description:
🧩 Welcome to Cube to Hole Puzzle!
Get ready for an exciting and brain-teasing experience! In Cube to Hole Puzzle, your objective is simple: fill the colored cubes into their matching colored holes. But there’s a catch—limited space on the board and only a few slots to move the cubes forward. You’ll need to plan ahead and choose the right cube to move first. Strategize carefully to avoid blocking yourself and clear the board to progress through each level!
🎨 Art & Aesthetic
Enjoy a visually stunning and clean design as you dive into the world of Cube to Hole Puzzle. With vibrant, colorful cubes and minimalistic backgrounds, the game keeps your focus on the puzzle while providing a visually satisfying experience. Each level is beautifully designed, ensuring you stay immersed as you solve each challenge.
🔊 Sound & VFX
The game features satisfying sound effects that provide audio feedback for every move you make. The soft clicks and smooth animations as the cubes glide into their holes add an extra layer of enjoyment to the gameplay. The bright colors and fluid VFX make every completed puzzle feel like a small victory, making the experience even more satisfying.
🎉 Ready to Challenge Yourself?
Do you have the skills to solve every puzzle? With increasing difficulty and new challenges at every level, Cube to Hole Puzzle will keep you entertained for hours. Download the game now and put your brain to the test—can you clear the board and become a puzzle master?

bluejetty:00126412:ios.description:
Did you know there can be a difference of 40 cents per litre between the cheapest and most expensive service stations?
FuelCheck gives you real-time fuel prices at your fingertips. Over 2300 service stations in NSW and 60 service stations in ACT upload fuel prices in real-time. You can find the cheapest fuel near you anytime anywhere.
You can personalise the app by adding your favourite stations and addresses. Set up alerts for your favourite station or when the price drops under a certain threshold.
My trip feature helps you locate the cheapest fuel on your route.
Ability to report a price mismatch if the price displayed in the service station is different to the app.
Trends allow you to see the price cycle, cheapest day to fill and price range in your local area and compare prices for different fuel types.

TAKE THE IQ TEST
Start with the complete 40-question IQ-st
bluejetty:00086912:ios.description:
How smart are you? Take a complete IQ-style test, discover your estimated score, and challenge yourself with brain games designed around logic, memory, focus, math, and reasoning.
TAKE THE IQ TEST
Start with the complete 40-question IQ-style test for a more detailed result, or choose a shorter quiz when you only have a few minutes. Different question types challenge the way you recognize patterns, work with numbers, solve problems, and reason under pressure.
Your score is an approximate estimate intended for personal use, practice, and entertainment. You can repeat tests, become familiar with the formats, and compare your results over time.
TRAIN YOUR BRAIN
Go beyond a single intelligence test with a varied collection of mental exercises and quick games. Practice key skills through:
• Logic puzzles and problem-solving challenges
• Number series and mathematical reasoning
• Pattern recognition
• Spatial and geometric puzzles
• Memory and attention exercises
• Verbal reasoning
• Focus and processing-speed challenges
Short sessions make it easy to fit mental exercise into your day, while progressive difficulty keeps the experience challenging as you improve.
PRACTICE FOR APTITUDE TESTS
Prepare for common question formats found in aptitude tests, psychometric assessments, entrance exams, and job-selection processes. Timed exercises help you practice working under pressure, while untimed activities let you focus on understanding each type of problem.
The app is designed for practice and familiarity with test formats. It is not affiliated with any employer, school, examination provider, or professional assessment organization.
CHOOSE HOW YOU WANT TO PLAY
• Complete 40-question IQ-style test
• Quick tests and mini-quizzes
• Timed and untimed activities
• Logic, math, memory, focus, and spatial challenges
• Different difficulty levels
• Progress and score tracking
• Approximate IQ certificate to share for fun
• Brain games for short daily sessions
WHO IS IT FOR?
IQ Test is suitable for adults and students who enjoy logic games, math puzzles, mental challenges, and reasoning tests. It can also help job applicants and students become more comfortable with aptitude-style questions and timed test formats.
Whether you want to estimate your IQ score, prepare for a test, exercise specific thinking skills, or simply enjoy a challenging puzzle, you can choose the experience that fits your time and goals.
START YOUR CHALLENGE
Take the complete IQ-style test, try a quick quiz, practice your weakest skills, and keep challenging yourself with new logic, memory, math, and reasoning exercises.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
All scores and certificates provided by the app are approximate estimates intended for educational, practice, entertainment, and personal-tracking purposes only. They are not medical or clinical results and are not a substitute for an assessment administered by a qualified professional.

**CFRN – Flight Nursing**

**CBRN – Burn Nursing**

* Question history

If you want to play fun mini games with your friends all together on the same device, this is a great game for you!

Snakes :
Don't touch your opponent's body and stay alive! A simple goal but a challenge.

Instead of using pen and paper just open the app and challenge your friend on the same device! A two player classic!
Pool :
The classic pool game for 2 player on one device! Pot the balls to score!
Paint fight :
Coloring race, to paint the paper fastest with your color!
Spinner war :
Push your opponent outside the stage! Two players on a small area are too much!
More classic fun like Archery, tug of war rope, whack a mole.
Other brain games like Memory, maths, solitaire, jigsaw puzzles.
Racing cars, sword duels, and much more!
Plus, even more new games coming soon!
All these games in one app for 1 2 3 4 players. Get the collection for free now, and enjoy local multiplayer on one device / one phone / one tablet, and bring the fun to the party!
Disclaimer: this multiplayer game can ruin friendships!

bluejetty:00027828:android.description:
Enjoy home design & makeover games? Welcome to My Home Design Makeover! Play the best home design meets toy cube blast puzzle game! Help clients decide, decorate & design their homes and transform their dreams into reality with amazing home makeovers! Solve fun toy cube blast game puzzles to help design, renovate, decorate, restore, create, fix, flip & build the perfect dream home makeover with beautiful room decor. Challenge your brain in the best offline home design match 2 or 3 cube blast game.
The goal is to create, design, decorate, renovate, flip, fix, makeover & restore your client’s house, mansion or home & play fun toy cube blast puzzles. Become the best home designer as lots of families are counting on you to restore, renovate their home down-and-out fixer uppers!
GAME FEATURES:
* Express yourself: with an incredible variety of high-end designer furniture, lighting, flooring & other décor choices. Challenge your sense of design, adjust wall colors, flooring and furniture placements to harmonize the atmosphere. Customize every piece of your own furniture the way you want! Any location, any color; You choose! you decide!
* House Design: Open-ended addictive puzzle game-play. Various styles at your own disposal! Makeover, build, create, renovate, design, decorate, fix, flip & restore other people’s dream houses, mansions & homes all by yourself & make them happy!
* Renovate: Rebuild outdated interior designs into outstanding makeovers with bold accents, pops of color, stylish fixtures & finishes. Remodel homes, mansions, houses with traditional interior styles or go Modern? You decide, you design!
* Furniture Styles: Renovate a variety of fixer uppers that need your interior design eye: living rooms, kitchens, bathrooms, decks, offices, gardens & much more! Master all furniture styles & become a truly professional decorator, each client with their own design challenge!
* Different Stories: Work with multiple client personalities. Help various HGTV like clients brothers, celebrities, families, newlyweds to transform dreams into reality. Build the most incredible property or fixer upper for brothers, celebrities and families with kids. Help them create, design, decorate, restore, renovate, build, flip, fix and makeover their old homes, broken houses & outdated mansions into beautiful dream makeovers.
* Multiple houses / mansions / homes: Not satisfied with decorating, building, designing, creating or restoring only one mystery house and just one sweet fantasy story? We have plenty of simulation mystery houses for you to build, flip, design, craft, renovate, restore, create or decorate & have a blast! Design and renovate different room styles including family-friendly living rooms, rustic kitchens, stylish bathrooms, chic bedrooms, private study rooms, amazing office spaces & chilled out decks and gardens!
* Exciting Match Cube Blast Puzzles: Match 2 or 3 the same color cubes and combine boosters for huge explosions to blast your way through thousands of levels! Play fun challenging match 2 or 3 cube blast levels with awesome boosters. You can create tons of powerful boosters, make magical combos to match and crush the crafty match 3 levels. More matching means more decor and more fun! Earn coins from the match puzzles to customize your client’s homes, houses, mansions with a variety of furniture and decorations.
* Rewards: Unlock multiple rewards and earn them as you impress your clients by decorating the home, house or mansion project of their dreams with amazing beautiful makeovers.
* Frequent content updates: frequent, fresh and free story content updates with new project opportunities to put your design, decorate, create, renovate, restore, build, fix and flip skills to use and create amazing makeovers!
You don’t have to be a house flipper or need to have knowledge of house building, interior designing, decorating, creating, restoring, renovating or flipping. My Home Design Makeover is a free to play game.

bluejetty:00063183:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00063183:ios.description:
Embark on a Marble-Shooting Adventure Like Never Before!
Dive into the colorful world of Zumbia Revenge, the ultimate marble-shooting puzzle game that will test your skills and keep you entertained for hours! With stunning graphics, challenging levels, and exciting power-ups, Zumbia Revenge is the perfect blend of strategy and fun, designed for players of all ages.
 Engaging Gameplay
Your mission is simple: match three or more marbles of the same color to clear them from the board. But don't be fooled by the simplicity! With every level, the challenge increases as new obstacles and tougher layouts appear. Use your strategic thinking and quick reflexes to master each level and advance to the next.
 Unique Power-Ups
Unleash the power of special marbles to blast through obstacles and achieve high scores! From explosive bombs to lightning-fast speed boosts, the power-ups in Zumbia Revenge are designed to help you overcome even the trickiest levels. Strategically deploy them to create chain reactions and clear the board in style.
 Explore Multiple Worlds
Travel through various themed worlds, each with its own unique set of levels and challenges. From ancient temples hidden deep in the jungle to icy landscapes full of mystery, every environment offers a fresh experience and new puzzles to solve. Unlock new worlds by completing levels and earning stars.
 Easy to Play, Hard to Master
With intuitive controls and a user-friendly interface, Zumbia Revenge is easy to pick up but difficult to put down. Whether you're a casual player looking to pass the time or a puzzle enthusiast seeking a real challenge, Zumbia Revenge offers something for everyone. Master the art of marble-shooting and rise through the ranks!
 Stunning Visuals and Soundtrack
Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Zumbia Revenge with beautifully crafted graphics and a captivating soundtrack. Each level is brought to life with rich colors, detailed animations, and dynamic sound effects that enhance your gaming experience. Get ready for a visual and auditory treat every time you play!
 Free to Play
Zumbia Revenge is completely free to play, with optional in-app purchases available for those who want to enhance their experience. Whether you choose to play for free or invest in premium items, you'll find endless entertainment in this marble-shooting adventure.
 Regular Updates
We're committed to making Zumbia Revenge the best marble-shooting game out there! Expect regular updates with new levels, features, and improvements based on player feedback. Your adventure in the world of marbles is just beginning!
Download Zumbia Revenge now and start your journey through a world of color, strategy, and fun! Can you conquer all the levels and become the ultimate marble master? Play now to find out!

WELCOME TO CHATKIDS: SAFE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR KIDS AND FAMILIES — LEARN, PLAY, AND MAKE ART WITH AI.

bluejetty:00145261:ios.description:
WELCOME TO CHATKIDS: SAFE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR KIDS AND FAMILIES — LEARN, PLAY, AND MAKE ART WITH AI.
The premier educational and entertainment platform powered by the most advanced AI technologies, including the ChatGPT API and GPT-5. This family-friendly app is specifically designed to foster a safe, engaging, and enriching environment for children, ensuring peace of mind for parents.
WHY CHATKIDS? — At ChatKids, we prioritize the safety and development of your children. Our platform is not just another digital AI companion; it’s a secure gateway to a world of learning tailored to the needs of young minds. Every interaction within ChatKids is meticulously crafted to be age-appropriate, ensuring a wholesome experience for your family.
DEDICATED TO FAMILY SAFETY: In a world where digital safety is paramount, ChatKids ensures a secure environment with PIN-protected parent mode and age-appropriate interactions for each different ages, perfect for your child’s first steps in the digital world.
FOCUSED ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE EXPERIENCES FOR KIDS: ChatKids offers a unique range of pre-trained AI experiences designed to safely educate and entertain. With experiences ranging from ‘Language Learning’ to ‘Space Explorer,’ and ‘Create Your Super Hero,’ our AI ensures that learning is always safe and fun.
EXPAND YOUR CHILD’S HORIZONS: With artificial intelligence tailored for educational purposes, ChatKids facilitates a broader understanding of complex subjects through simple, engaging conversations and activities designed for children.
AGE-APPROPRIATE: Each feature of ChatKids is designed with the age of the child in mind, from the AI bots they interact with, to the topics and challenges they engage in. This ensures that every part of our app is not just fun but also perfectly suited to their developmental stage.
MAKE ART: Encourage your child’s artistic flair with ChatKids. From drawing and painting to digital creation, our AI supports your child as they express their creativity through art, helping them to visualize their imagination in vivid colors and shapes.
SAFETY FIRST: — In the digital age, your child’s safety is paramount. ChatKids is built with strong content filters and a commitment to privacy, ensuring a worry-free experience.
CREATIVITY WITHOUT LIMITS: — Offer your child multiple creative outlets like music composition, poetry writing, and drawing.
PERSONALIZED GROWTH: — Adaptive learning experiences that evolve with your child, helping them to grow, learn, and thrive in a dynamic environment.
KEY FEATURES:
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE-POWERED INTERACTIONS: Over 30 guided AI chatbots in subjects like science, arts, and mathematics, each designed to match your child’s age for personalized and effective learning.
ROBUST PARENTAL CONTROLS: Complete control with advanced settings, including PIN-protected parent mode and custom instructions for each child’s profile.
MULTI-CHILD PROFILES: Customize the app for each child’s learning pace and interests, with settings that adjust based on their birth year and optional gender.
INTERACTIVE LEARNING MODULES: Engage in fun and impactful education with coding classes, art-making sessions, and more.
CREATIVITY AND PLAY: Features to invent stories, design superheroes, or create fairy tales, encouraging creativity.
DISCOVER AND LEARN: Transform routine learning into an exciting adventure. Let your child explore space, the underwater world, or future cities, all within the safety of our app. Our AI guides offer knowledge and support, nurturing curiosity and critical thinking.
EMBRACE THE FUTURE OF FAMILY LEARNING WITH CHATKIDS.
-----
Privacy Policy & Terms of Use
Privacy Policy: https://mn-appstudio.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://mn-appstudio.com/terms/

bluejetty:00058513:android.description:
Introducing the premier parkour-style, run-and-drive arcade game that catapults you into the heart of Japan's urban jungle. Embark on a thrilling escapade through the authentic streets of Shinjuku, where the city's pulse is recreated with stunning realism.
Features:
Life-Like 3D Tokyo Replication: Navigate through Shinjuku with hyper-realistic 3D scenes, crafted with attention to detail to mirror the vibrant real-world location.
High-Definition Graphics: Arcade simulation reaches new heights with crisp, HD graphics that bring the bustling Tokyo streets to life.
Expansive Open World: Explore a vast and meticulously designed 3D cityscape that replicates vast urban sprawl, from skyscrapers to intricate street layouts.
Photorealistic Cityscapes: Stroll through a city brought to life with pedestrians and street props, rendered with photographic quality.
Cutting-Edge Physics: Dive into an immersive driving experience underpinned by an advanced physics engine that elevates gameplay to the peak of realism.
Diverse Vehicle Roster: Choose from a selection of sports and classic cars, each with unique handling to master in this ultimate competition.
Multiplayer Mayhem: Test your skills against other players, proving your mettle in a real-time urban challenge.
This isn't just another racing game; fuses realistic city simulation with the adrenaline-pumping fun of an arcade racer. Navigate through massive open world, where each vehicle, from precision-tuned parking masters to turbocharged SUVs, boasts its own distinct physics for a truly bespoke sensation.
The game's sprawling open-world map has been creatively designed to challenge your prowess while delivering the ultimate gameplay experience. The city comes alive with detail, making each journey an exploration of Japan's metropolitan marvel.
Underpinned by an elite graphics engine,delivers the deepest, most high-definition 3D driving experience on mobile. You'll be forgiven for mistaking the virtual world for reality, thanks to smart AI traffic and lifelike pedestrians that populate the streets.
Kick off the gameplay with turbocharged urgency, weaving through real asphalt streets at breakneck speeds. becomes an intense test of your reflexes and precision parking abilities. Feel the rush of drift-fueled performance and speed down trophy roads to reign as the undisputed racing monarch.
Tired of detached third-person views? offers a refreshing perspective. Slip into the driver's seat and view the world through the cockpit for an authentic and exhilarating ride. Push your limits, dodge through traffic, collect coins, and upgrade your fleet to climb the ranks and secure your spot atop the global leaderboards.
Prepare for the ride of your life with where the city's heartbeat is the rhythm of your race.

bluejetty:00099667:ios.summary: The number 1 recipe organizer. RecipeSnap keeps all your favorite recipes in one place, effortlessly importing from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and the Web. As the ultimate recipe keeper, it allows you to create grocery lists, des
bluejetty:00099667:ios.description:
The number 1 recipe organizer. RecipeSnap keeps all your favorite recipes in one place, effortlessly importing from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and the Web. As the ultimate recipe keeper, it allows you to create grocery lists, design meal plans, and even calculate calories for every dish you save. Whatever your cooking style, RecipeSnap helps you do it better.
FEATURES
- Instant Recipe Importer
Share a link from TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or any website. Our smart technology instantly turns videos and long articles into clean, easy-to-read recipes without the clutter.
- Screenshot to Recipe
Have a recipe saved in your camera roll? Upload a screenshot, and RecipeSnap will automatically extract the exact ingredients and instructions for you.
- Smart Grocery Lists
Create shopping lists in a flash. Ingredients are automatically sorted by supermarket aisle to make your trips to the store faster and easier.
- Weekly Meal Planner
Plan your week with ease. Organize recipes into daily meals for breakfast, lunch, and dinner to perfectly fit your schedule.
- Calculate Calories & Macros
Want to know what you're eating? Instantly calculate detailed nutrition information, including calories, protein, carbs, and fats for any recipe you save.
- Your Personal Cookbook
As your dedicated digital recipe keeper, the app lets you organize your meals into custom folders. Group them by cuisine, meal type, or diet (like vegan, keto, or gluten-free).
- Always in Sync
Your recipe collection is saved securely to the cloud. Access it on your iPad, iPhone, and share it with family from a single account.
- Cook with Confidence
Keep your screen awake while cooking with step-by-step instructions. Easily adjust serving sizes and convert measurements with a single tap.
- Share Recipes Instantly
Send your favorite meals to friends and family in seconds. Share full recipes directly via WhatsApp, SMS, email, Messenger, or AirDrop with a single tap.
ADDITIONAL TOOLS
• Add multiple photos to each recipe step.
• Attach original website links for easy reference.
• Rate and review your favorite meals.
HOW IT WORKS
RecipeSnap offers a free version and a premium subscription for advanced features.
The Premium Subscription unlocks:
1. Unlimited recipe import from social media and websites.
2. Upload unlimited private recipes to your personal collection.
3. Calculate nutrition for every recipe.
4. Create recipe from your screenshots or just type your ideas to make meals.
Start importing today for free to experience all premium features. You will only be charged at the end of the 7-day trial unless you cancel at least 24 hours beforehand. Your subscription will auto-renew at the end of each period until you cancel. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.
WEBSITE
Visit https://recipesnapapp.com to import your first recipe from the web.
Terms of Use: https://appable.app/legal#terms
Privacy Policy: https://appable.app/legal#privacy
Got an idea to make your cooking experience with RecipeSnap even better? We'd love to hear from you—reach out to us at https://recipesnapapp.com/contact

bluejetty:00063519:ios.summary: Hungry Shark is back in this epic arcade game where you control a monstrous sea beast! Dive into an ocean adventure that’s bigger, wilder, and more thrilling than ever. Feed your shark’s appetite by devouring everything in sight: from bite-
bluejetty:00063519:ios.description:
Hungry Shark is back in this epic arcade game where you control a monstrous sea beast! Dive into an ocean adventure that’s bigger, wilder, and more thrilling than ever. Feed your shark’s appetite by devouring everything in sight: from bite-size fish to unsuspecting beachgoers, and become the fiercest predator in the sea!
43 SPECIES OF SHARKS
Play as one of 43 unique sharks in this arcade game, with 8 size tiers including the legendary ocean beast, the Great White! These fish and monster sharks are ready to rule the ocean.
HUGE OPEN WORLDS
Explore diverse ocean and sea environments: the lush Pacific Islands, icy Arctic Ocean, mysterious Arabian Sea, and now the South China Sea—a bustling urban oasis with fresh prey for your hungry shark!
EYE-POPPING GRAPHICS
Experience the thrill of this ocean simulator in stunning 3D visuals. Dive deep into realistic sea environments that bring every fish, monster, and ocean beast to life!
SURVIVAL OF THE HUNGRIEST
It’s an underwater battle where you’re either the eater or the eaten! Conquer the ocean as you hunt down whales, submarines, and other tasty targets in this thrilling arcade game.
SHARK UPGRADES AND GEAR
Customize your monster shark with gadgets and accessories to swim faster, bite harder, and survive longer! Gear up with everything from jetpacks to lasers and take your beast to the next level.
SUPER SKINS
Transform your sharks with skins that make them stand out in the ocean and boost their stats. Express your inner beast with these fierce fits!
MANIC MISSIONS & BADASS BOSSES
Take on over 20 unique mission types, from high-score challenges to prey hunts and intense boss battles in this ocean simulator!
HELPFUL PREDATORY PETS
Recruit baby sharks, whales, and even a bald eagle to join you in the sea! These pets have special skills to help your shark grow stronger in this casual yet action-packed game.
SUPERSIZE MODE AND EPIC POWERS
Activate powerful abilities like supersize mode, explosion, hypnosis, and more to rampage through the ocean as the ultimate sea beast!
EXTINCTION MODE
Rise from the depths of the ocean in a battle to save the sea from destruction. Use the mighty Apex sharks to unleash chaos on your enemies and conquer the waters.
Use Facebook or Apple sign-in to synchronise your progress across your IOS devices.
Hungry Shark World is regularly updated with new features, missions, and challenges, making it the go-to arcade game for endless sea and ocean action! Dive back in for more thrills with each update.
This game includes In-App Purchases for Gems and Gold, which can also be collected in-game.

Introducing the ultimate Python editor for iOS!
Enjoy a powerful, easy-to-use environment for coding in Python right from your iPhone or iPad.

bluejetty:00139494:ios.description:
Ham's Kitchen - A Dream Cooking Tycoon Game with Cute Hamster Chefs!
Welcome to Ham's Kitchen, the ultimate healing game packed with fun and relaxation!
Start with a small restaurant, upgrade it, and decorate your accommodation with the help of cute hamster chefs, just like adorable cats. Watch as your tiny eatery grows into a luxurious restaurant, just like a hotel in this exciting idle tycoon cooking game.
In Ham's Kitchen, hamster chefs are waiting to serve you a variety of delicious foods.
▶ Create Your Own Restaurant with Various Dishes and Themes
Enjoy diverse desserts like coffee, bakery, tanghulu, candy, and snacks in the café,
try Korean dishes like kimbap and bibimbap, and Western favorites like hot dogs, hamburgers, and pizza!
For those who love fruit desserts, we offer sweet treats with melons, strawberries, and peaches!
Expand your restaurant into a high-class dining experience with brunch and meals.
Now you can welcome guests with a relaxing Aloha theme!
▶ Join the Cooking Journey with Cute Hamster Chefs
The hamster chefs are learning new dishes every day and upgrading the restaurant.
Decorate the chefs with adorable costumes and customize your restaurant with various themes and dishes!
Enjoy the fun of decorating and organizing the restaurant while collecting cute goods and growing your restaurant.
▶ Meet Special Guests
There’s never a dull moment with exciting themes and special guests waiting for you.
Experience moments of stress relief and healing while cooking with the hamster chefs!
Like a hotel that offers personalized service, provide the best accommodation and meals for your customers.
▶ Merge Event Game for Extra Rewards!
Join the merge event game and get special rewards!
Unlock more items and upgrade opportunities through the event game!
Enjoy new dishes and exclusive rewards with the hamster chefs!
Keep participating to earn more rewards and upgrades. Special events and rewards await!
▶ Healing Game Available Offline
Don’t worry if you don’t have an internet connection!
Even in offline mode, hamster chefs are working hard to run the restaurant.
When you need a break, leave the work to the hamster chefs and enjoy a free single-player game for healing!
Download now and start your exciting cooking tycoon adventure with your hamster friends!
Experience the fun of restaurant management, healing games, and cute characters every day!

bluejetty:00083742:ios.description:
We are Swisscows and we do not save your data! We respect your privacy and see it as our calling to protect your privacy.
Swisscows is a data-safe search engine. We take the privacy of our users very seriously.
More and more people are angry about how online companies handle user data. As Swisscows team, we have made it our business to offer Internet users a protected space. To ensure the protection of personal data and privacy on the Internet, we have developed the data-secure search engine Swisscows. By using Swisscows, you reduce the amount of data collected about you many times over. We do not create personal profiles, but anonymize all search queries after 7 days.
• It is in our DNA to protect every user!
• We do not save your data!
• At Swisscows you are 100% anonymous!
• We have our own servers and do not work with a cloud or with third-party providers!
• Our data center is located in the Swiss Alps and this is the safest bunker in all of Europe!
More privacy for all internet users! No monitoring, no data storage!
Swisscows does not save any personal information and does not forward any personal information! Absolutely none! We make sure that your private life remains your private life. Swisscows is the efficient alternative for everyone who values data integrity and the protection of privacy. In contrast to other search engines, Swisscows users leave no traces. We do without countless analyzes of our visitors. Your topics, IP addresses and personal information will not be stored or used for additional business purposes.
Our search engine is not only safe, but innovative.
Our semantic map offers you an interactive search experience! This will give you the results you want much faster. We have been researching information analysis and search for over 20 years. Swisscows offers you a completely new kind of intelligent search.

bluejetty:00062459:ios.summary:
Prepare your child for the digital age with Tynker - the fun and interactive way to learn to code! Whether your child is a complete beginner or has some experience, they'll love the engaging and exciting coding courses we offer.
Tynker is
bluejetty:00062459:ios.description:
Prepare your child for the digital age with Tynker - the fun and interactive way to learn to code! Whether your child is a complete beginner or has some experience, they'll love the engaging and exciting coding courses we offer.
Tynker is the leading platform for childhood coding education, used by over 100 million children and 150,000+ schools worldwide. Our award-winning curriculum is designed to make coding enjoyable for kids of all ages, and our step-by-step tutorials make learning easy and fun.
TYNKER AWARDS
*** Rated 5 stars for Engagement, Common Sense Media
*** Parents’ Choice Gold Award
*** Academics' Choice Award
*** Selected for Everyone Can Code program by Apple
*** Editor's Choice, Children's Technology Review
*** Featured by Apple in Education, Kids, and Best New Apps
*** Rated “Best for 8-14” by USA Today
Mod Creator App
Unleash your creativity in Minecraft with Tynker's Mod Creator App! This app equips you with the tools to shape and modify your Minecraft universe and invites you into a vibrant community of creators. Here, you can remix, reuse, and share a vast array of community-crafted skins, blocks, items, mobs, mods, and add-ons. 
This award-winning app includes unlimited access to Tynker's enormous educational and coding tools for mobile and web, fostering creativity and imagination.
Design Minecraft Resources with Ease
Save and import your skins into Minecraft
Build your custom world filled with blocks like cake or pink sand
Create items like lucky blocks, rainbow swords, and magic potions
Design mobs like colored sheep, rainbow chickens, and textured horses
Change Mob Behaviors with Block Coding
Use the built-in 3D editor to create custom mobs with extra parts and shapes
Create custom mobs such as a thunderbird, a three-headed wolf, or a unicorn
Define mob behaviors and change default behaviors with easy visual programming tools
Create Minecraft Mods with Code
Change the weather, set the time, and even teleport
Build mini-games like Tetris and Alien Invaders
Generate cities, roller coasters, and underground railroad systems
SUBSCRIPTIONS
A monthly or quarterly subscription plan unlocks full access to Minecraft courses like Mythicraft, Agent Recall, Gears of Time, and Mind Crafters. In addition, you get over 300 coding activities, unlimited access to all of Tynker’s award-winning apps, Tynker and Tynker Junior, and 5,000+ web lessons.
Choose between the following auto-renewing subscription options:
Monthly Plan – $24.99 per month
Quarterly Plan – $59.99 per quarter 
Prices are in USD and may vary by location.
Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account and will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
To cancel a subscription, turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes settings and allow the current period to end. Refunds are not available for unused portions of a subscription per iTunes policy.
Terms and Privacy Policy: https://www.tynker.com/privacy
NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG.
WHAT IS TYNKER?
Tynker empowers children to learn to code, starting with intuitive visual blocks and advancing to sophisticated languages like JavaScript, HTML, and Python. Children learn crucial skills such as logic, problem-solving, and critical thinking through coding. With Tynker's block-based approach, grasping fundamental coding concepts becomes enjoyable and straightforward. You can learn more at Tynker.com.

bluejetty:00034974:ios.name: Stand In Pride
bluejetty:00034974:ios.summary: Feeling the love and support of family is essential, especially during life's most significant moments. Whether it's a wedding, graduation, holiday, or simply a challenging day, everyone deserves to feel surrounded by caring individuals. St
bluejetty:00034974:ios.description:
Feeling the love and support of family is essential, especially during life's most significant moments. Whether it's a wedding, graduation, holiday, or simply a challenging day, everyone deserves to feel surrounded by caring individuals. Stand In Pride is here to connect members of the LGBTQIA+ community with other members and allies for emotional support or to physically stand in at life events, such as weddings or graduations.
Features:
- Regional Feed: Post and connect with support near you
- Advanced Tags: Use tags to find what you need, whether it’s an introduction or seeking support, tags will help you navigate the feed.
- Support Directory: List yourself as support or an available stand-in for events. Allow others to find your support based on location, interests, and needs.
- Find & Create Groups: Tailor your connections by creating or joining groups that resonate with your interests, hobbies, etc.
- Direct messaging: Continue connections safely in app
- Stand In Pride University: Learn more about how to be involved
- Support Requests: Keeping the spotlight on those seeking support
- Social Profile: Create a profile that reflects who you are and what kind of support you’re looking for.
- Safe & Inclusive Community: Join a global network of understanding and caring individuals who are committed to supporting the LGBTQIA+ community.
- Safety & Privacy: Tons of privacy settings to customize your experience, safety tips, and extensive data encryption. 
Why Stand In Pride?
Our Mission is to help any member of the LGBTQIA+ community who has lost the love and support of family. We will help them get connected with a loving heart that will be their Stand in Family. bluejetty:00074660:android.description:

- Challenging excavation and transportation missions
- Realistic physics controls of dumper truck and heavy excavator crane
- Smooth controls for hydraulic lifting, steering, rotation and brakes
- Remove ads functionality(you can play ads free game)
- Adventur

bluejetty:00027361:ios.summary:
PIANOTEQ: THE ULTIMATE VIRTUAL INSTRUMENT
Pianoteq is an award-winning virtual instrument that simulates a wide range of instruments including pianos, electric pianos, harpsichords, vibraphones, guitars, steel drums, and more, using advanc
bluejetty:00027361:ios.description:
PIANOTEQ: THE ULTIMATE VIRTUAL INSTRUMENT
Pianoteq is an award-winning virtual instrument that simulates a wide range of instruments including pianos, electric pianos, harpsichords, vibraphones, guitars, steel drums, and more, using advanced physical modeling. Unlike traditional virtual instruments that use recorded sounds, Pianoteq generates sounds in real-time by calculating the physics of how strings vibrate and how the soundboard radiates sound.
Why Pianoteq Stands Out:
 - Realistic Playability: By modeling the physical properties of instruments, Pianoteq replicates the playability and complex behavior of real acoustic instruments.
 - Compact Size: Without large samples, Pianoteq's file size is much smaller than other virtual instruments, making it ideal for your iOS device.
Trusted by the Best:
Steinway, KAWAI, Bösendorfer, C. Bechstein, Petrof, Steingraeber, Grotrian, Blüthner, and Hohner have all endorsed Pianoteq for its faithful sound reproduction.
Getting Started:
 - Connect a MIDI device to your iPad/iPhone.
 - Launch Pianoteq.
 - Start playing!
Pianoteq also works as a plugin in any Audio Unit host application, such as GarageBand, AUM, Cubasis, Camelot, and more.
Note: All instruments run in demo mode (with some keys disabled) until you purchase a Pianoteq STAGE license (unlocks two instruments) or link to an existing Pianoteq user account with a valid license. Licenses purchased on the App Store are valid across other supported platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux).

bluejetty:00121694:ios.description:
Welcome to the First Edition of the Beloved Game – "My Baby"!
Experience the joy of parenthood in the most delightful and interactive way. "My Baby" is an engaging, easy-to-use simulation game that allows you to care for your own adorable virtual newborn – a boy or a girl – just like in real life.
Learn how to nurture your little one with love and attention. Feed, play, bathe, cuddle, and even talk to your baby. Watch as they respond to your care with laughter, smiles, and sweet gestures. Every need is communicated – just like a real baby – making the experience both heartwarming and realistic.
Getting Started with “My Baby” – Quick Guide:
• Name Your Baby – Start by giving your newborn a unique name.
• Choose a Profile – Select the baby’s dominant hand (left/right).
• Make Them Laugh – Tap your baby’s face to see them giggle with joy.
• Keep Them Fed – Play mini-games to earn food and feed your baby.
• Bottle Time – Pick up the milk bottle to nourish your little one.
• Bath Time – Press the "shower cloud" icon, grab the soap, and give your baby a gentle bath.
• Playtime Fun – Hand your baby the rattle for some cheerful play.
• Bedtime Routine – Tap the "lamp" icon to tuck your baby in or wake them up.
• Talk to Your Baby – Record your voice with the "Recording" button for a personal touch.
• Capture the Moment – Take snapshots and share precious memories with friends and family.
Whether you're playing for fun or preparing for real-life parenting, "My Baby" offers a delightful and educational experience for all ages. Start building special moments with your little one today!

2248 Merge World : Numbers & Goods combines two satisfying puzzle experiences in one relaxing game.
Merge numbers to reach higher values in classic 2248 gameplay, or switch to goods merging to complete level-based challenges and collect charming items.
Two Merge Modes

Number Merge
- Classic 2248 number merge mechanics
- Endless gameplay with smooth controls
- Perfect for quick or long sessions

Goods Merge
-Merge two matching goods to evolve items
-Complete structured puzzle levels
-Discover new collections as you progress

Designed for Relaxation
-Cozy, nature-inspired visuals
-Simple and intuitive gameplay
-Offline play available

Whether you love merge games, number puzzles, or cozy casual experiences, 2248 Merge World : Numbers & Goods is the perfect way to unwind.

bluejetty:00063829:ios.name: ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE-RPG
bluejetty:00063829:ios.summary:
Sail for the Grand Line with Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates in the anime game ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE!
ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE is an epic turn-based anime RPG based off the popular ONE PIECE, with over 100 Million downloads worldwide!
bluejetty:00063829:ios.description:
Sail for the Grand Line with Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates in the anime game ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE!
ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE is an epic turn-based anime RPG based off the popular ONE PIECE, with over 100 Million downloads worldwide! Play through the ONE PIECE storyline and become the next pirate king in this hit anime game!
Recruit your favorite ONE PIECE characters and build your dream pirate crew. Recruit, level up and battle with characters from the anime, from Buggy the Clown to Trafalgar Law.
Enjoy unique outfits and forms of ONE PIECE characters. If you love Chopper in his reindeer form, Sanji in his Vinsmoke Raid Suit or Boa Hancock, you can find them all in ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE!
Explore the world of ONE PIECE and relive your favorite moments from the anime. Take Luffy, the Straw Hat Pirate crew and your favorite characters from every arc on an RPG adventure!
Battle pirates and Marines through classic turn-based RPG battle mechanics mixed with an intuitive tap battle system. The pirate action never stops in this anime game!
Find the ONE PIECE treasure and become the king of pirates in the anime game ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE!
ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE FEATURES:
ANIME GAME FROM THE ONE PIECE WORLD
• Explore the epic anime story from the beginning through every amazing storyline
• Join Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates on an RPG adventure to find the ONE PIECE treasure!
• Play through story arcs like Thriller Bark, Impel Down and Dressrosa
• Visit iconic locations across the sea, from the Baratie Restaurant to Fishman Island
• The unpredictable and diverse world of ONE PIECE is now yours to explore!
RECRUIT ONE PIECE CHARACTERS AND COLLECT SHIPS
• Recruit over 2,000 of your favorite ONE PIECE characters
• Unlock new characters by clearing story missions
• Recruit banners with awesome events
• Set sail on iconic ships, like the Going Merry and Thousand Sunny
LEVEL UP YOUR PIRATE CREW
• Make a team with all your favorite characters, from Zoro and Nami to Ace and Sabo
• Level up by evolving and limit breaking your favorite characters!
• Assemble the greatest pirate crew the Grand Line has ever seen!
ANIME RPG BATTLE GAMEPLAY
• Experience the intuitive turn based RPG battle tap timing system
• Turn based strategy battles with different character matchups and skills
• Time your attacks with your crew to unleash powerful battle chain attacks!
• Use special Tandem attacks for even more damage!
ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE is recommended for people who...
• like anime games
• want to play RPG games
• play other anime games
• have played other RPGs
• want to try anime games
• like RPG games
• want to play Japanese games
• addicted to RPG games
• want to try One Piece games
Are you ready to set sail on an adventure into the anime world of ONE PIECE? Join Luffy and his pirate crew in ONE PIECE TREASURE CRUISE anime game today!

bluejetty:00096973:ios.description:
Smart Cleaner: Effortlessly Free Up More Storage.
Tired of the "Storage Almost Full" alert? Smart Cleaner is the tool that uses cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence to help you quickly free up storage space on your iPhone. Clear up camera roll clutter with a single tap and make your phone feel brand new!
Key Features at a Glance
Intelligent Scanning & Cleaning
Duplicate & Similar Photo Cleaner: Smart recognition swiftly identifies and precisely filters out duplicate photos, burst shot series, and screenshots from your camera roll. Easily keep the best version and bulk delete the unnecessary clutter.
Large & Similar Video Management: Quickly locate large video files consuming your storage, or find similar and redundant video clips cluttering your device. You can choose to review and delete them directly, instantly freeing up precious space.
Email Cleaner
Overwhelmed by emails? Use Email Cleaner to take back control.
We efficiently remove unwanted mail and let you unsubscribe from spam and promotional lists, keeping your inbox clean and organized. 
Lightning-Fast Swipe-to-Clean Mode
Say goodbye to tedious selection boxes! Use intuitive Left and Right Swipe gestures to organize your album like sorting through cards:
Swipe Left to Delete: Quickly discard unwanted photos.
Swipe Right to Keep: Effortlessly save precious memories. 
Organize your photos efficiently by using the quick action of swiping left to delete and right to save.
Video Compression
Use our advanced Video Compression feature to significantly shrink large video file sizes while maximizing quality preservation. Instantly reclaim massive space without sacrificing your memories.
Manage Contacts
Quickly merge duplicate contacts and clear incomplete entries. Ensure data safety with one-tap backup, eliminating clutter for an organized address book.
Subscription Information
Choose between the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features:
* Weekly Subscription (Includes a 3-day free trial)
* Yearly Subscription (No free trial available)
You can cancel the free trial or stop the auto-renewal of any subscription at any time by managing your settings in the App Store. To avoid being charged, cancellation must be completed at least 24 hours before the end of the current trial or billing period. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited upon purchase of a subscription.
This app is subject to Apple's Standard End User License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Why Choose Smart Cleaner?
High Efficiency & Intelligence: AI-driven recognition technology makes the cleaning process far superior and faster than manual sorting.
Simple Operation: With an intuitive interface, both the one-tap cleanup and gesture organization are easy to master.
Deep Storage Release: Go beyond simple deletion. Use video compression to fundamentally solve your storage deficit problems.
Privacy Policy: https://www.dreameyeshk.com/home/smartcleaner-privacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://www.dreameyeshk.com/home/smartcleaner-terms
App Support: https://www.dreameyeshk.com/home/help-support
Download Smart Cleaner now to enjoy a smoother and more spacious phone experience!
