bluejetty:00100790:ios.description:
Are you an existing Sola client? Download Sola Payments to accept and manage payments on the go!
Manage and process your business’s payments at the lowest rates—anytime and anywhere. Use our compatible EMV card reader, key-in card details, capture card info through your camera, and send customer email receipts with the click of a button. Download for free and log in to your existing Sola processing account, giving you the ability to track sales and reports on the go. 
• Key in card data or snap a photo to quickly capture card details.
• Use our compatible mobile EMV card reader to give your customers even more payment options—from chip and contactless cards to magstripe cards.
• Instantly locate and view past transactions with easy search and filter tools.
• Quickly and automatically send email receipts.
• Adjust, refund, and void transactions with just a few clicks.
• Generate powerful, on-demand reporting and analytics.
• Schedule and process recurring transactions for predictable and on-time payments.
• Securely store customer payment information.
• Keep sensitive data off merchant servers and remain out of scope with built-in PCI DSS compliance.
• Integrate with third-party apps using our powerful mobile SDK. 
• Contact us for personalized, white-glove phone or email support.
About Sola
Sola is an omnichannel payment gateway that can be seamlessly integrated with POS systems, ERP software, e-commerce, unattended retail, and mobile platforms. Offering flexible payment solutions and innovative technology to qualify transactions for the lowest interchange rates, Sola serves thousands of partners and customers across every major industry throughout the U.S., the U.K., and Canada. For more information, visit www.solapayments.com

bluejetty:00169327:ios.summary:
Public safety professionals need tools that are as mobile as they are. The Axon app was built so law enforcement officers and supervisors can securely view and manage their digital evidence and records anytime, anywhere.
The intuitive int
bluejetty:00169327:ios.description:
Public safety professionals need tools that are as mobile as they are. The Axon app was built so law enforcement officers and supervisors can securely view and manage their digital evidence and records anytime, anywhere.
The intuitive interface includes a homepage dashboard with quick links to evidence that is missing an ID or category. Officers can use the app to complete evidence workflows while in the field, increasing agency efficiency and data compliance, as well as improving officer satisfaction.
Officers can review evidence in the field after the incident, providing investigators with the ability to gain a more complete perspective on how events unfolded.
They can also use the app to initiate digital evidence collection by inviting witnesses to submit their photos and videos directly to the agency, ensuring a clean chain of custody.
Agencies using Axon Records additionally benefit from the ability to write, submit, and search records from the Axon app. Their homepage dashboard also includes pending records tasks, as well as a quick link to create a new record. 
FEATURES INCLUDE:
- Evidence management (DEMS): search, playback, manage metadata
- Records management (RMS): search, write, continue/edit, submit, review
- Axon Evidence user permissions maintained across desktop and mobile
- Homepage dashboard that highlights missing data (plus pending tasks for RMS users)
- Integration with the device’s biometric security 
- Dictation support (talk-to-text) for report writing
- Ability to request evidence from a community member 
- Secure access - all data remains in the cloud with no local storage
NOTE: Your agency must have a subscription to Axon Evidence or Axon Records to benefit from this app. Not an Axon customer? Contact us at axon.com/contact.

bluejetty:00141122:ios.summary: The Lilly Pulitzer iOS App is designed for anyone who wants to shop & experience the sunniest brand around. It’s your one-stop destination for easy shopping, first looks, gifts with purchase, stories behind our hand painted prints, and all
bluejetty:00141122:ios.description:
The Lilly Pulitzer iOS App is designed for anyone who wants to shop & experience the sunniest brand around. It’s your one-stop destination for easy shopping, first looks, gifts with purchase, stories behind our hand painted prints, and all the sunshine that only Lilly can truly bring.
WHAT’S TO LOVE
*Keep me signed in: selecting this option will keep you signed in on your device so you won't need to sign in as often.
*Join our loyalty program, Club Lilly, to enjoy exclusive benefits & earn points toward rewards when you shop. It’s free, it’s easy & everyone is invited. We can’t wait to share some sunshine with you!
*Reserve & Try in Store: You can now reserve up to 10 of your favorite items to be held to try on at your local store. This commitment-free experience is an easy way to be sure before you buy, and exclusive to the Lilly Pulitzer iOS App.
*Need it fast? Shop your local store’s inventory with our Delivery type filter and Store pick up checkout options.
*Saved For Later: Save items from your tote for purchase at another time. Easily move between your tote and Saved For Later list.
*Create multiple wishlists to organize all your favorite items. Our new layout makes it easier to add your Wishlist items to your tote. Seamlessly share your Wishlist with friends and family via the Share option.
*Keep track of when your favorite styles come back in stock with Notify Me.
*Download Lillymoji to your keyboard to share our custom artwork with all your friends.
*If you choose, we’ll send you push notifications that will MAKE. YOUR. DAY. We’ll spill a few secrets & make sure you’re the first to know when there’s something you can’t miss.
*Save your Lilly gift cards directly to your online account, and apply automatically at checkout.
*Multiple Checkout Options: Quickly checkout from your Paypal account, split transactions into 4 payments with Afterpay, or immediately get a seamless, secure, one-click checkout.
*Effortlessly manage your account within the app, and enjoy easy login via Face ID or Touch ID.
We’d love to hear from you – tell us what you think!
If you have questions or feedback, please email us at service@lillypulitzer.com
Follow us on Instagram: @lillypulitzer
Visit our website: http://www.lillypulitzer.com

The villagers from One Night Ultimate Werewolf once again find their humble home Town of Silver infested with werewolves! Compete with other mayors to have the fewest werewolves in your village. Harness each villager’s unique abilities in this fast and clever deduction card game.
FEATURES
⏺ Online Multiplayer
Connect with friends and family in private online games or with fellow gamers around the world in open online multiplayer, and compete with any number of ruthless AI opponents. The host player's purchased expansions are available to play with others in private online games.
⏺ Single Player Mode
With dynamic speed settings to suit all needs and ruthless AI adversaries, single player games provide a realistic challenge for new and experienced gamers alike.
⏺ Deck Customization
Explore and experience over 4 TRILLION possible Silver decks via downloadable digital content based on the pre-existing standalone Silver card game expansions.
⏺ Custom Decks Online 
Save and share your custom decks in online multiplayer. Race to explore and exploit hidden combos hiding in every customized deck of Silver.
⏺ Immersive Experience
Every gaming moment has been brought to life with eccentric character design, atmospheric music, and sleek 3D animations, deeply immersing you in the One Night Ultimate Werewolf universe.
⏺ Strategic Gameplay
Each of Silver’s 4 TRILLION possible decks presents fresh challenges and powerful combos, making Silver a joy to explore. Develop your winning strategy across countless combinations and character combinations.
⏺ Get More Silver!
Expand your library of cards with each in-app purchase of Silver! Each card set includes 14 new cards as well as a new Silver token to reward the winner of each round! Mix and match cards from different sets to create your own customized deck!
Silver Amulet: Master the basic strategies of Silver with this core collection of Silver cards. Comes FREE!
Silver Bullet: The best defense is a strong offense! These 14 new cards increase aggressive play, allowing players to get in each others' faces. Immediately eliminate any card from your village with the coveted Silver Bullet!
Silver Coin: Clever card play is the core behind this set of 14 cards. Pull off some rather clever card combos and rapidly take the lead from others! Cull your village with ease with cards like Curator.
Silver Dagger: Reverse the direction of play and gift the zombie horde to your opponents. This collection of 14 cards explores cards with powerful swings and effects, such as the Fury who is capable of gifting 50 points to each of your opponents! If you can pull off his request...
Silver Eye: High-Risk-High-Reward is the name of the game in this collection of cards! Use the Illusionist to score negative points! Employ the Mad Bomber and remove any card from the game during final scoring!
Silver Fang: Enter powerful characters such as Odd Maude and Even Steven who cancel effects of odd and even cards respectively! Beware the Tallyman who immediately scores all faceup cards; nobody escapes death or taxes.

Refresh your look with the styles everyone’s talking about and shop the latest men’s and women’s clothing, from hoodies, jackets, and joggers to T-shirts, tracksuits, and accessories…

bluejetty:00033488:ios.summary: Ready to find that special connection? Welcome to Duet - a new dating app featuring REAL profiles for all kinds of interests. Whether you're a gamer, fitness enthusiast, foodie, fashionista, cat person, meme expert, cinephile or a bookworm,
bluejetty:00033488:ios.description:
Ready to find that special connection? Welcome to Duet - a new dating app featuring REAL profiles for all kinds of interests. Whether you're a gamer, fitness enthusiast, foodie, fashionista, cat person, meme expert, cinephile or a bookworm, you'll find someone whose interests and passions strike a chord with you.
BREW UP CONNECTIONS, NO HASSLE
Duet’s Meet-up Assistant takes the stress out of planning—automatically suggesting coffee date times when one user shows interest in meeting up, syncing with your calendar, and sending reminders, so meeting up in real life feels easy and natural.
NO SCAMMERS WITH DUET'S VERIFIED PROFILES
Tired of endless swiping only to fall prey to scammers and catfish? Duet introduces our enforced face verification system as reliable as banking security. No more fake profiles — we love authenticity and real connections, just like you.
Plus, Duet's 24/7 moderation team is always on alert, tackling any scam reports swiftly.
DISCOVER YOUR PERFECT MATCH WITH DUET'S SMART TAG
Duet's Smart Tag digs deeper than superficial similarities, covering your interests, traits, opinions, and habits. This multifaceted self-description enhances connections and guarantees a match based on an in-depth understanding of each person.
SHARE YOUR VOICE WITH DUET'S VOICE PROMPT
Voices are full of emotion and depth — share your 30-second story, open up about yourself, and invite meaningful conversations with one another.
DISCOVER LIKE-MINDED PEOPLE IN UNIQUE WAYS
Had enough of swiping? Duet Blind Date connects you with similar individuals through engaging new features.
► Duet's Dating Quiz matches users who pick similar answers, breaking the ice and encouraging further conversation.
► Duet's Personality Test unveils your romance compatibility score and relationship strengths.
► Duet Clic randomly pairs you with someone based on your location and zodiac sign compatibility, letting fate take the wheel!
UPGRADE TO DUET PREMIUM FOR EXCLUSIVE FEATURES
► See Who Likes You: Instantly match and chat with your secret admirers.
► Unlimited Likes: Enjoy Duet without any limits on likes you send.
► Unlimited Rewind: Accidentally swiped left? Get a second chance.
Unlock more premium perks for the ultimate dating journey!
JOIN THE DUET SUPREME CLUB TO ENJOY YOUR PERSONAL FILTER
Duet Supreme includes all 9 Duet Premium privileges with extra exclusive privileges:
► Message Before Matching: You can send 3 Praises directly to people you like
► Advanced Filters: You can filter by height, education, purpose and popularity to only see your type
► Daily Picks: Duet will pick the most popular users and recommend to you everyday
Duet Premium and Supreme purchases are charged to your iTunes account and will be auto-renewed unless disabled in-app 24 hours before the current period ends.
We appreciate your feedback! Contact us at support@duetapp.net for any questions or comments.
- Terms: https://duetapp.net/terms
- Privacy: https://duetapp.net/privacy
- Website: https://duetapp.net/

bluejetty:00123552:ios.name: Peet's Coffee: Earn Rewards
bluejetty:00123552:ios.summary: Welcome to the Peet’s app – getting a cup of quality coffee and delicious food doesn’t get much easier than this. Browse our menu, customize your beverage, and have your order delivered to your door or ready for pickup in a Peet’s Coffeebar
bluejetty:00123552:ios.description:
Welcome to the Peet’s app – getting a cup of quality coffee and delicious food doesn’t get much easier than this. Browse our menu, customize your beverage, and have your order delivered to your door or ready for pickup in a Peet’s Coffeebar when you arrive.
PEETNIK REWARDS
* Members automatically earn points for mobile orders placed for pickup or delivery.
* Scan the app in-store to earn points or redeem rewards.
* Redeem points for free food, free drinks, free coffee beans, and upgrades in our Rewards Store.
* Earn points fast with bonus point offers and get special discounts.
* Enjoy early access to new items and a special menu just for members.
* Save your favorite Coffeebar location and quickly reorder saved orders.
* Look forward to a special birthday surprise and Peetnik Rewards anniversary gift.  
APP FEATURES:
ORDER AHEAD – Skip the line and place an order as a guest or log in using your Peetnik Rewards account to earn points for your order. Orders can be placed for pickup at your preferred Coffeebar or use the delivery option and we’ll do the rest!
EASY REORDERING – Your go-to order can be quickly reordered from your favorite Coffeebar.
CUSTOMIZATION – Modify your beverage to make it truly your own: choose from our variety of milks, syrups, sauces, toppings, sweetness, and temperature settings.
PAYMENT – Peetnik Rewards Members benefit from a variety of payment options, like Peet’s Card, credit and debit card, and Apple Pay. Guest orders enjoy credit and debit payment to place an order.
ORDER & ACCOUNT HISTORY – Access your Peetnik Rewards account order and transaction history easily within the app.
GIFT CARDS – Make a coffee-lover’s day by instantly sending them a gift card or scheduling it for a later date.
TIPPING – Show your barista some love with contactless tipping right in the app.
Whether you need your morning cup, a warm breakfast sandwich, or your favorite coffee beans – the Peet’s app has you covered all day, every day.
Start your morning off right with Peet’s Coffee.

bluejetty:00021212:ios.summary:
Pick up the ukulele and play your first real song. Ukulele Lessons walks complete beginners from their first chords to full ukulele songs, through short video lessons and guided courses.
WHAT'S INSIDE
Guided Courses
Follow step-by-step co
bluejetty:00021212:ios.description:
Pick up the ukulele and play your first real song. Ukulele Lessons walks complete beginners from their first chords to full ukulele songs, through short video lessons and guided courses.
WHAT'S INSIDE
Guided Courses
Follow step-by-step courses that teach ukulele chords and playing techniques in order. Each lesson builds on the last, from hand position and your first chords to the strumming patterns that turn up in most songs. No music theory required. Chord lessons, songs and videos are delivered online and updated regularly, so an internet connection is required.
Video Lessons by Category
Browse ukulele videos sorted by technique, song type and skill level, from strumming to fingerpicking. Pick what you want to learn next and replay any lesson as often as you need.
Built-in Ukulele Tuner
Tune your ukulele inside the app before you play. No separate tuner app needed.
What's New
Catch the latest and trending lessons in the What's New section, so there is always something fresh to practice.
Favourites
Save the lessons you keep coming back to and find them again in seconds.
Reading Room
Read ukulele tips, tutorials and beginner guides between practice sessions.
Lessons, videos and articles are streamed from our servers, so the library can grow without an app update and an internet connection is needed.
WHY IT WORKS FOR BEGINNERS
Plain language and clear video. We skip the lecture-hall theory and show you the chord shape, the strum and the song. If you can hold a ukulele, you can play it.
The ukulele is a forgiving first instrument, and easier to start on than a guitar: four nylon strings, easy on the fingers, and small enough to take anywhere. Take it to the beach, on a trip, or to the couch after work.
Open the app, tune up, and play your first song today.

bluejetty:00123311:ios.description:
Developed by Alegeus, the WealthCare SMART App provides a single access point for members to manage their HSAs and other tax-favored benefit accounts.
Managing your benefit account(s) on-the-go is made easy with the Smart Account app. This powerful, intuitive mobile app gives you access to view your account balances, update your profile, submit a claim, and much more, right from your mobile device. Smart Account provides a personalized experience and delivers meaningful insights to better guide your healthcare spending. The app also offers recommendations for savings on healthcare items such as prescription medications. 
The WealthCare SMART App provides industry-leading functionality, including:
• Account balances and details
• Recent transactions
• Long-term healthcare savings guidance based on your unique health conditions and needs
• Virtual medicine cabinet which allows you to find nearby pharmacies that sell your prescription and OTC medications at a reduced price
• Ability to fund your HSA from checking/savings account
• View all email alerts
• Contact administrator from mobile app via email or mobile phone
• Same username/password as WealthCare Portal (no need to register your mobile device; just download, login, and go!)
• Stronger authentication support (Picture/Passphrase, device identification and challenge questions)
• View Demographic Details
• View Dependents
• View Card Details
• View Card PIN
• Fund HSA from registered external bank accounts
• Register new users directly from a mobile device

bluejetty:00142621:ios.description:
Trying to recover your lost or deleted photos? PicRestore gives you easy access to recover any important photos or videos that you might have lost or deleted.
◆ How to use the PicRestore App ◆ 
● Recover deleted photos and videos in a single tap
● PicRestore allows you to filter through your entire camera roll to locate and recover the photos and videos that you've previously lost or deleted
—————————————————————————————————
PicRestore subscription policy:
Once you sign up to PicRestore Premium, you will have full access to all of PicRestore's features for free for 3 days.
You can cancel your subscription any time and you will be sent a reminder before your PicRestore subscription begins after your trial.
PicRestore Premium Subscription:
- With a PicRestore Premium subscription you have access to recover your lost photos, delete duplicate photos and contacts, find and remove large photos and videos, and store private photos and videos in the private vault section.
- PicRestore Premium weekly subscription is billed weekly for $3.99, and payment will be charged to iTunes Account.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user's iPhone Settings -> Apple ID -> Subscriptions.
—————————————————————————————————

Have any questions or recommendations? Feel free to reach out to me at:
Kyle@KyleMitchellAllen.com

bluejetty:00144801:ios.description:
Get your first Cash Loan or Virtual Mastercard on Mocasa – Hassle-free! Instant approval with transparent pricing.
Mocasa Quick Loan Highlights:
· Loan amount: ₱1,000.00 - ₱50,000.00
· Loan term: 91 days - 365 days
· Maximum APR: 36%
· Convenience Fee: up to ₱20 per transaction (varies by payment channel)
· Applicable Tax (DST & GRT): N/A
REPRESENTATIVE EXAMPLE OF THE TOTAL COST OF A LOAN:
91-day loan with principal amount of ₱10,000
· Interest (2.867% per month × 3): ₱860
· Service Fee (0.4% of principal): ₱40
· Total cost retained by Mocasa: ₱900
· Total Repayment: ₱10,900
· Monthly Repayment: ₱10,900 ÷ 3 = ₱3,633.33
· Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 36.00%
Note: Convenience fees charged by third-party payment gateway providers are disclosed separately and are not included in the APR.
Mocasa Virtual Mastercard Features:
· Interest-Free Period: Enjoy up to 50 days of interest-free credit, just like a standard credit card.
· Shop Anywhere: Add it as a payment method to any app or website that accepts Mastercard.
· Scan to pay: Pay via QRPh code at stores nationwide.
· Bill Payments: Pay utility bills or buy load/data directly within the Mocasa app.
PRIVACY & PERMISSIONS
Your privacy is our priority. We will never disclose your personal information to anyone without your permission or sell your data to third parties.
Before you avail of any loan, we will provide a Disclosure Statement in compliance with the Truth in Lending Act to ensure full transparency—no surprises.
WHO CAN APPLY?
· 21+ years old
· Filipino citizen
· Have 1 government-issued ID
· Have a stable income
HOW TO APPLY?
· Register: Create an account with an active mobile number.
· Apply: Fill out the simple Online Loan Forms.
· Review: Get evaluated in as fast as 5 minutes.
· Cash Out: Money will be disbursed to your preferred account immediately upon approval.
WHY CHOOSE MOCASA?
· High Limit: Get approved for up to ₱50,000.
· Easy Access: 100% online process with no collateral required.
· Transparent Pricing: All fees and costs are clearly disclosed before you confirm your loan.
· Fast Disbursement: Transfer cash instantly to your GCash, Maya, Lazada wallet, or bank account.
WHO WE ARE
· Corporate Name: Philippines Cashtrout Lending Corporation
· Business Name: Mocasa
· PSEC Registration Number: CS201910407
· Certificate of Authority (CA): 3015
· Office Address: 4/F Kings Court 1 Building, 2129 Chino Roces Ave., Pio del Pilar, Makati City, Metro Manila, Philippines
CONTACT US
We value your feedback! If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us:
· Email: support.user@mocasa.com
· Office Hours: 08:00 AM - 20:00 PM, Monday to Sunday
· Website: www.mocasa.com

bluejetty:00019495:ios.description:
Short Summary:
≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈
In a world of fantasy, called Terra Mystica, 14 races are fighting together or individually against their opponents to gain power and territory. Using their resources smartly and terraforming wisely to gain supremacy and lead their own settlers to victory. The original digital conversion of the highly decorated Terra Mystica board game of Helge Ostertag and Jens Drögemüller. Play against other players world wide or challenge the computer opponent.
Overview:
≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈
Terra Mystica is a strategy game with a simple game principle and very little luck involved: You govern one of 14 factions trying to transform the Landscape on the game board in your favor in order to build your Structures. On the one hand, proximity to other players limits your options for further expansion, on the other hand though, it provides some benefits during the game. This conflict is the source of Terra Mystica's appeal.
Structures may be upgraded to provide even more resources, like Workers, Pries
The 14 artfully designed factions, each having unique special abilities, as well as the exchangeable bonus cards allow for a large number of possible game plays that constantly keep this game entertaining!
Features of Terra Mystica:
≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈≈
- easy to learn: the interactive Tutorial helps to get a start in this deep strategy game
- hard to master: Enormous depth and interesting decisions without being too complex to understand. The best strategy always wins!
- replayability: always changing and challenging game experience with new combinations. You want to try all fantasy races! An ideal game for hardcore gamers!
- challenging developments: only strategy and tactics count - not luck!
- game replays: Analyse your best games or learn tricks from the pro settlers
- multiplayer: Challenge the best players across all platforms world wide or play against your family and friends
- three computer difficulties: Try to beat the computer opponent
- newest update: This game uses the newest rules edition of the board game
Awards:
≈≈≈≈≈≈
Terra Mystica has won many awards as a board game, such as:
- Deutscher Spielepreis (German Games Award)
- Spiel des Jahres (Empfehlung) (Game of the Year - Recommended)
- Golden Geek Game Award
- Nederlandse Spellenpreijs
- International Gamers Awards

bluejetty:00148083:ios.description:
Con Inkafarma Móvil ya no tendrás que ir a la farmacia o botica para comprar tus medicamentos o productos para el cuidado personal, tenemos delivery disponible en varios puntos de Lima*.
Realiza tu pedido en el app, elige pagar con efectivo o tarjeta**, sigue tu pedido en tiempo real, y recibe tu compra en tu casa, oficina o donde estés. Nosotros te avisaremos cuando el motorizado esté cerca.
Consigue los mejores precios en medicamentos, proteínas, vitaminas, productos de belleza, aseo y cuidado personal. Accede a promociones exclusivas que solo encontrarás en el app.
Términos y Condiciones
Horario de atención:
Recibimos pedidos a través de Inkafarma Móvil de Lunes a Domingo, 24 horas al día. Los pedidos recibidos entre las 08 horas (8 a.m.) y 22 horas (10 p.m.) de Lunes a Domingo, serán atendidos el mismo día. Los pedidos recibidos a partir de las 22 horas serán atendidos al día siguiente desde las 08 horas previa coordinación telefónica con el cliente. El horario de entrega puede cambiar sin previo aviso por disponibilidad de personal motorizado o por eventos en la zona de entrega.

San Borja 
Miraflores 
Barranco 
Breña 
Jesús María 
La Victoria 
Lince 
Magdalena del Mar 
Pueblo libre 
San Miguel 
Surco 
Surquillo 
Así mismo, estará disponible parcialmente a modo de prueba en los demás distritos de la ciudad de Lima. La cobertura puede cambiar sin previo aviso por disponibilidad de personal motorizado o por eventos en la zona de entrega.
** Pagos:
El pago se debe realizar al recibir el pedido en la dirección solicitada. Aceptamos efectivo (sólo en Soles) y tarjetas de débito o crédito Visa, MasterCard y American Express.

bluejetty:00168536:ios.description:
Ready to get your mind in a twist? Wood Screw Sorting Puzzle lets you unscrew your way to victory in a brain teasing puzzle of bolts and nuts. It's a puzzle playground where strategy mechanisms meet satisfying solutions, and every tangled mess begs to be unraveled.
Think you're a puzzle pro? Think again! This ain't your grandma's jigsaw puzzle. But Wood Screw Sorting Puzzle is more than just about unscrewing nuts and bolts. Each level unveils a unique wood metal maze, a twisted puzzle begging to be unscrewed. No two puzzles are alike, and the challenge scales alongside your skills. From beginner-friendly knots to expert-level tangles, Wood Screw Sorting Puzzle will keep your brain buzzing like a hive of happy hornets.
Here's what awaits you in Wood Screw Sorting Puzzle:
Hundreds of handcrafted levels: From beginner-friendly twists to mind-melting knots, Wood Screw Sorting Puzzle offers a never-ending challenge for puzzle enthusiasts of all skill levels.
Strategic sorting gameplay: Think ahead, plan your moves, and master the art of unscrewing in the perfect order. Each nut and bolt placement matters!
Satisfyingly smooth mechanics: Enjoy intuitive controls and realistic physics as you manipulate the screws and nuts with ease.
Relaxing ASMR experience: Immerse yourself in the soothing sounds of metal clinking and gears turning as you solve each puzzle.
Compete with friends: See who can conquer the puzzles faster and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate Wood Screw Sorting champion!
So, are you ready to unscrew the fun? Download Wood Screw Sorting Puzzle today and let the puzzling begin!

bluejetty:00076300:ios.name: Pure Piano - Grand Piano App
bluejetty:00076300:ios.summary:
Pure Piano is a professional, multi-sampled concert grand piano with a unique Morph Pad that allows you to explore a multitude of sounds ranging from mellow and intimate tones to surreal, cinematic textures. 
Similar to an XY pad in its fl
bluejetty:00076300:ios.description:
Pure Piano is a professional, multi-sampled concert grand piano with a unique Morph Pad that allows you to explore a multitude of sounds ranging from mellow and intimate tones to surreal, cinematic textures. 
Similar to an XY pad in its flat, tactile nature, the Morph Pad offers up nine different core timbres of the piano including percussive, cinematic, bright, and intimate, to name a few. The “pure” piano sits untouched at the heart and center of the space, surrounded by eight more presets for you to explore as you guide your finger seamlessly through the wide-ranging tonal palette of the piano. As you do so, the various timbres blend together allowing you to create your own sounds comprising combinations of neighboring presets for you to save and recall. It doesn’t stop there either. The Morph Pad is linked to the app’s inbuilt EQ, reverb, and delay and so operates as a macro control adding even more to the experience by way of ever-changing texture and atmosphere, all from just one single piano. 
Pure Piano works as a standalone app or as an AUv3 plug-in within your DAW of choice, and extensive connectivity options allow you to connect to your keyboard controller with ease via USB, direct, or Bluetooth MIDI to experience the sound of a professional grand piano through your headphones or speakers. The app also supports direct connection to your Mac using Inter Device Audio (IDAM). This enables you to easily integrate Pure Piano into your desktop projects by sending MIDI and receiving audio with one single cable, as well as network MIDI and Inter-App Audio for triggering the piano from other apps that you might have installed. 
Equipped with customizable reverb, EQ, and delay, sound creation becomes even more creative. Simply unlink any of the audio effects from the Morph Pad to dial in your own settings. Maybe you want to add a long reverb tail to add some extra atmosphere, tweak the EQ a little or add some delay to a particular sound. It’s up to you. 
If all that isn’t enough, the app includes sympathetic resonance which you can adjust along with the pedal and key noise to taste, and there’s a host of flexible tuning options for when you need them. The stretched piano tuning is how a piano technician would tune the piano. The equal temperament tuning, on the other hand, is best for when layering Pure Piano with sounds like electric pianos, pads, or strings. Also provided is the ability to transpose the piano which comes in very useful if you are working with a vocalist who wants to sing in a different key!
Pure Piano is designed and developed by Hamburg-based e-instruments, renowned for their high-end digital recreations of acoustic instruments. 
Feature Overview: 
• Interactive Morph Pad - Explore the many timbres of a concert grand
• Nine different sounds - Navigate and blend between nine core sounds
• Studio Quality Audio at Ultra-low Latency
• Extensive Connectivity - Connect via USB, direct, or Bluetooth MIDI. Inter Device Audio (IDAM), Network MIDI, and Inter-App Audio also fully supported
• Standalone and AUv3 plug-in compatible - Plug and play or use within your favourite music production software
• Zynaptiq QREV Reverb - Have fun adding extra atmosphere and depth to your sound
• 3-Band EQ and Delay - Get creative with customizable EQ and Delay, or use the Morph Pad as a macro control
• Save and Load Your Own Presets - Wherever you land on the Morph Pad, if you like the sound you hear – save it and recall it again later
• Sympathetic Resonance - Delivers a fuller sound and more natural, realistic piano-playing experience by adding resonances between harmonically-related notes. 
• Silent Key Press - Just like on a real-life piano pressing a key very softly will not produce a sound.
• Flexible Tuning Options - Choose between equal or stretched tuning, and transpose the piano by semitones or Hz
• Customizable velocity curve 
• 24-bit, 44.1 kHz
• 1.1GB installation

bluejetty:00165971:ios.description:
Track Your Steps, Distance, and Workouts — Right from Your iPhone or Watch.
Step It Up helps you stay active and motivated by tracking your steps, distance walked or run, flights of stairs climbed, workouts, active calories burned, and more. Built for iPhone and Apple Watch, it's a sleek and privacy-first way to stay on top of your daily movement.
That big orange ring on your Home screen isn't just decoration — it's your whole day. Steps, miles, floors, and how close you are to today's goal, updated in real time. Hit it, and Step It Up tells you so.
Step It Up also checks the weather so you don't have to. It'll nudge you toward the best window to get outside, and tell you why — so you're never guessing whether it's worth lacing up.
Step It Up isn't just about daily numbers — it's about progress over time. With built-in trends and insights, you can see your weekly average, how many days you hit your goal, and whether you're trending up or down over the last month, so you can build habits that actually stick.
Running, cycling, walking — Step It Up records your workouts properly: pace, heart rate, calories, and distance live, with a clean history you can view as a list or on a map.
Not sure what your step goal is or how this week compares to last? Just ask. Step It Up's built-in AI answers in plain language, right where you're already looking.
Features:
• View your daily steps, distance, flights climbed, and steps from the past hour.
• Get a weather-smart nudge for the best time to walk.
• Set a daily step goal and track your weekly exercise minutes.
• Adaptive Step Goal that changes based on your activity, so you're always ready for a challenge or to take a break.
• Record workouts — running, cycling, and walking — with live pace, heart rate, and calories.
• Explore Insights and Trends to see how your fitness has changed over time.
• Check your full History to review previous days' data.
• Ask Step It Up's about your stats, goals, and more with built-in support for Apple Intelligence.
• Built-in coach powered by Apple Intelligence to give you motivation as you go through your day.
• Add Home Screen Widgets in a variety of sizes to quickly glance at your activity.
• Syncs with Apple Watch, including support for Watch face complications so your data is always at a glance away.
• Integration with Apple Weather so you always know when the weather is best to beat your goal.
• Integration with Apple Music so you can have your playlist ready for your next workout.
• Workout tracker with your step goal always visible so you can see how far you are from your goals.

Track Your Steps, Distance, and Workouts — Right from Your iPhone or Watch.

Step It Up helps you stay active and motivated by tracking your steps, distance walked or run, flights of stairs climbed, workouts, active calories burned, and more. Built for iPhone and Apple Watch, it's a sleek and privacy-first way to stay on top of your daily movement.

That big orange ring on your Home screen isn't just decoration — it's your whole day. Steps, miles, floors, and how close you are to today's goal, updated in real time. Hit it, and Step It Up tells you so.

Step It Up also checks the weather so you don't have to. It'll nudge you toward the best window to get outside, and tell you why — so you're never guessing whether it's worth lacing up.

Step It Up isn't just about daily numbers — it's about progress over time. With built-in trends and insights, you can see your weekly average, how many days you hit your goal, and whether you're trending up or down over the last month, so you can build habits that actually stick.

Running, cycling, walking — Step It Up records your workouts properly: pace, heart rate, calories, and distance live, with a clean history you can view as a list or on a map.

Not sure what your step goal is or how this week compares to last? Just ask. Step It Up's built-in AI answers in plain language, right where you're already looking.

Features:

• View your daily steps, distance, flights climbed, and steps from the past hour.
• Get a weather-smart nudge for the best time to walk.
• Set a daily step goal and track your weekly exercise minutes.

• Explore Insights and Trends to see how your fitness has changed over time.

• Add Home Screen Widgets in a variety of sizes to quickly glance at your activity.
• Syncs with Apple Watch, including support for Watch face complications so your data is always at a glance away.
• Integration with Apple Weather so you always know when the weather is best to beat your goal.
• Integration with Apple Music so you can have your playlist ready for your next workout.
• Workout tracker with your step goal always visible so you can see how far you are from your goals.
• Ability to upload your workouts to Strava.

Step It Up is yours for good — one price, no subscription. Buy it once and get every feature, every update.

bluejetty:00026903:ios.description:
We're working to make the place we call home, better. As the largest newsroom in Arizona, and a Pulitzer Prize winner, we have an obligation to our community, to tell all the stories that need to be told. 
Whether it’s economic news, sports news or one of the many other subjects we cover, we believe that local journalism is valuable – it has the power to keep Phoenicians connected, to hold leaders accountable, to unite our city in celebration and spur us towards common goals. 
We’re Phoenix’s trusted storytellers. We’re here for it. 
WHAT WE’RE ALL ABOUT: 
• Investigative reporting that holds people, companies, politicians and the government accountable in Arizona. 
• In-depth coverage of the Valley’s real estate market 
• Sports coverage for locals, by locals: the Sun Devils, Suns, Cardinals, Diamondbacks and Arizona High Schools 
• Arizona’s election coverage, including the 2024 Presidential Election and local races for the U.S. Senate and House.
• Voices, experts and personalities on the left and right side of politics 
APP FEATURES: 
• Real-time breaking news alerts 
• A personalized feed on the all-new For You page 
• The eNewspaper, a digital replica of our print newspaper + USA TODAY and 200+ local eNewspapers. 
Subscription Information:
• The AZ Central app is free to download and all users can access a sampling of free articles every month. 
• Subscriptions are charged to your account at confirmation of purchase and automatically renew each month or year, unless turned off in your account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. See "Subscription Support" in the app's Settings for more details and customer service contact information.  
MORE INFORMATION:
• Privacy Policy: https://static.azcentral.com/privacy/
• Terms of Service: https://static.azcentral.com/terms/ 
• Help Center: https://help.azcentral.com

bluejetty:00014222:ios.description:
Life is full of lane changes. Some expected. Some not as much. No problem, because the GEICO Mobile app is here to lend a hand if you ever need a quote, policy update, tow, or you just need to change your address. Now, when life changes lanes we’ll be right there because we’re always headed in your direction.
Not to toot our own horn but we’re the #1 Insurance Mobile App. Find out why below.
FEATURES
DIGITAL ID CARDS
The days of rummaging through your wallet, past expired gym memberships and old receipts to find your insurance ID cards are over. Now they’re always easy to access right on your phone. Access them from the app or add them to your Apple Wallet. 
BILLING - MAKE A PAYMENT 
Now you don’t have to slow your roll to pay or manage your bill. The GEICO Mobile app makes paying on the go easy with numerous payment method options such as Apple Pay as well as flexible payment amounts that fit your needs. 
ROADSIDE ASSISTANCE
No one likes being stranded in the middle of nowhere – or even in the middle of somewhere. The GEICO Mobile app lets you tap for a tow anyplace, anytime.
SUBMIT AND MANAGE YOUR CLAIM
Let’s be real - claims aren’t fun. A fender bender, crash or broken windshield can all be nerve-racking. That's why GEICO Mobile makes it easy to file and manage a claim.
YOUR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT
Ever wish you had a teeny tiny person in your pocket that you could ask questions about your policy, billing or more? Us too. So just ask GEICO’s Virtual Assistant.
VEHICLE CARE
Vehicles need tender loving care too. That’s why we make it so easy to get your car serviced, find out about recall alerts, and even get maintenance reminders. It’s like a hug for your car.

Master a New Language Effortlessly and Speak Confidently with AI Tutor!
Are you looking for a teacher to help you learn a new language and achieve fluency? Look no further than Hablo—your ultimate partner for confident communication while enjoying the learning process! With our intelligent app, learning a language is not only efficient but also incredibly engaging.
Key Features:
- AI Tutor: Overcome the anxiety of speaking with real teachers! Hablo's AI tutor creates a relaxed environment to boost your confidence and practice without pressure.
- Personalized Guidance: Hablo's AI tutor identifies your specific weaknesses and provides customized instruction, ensuring effective progress toward your language goals.
- Learn What You Love: Stay motivated by focusing on topics that interest you. Hablo prioritizes your preferences for a relevant learning experience.
- Flexible Learning Schedule: Spend just 5 minutes a day with Hablo, and watch your skills grow from beginner to advanced at your own pace.
- Unlimited Conversation Opportunities: No chance to practice speaking? Hablo allows you to interact with the AI tutor as if you were having a real conversation with a native speaker, enhancing your speaking skills and ensuring that language learning is integrated into your daily life.
What We Offer?
- Contextual Learning: Vocabulary and grammar are woven into conversations for practical understanding.
- Accent Correction: Improve your pronunciation with feedback from our AI tutor.
- Visual Vocabulary: Boost your memory with images that clarify meanings.
- Role-Playing: Engage in realistic conversations tailored to various scenarios for better communication skills.
Why Choose Hablo?
From beginners to language enthusiasts, we cater to all, ensuring your learning journey is exciting, personalized, and absolutely rewarding.
Download Hablo now and embark on your language learning adventure with ease!

Solve one new logic puzzle every day to keep your streak alive. Cut ropes and pop balloons to feed cute green monster Om Nom, who's craving a candy fix!

ONLY ONE LEVEL A DAY 
• Join the worldwide puzzle challenge and take on the same level as everyone else — every day! 
• Puzzle it out on a subway ride, a lunch break, or whenever you have that sweet time to chill.
EASY TO BEAT, HARD TO EXCEL 
• Getting the candy into Om Nom's tummy is one thing, but can you collect all 10 stars, too?
NEW MONTH, NEW SITE
• Let the game take you to a new place each month, complete with a cute, special costume to fit the mood! Feelin' beach vibes? Time for a surfer look!
SHARE YOUR SWEET SUCCESS WITH FRIENDS
• Everyone and their cat are playing the same level, so why not show off your smarts? Share your results on social media to get the conversation going! 
KEEP THE STREAK ALIVE
• Once you start, you won't want to stop. No other commitment is as easy and fun to keep! So jump in right now for your daily dose of entertainment from cute monster Om Nom and Netflix!

Hyper is the ultimate app for avatar creators.

bluejetty:00169563:ios.description:
HabitPal is a habit tracker that helps you build good habits, break bad ones and stick to your daily routine. Whether you want to get healthier, be more productive or stay more active, HabitPal makes your progress clear and keeps you motivated every day.
KEY FEATURES
• Good and bad habits
Build the habits you want and cut back on the ones you don't, all in one place.
• Flexible tracking
Track a count (glasses of water, pages, steps), time with the built-in timer, or check off a habit with a single tap.
• Morning, afternoon and evening routines
Group your habits by time of day so you always know what's next.
• Streaks and accountability
Keep your streak alive with flames that change color the longer it grows, and stay inspired with daily quotes.
• Stats and yearly heatmap
Follow your progress day by day in the calendar and see your whole year in one heatmap.
• Smart reminders
Get reminded at the right time so you never miss a habit.
• Apple Health integration
Steps, workouts and more are logged automatically from the Health app.
• Home Screen widgets
See and track your habits right from your Home Screen without opening the app.
• Apple Watch
Pick a day, see your morning, afternoon and evening habits, and track them with a tap on your wrist. Includes complications for your watch face.
• iCloud sync
Your data syncs automatically across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch, in real time between iPhone and Apple Watch.
• Journal
Write down your thoughts and reflections for each day.
• Shortcuts and Siri
Track habits with your voice or with Shortcuts.
Start today, one small habit at a time, and let HabitPal help you become the best version of yourself.
For more information, visit https://habitpal.app/

bluejetty:00199976:ios.description:

Welcome to Arvella Fragrance, your destination for discounted luxury fragrances. Shop authentic designer and niche scents at better prices, discover new favorites, and enjoy a smooth, mobile-first shopping experience.
If you’re looking for real deals on premium fragrances, you’re in the right place. Arvella focuses on making luxury fragrance more accessible—so you can build your collection and find your signature scent without overpaying.
Discounted Fragrances First
Arvella is built around one goal: helping you shop luxury fragrances for less. Browse a curated selection of discounted scents and limited-time offers on popular designer and niche fragrances. Whether you’re replenishing a favorite or hunting for your next obsession, you’ll find premium options with pricing that makes sense.
Shop Authentic Designer & Niche Scents
We take authenticity seriously. Shop with confidence while exploring a wide range of scent styles—from fresh and clean to sweet, spicy, woody, and bold statement fragrances. New to fragrance? The app makes it easy to browse and discover. Already a collector? You’ll love having discounted options and restocks right at your fingertips.
Travel Sizes & Samples (Try More Without Committing)
In addition to discounted fragrances, Arvella offers Travel Sizes & Samples so you can explore more scents before committing to a full bottle. These smaller sizes are perfect for:
Testing a fragrance over multiple wears
Travel, carry-on, gym bags, and everyday carry
Rotating multiple scents without overspending
Gifting and sharing with other fragrance lovers
App Highlights
Shop discounted luxury fragrances anytime
Discover new deals, restocks, and limited drops
Browse quickly with a clean, premium shopping experience
Save favorites and revisit them anytime
Simple checkout designed for mobile shoppers
Stay updated with push notifications for promos and new arrivals
Built for Collectors, Beginners, and Deal Hunters
If you’re new to fragrance, Arvella helps you discover what you like with Travel Sizes & Samples. If you’re a collector, the app makes it easy to grab discounted fragrances and keep your rotation fresh. If you’re a deal hunter, you’ll appreciate the focus on value without sacrificing authenticity.
Download Arvella Fragrance today and start shopping discounted luxury fragrances—with Travel Sizes & Samples available when you want to try something new.

bluejetty:00038913:ios.name: Ramblr
bluejetty:00038913:ios.summary:
Ramblr – Your adventure. Your story.
Your outdoor adventures deserve more than a simple blog entry or status update. This is you overcoming the impossible, white knuckled and covered in dirt, and doing things you only dreamed of doing. Wh
bluejetty:00038913:ios.description:
Ramblr – Your adventure. Your story.
Your outdoor adventures deserve more than a simple blog entry or status update. This is you overcoming the impossible, white knuckled and covered in dirt, and doing things you only dreamed of doing. When you’re experiencing the best that Mother Nature has to offer, ramblr provides a way to chronicle your expeditions using stats, pics, videos, descriptions and maps. Whether you’re hiking, biking, skiing, kayaking, or road tripping, you can finally tell your story the way it was meant to be told.
Capture the highlights of your trip
• Track your route on the map – see where you’ve been and where you’re going.
• Revel in the glory of your accomplishments – check out statistics for your trip, such as speed, duration, distance, highest point, etc. 
• Record video, pics, audio and text descriptions and tag it to points on your map. Relive the full experience of your trip. 
• Create a story – use your video and audio recordings, statistics and map tracking to build a rich, detailed record of your journey. 
Share your story
• Upload and share memories from your adventures without any hassle. Whether you’re climbing mountains, surviving white water rapids, or generally conquering the world, sharing the details of your trip can be the farthest thing from your mind. Facebook and Twitter integration make it easy and effortless to update your friends on where you are on your journey.
Find your way
• Use the built-in GPS system for directions and routes.
• Download maps and use them on the go. Offline maps supported, so you can access them when you’re off the grid.
• Download public trips from our server for real-time guidance on your own journey.
Keep track of your daily steps
• Use the Apple Health app to record daily steps for its pedometer feature.
• Please allow to read 'steps' from the Health app to enable this feature.
Experience other stories
• Don’t know what adventure to embark on? Browse and access trips taken by your friends and others.
• Search for trips by video and audio recordings, map locations, keywords or by name.
Realtime Tracking Service Subscription
•Allow your friends and/or family track your location in near real-time (in pre-selected time interval) with maps.
• Ramblr is free but the Realtime Traking Service feature needs subscription.
• You can subscribe the Monthly Plan ($2.49) or the Yearly Plan ($24.99) to take the advantage of even more premium functions. (The actual price may differ depending on currency of each countries.)
• Recurring payments and plan subscriptions are automatically processed. Your subscription will automatically renew.
• Price may vary by location, Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. Manage your subscription in Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy : https://www.ramblr.com/web/info/privacy_policy
Terms of Service : https://www.ramblr.com/web/info/terms_of_service
“Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.”

bluejetty:00064201:ios.name: Syobon Action HD
bluejetty:00064201:ios.summary:
This is the most difficult action game in the world. It is full of infinite challenge and traps, made for only the most experienced gamers. If you think you have what it takes give it a try. But please don't break your phone. ^_^
Gameplay
bluejetty:00064201:ios.description:
This is the most difficult action game in the world. It is full of infinite challenge and traps, made for only the most experienced gamers. If you think you have what it takes give it a try. But please don't break your phone. ^_^
Gameplay Description
-----------------------------------
You control a little cat inspired my a popular Japanese emoji. You task is to save the world from the troll chicken who was turned the world's inhabitants evil. There are a lot of traps placed in places you wouldn't expect. You will fail a lot, but finally clearing a level feels so good.
The gameplay is in the style of old platformers, but a lot more coordination is required and the jumps need to be perfectly timed. If you played other rage games you should be just fine.
Syobon Action (known as "Cat Mario" or "Neko Mario") is a Jump 'n' Run Game parody. The traps are different from what you would expect from a jump and run game. Skill and a bit of imagination are needed and nerves of steel because it can be frustrating at times (which makes the game so addicting).
Syobon Action was created by a Japanese developer named ちく (Chiku) over the course of three days in February of 2007. The game was inspired by a flash game titled The Big Adventure of a Dead End Life (人生ｵﾜﾀ＼(^o^)／の大冒険 Jinsei Owata no Daibōken?),which was often played by members on the text board 2chan.
Cat MeOUCHio is a modern remake of the classic game for mobile devices so that it can be played for many more years by the fans.

bluejetty:00156943:ios.summary: With Vervecare, Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) is a breeze. Our user-friendly interface and intuitive workflows make it easy for caregivers to clock in and out of visits while giving coordinators real-time access to visit data and ensu
bluejetty:00156943:ios.description:
With Vervecare, Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) is a breeze. Our user-friendly interface and intuitive workflows make it easy for caregivers to clock in and out of visits while giving coordinators real-time access to visit data and ensuring compliance. Say goodbye to complicated and time-consuming EVV processes and hello to increased efficiency with Vervecare.
Key Features:
1. Electronic Visit Verification (EVV): Our app simplifies the visit verification process, eliminating paperwork and ensuring accurate documentation. Caregivers can easily verify visits with a signature or a voice recording, promoting transparency and accountability.
2. Client and Care Team Management: Vervecare enables caregivers to access essential client information, including care plans, preferences, and medical history. Stay informed and provide personalized care by having a comprehensive view of each client's needs.
3. Completed Hours and Visits: Keep track of completed hours and visits directly from the app. Caregivers can easily log their activities, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records for billing and reporting purposes.
4. Task Management: Caregivers can efficiently manage their tasks through the app. From medication reminders to daily routines, caregivers can create and track tasks, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and providing seamless care continuity.
5. Signature and Voice Verification: Clients have the option to verify visits using their digital signature or a voice recording. This adds an extra layer of confirmation and enhances the trust and transparency between clients and caregivers.
6. We Speak Your Language: We know that in the Homecare industry, language barriers can be a real challenge for both caregivers and clients. That's why our platform includes built-in translation features, so you can communicate more effectively with clients and caregivers who speak different languages.
7. Data Security and Privacy: Vervecare takes data security seriously. Our app is designed with robust security measures and is compliant with industry standards, ensuring client information remains confidential and protected.
Why Choose Vervecare?
Vervecare's Mobile App is more than just a tool – it's a game-changer in the Homecare industry. By combining EVV with advanced features such as task management, real-time communication, and personalized care plans, we empower caregivers to provide top-notch care while enhancing the overall care experience.
Join the Vervecare community and experience the power of our Mobile App. Simplify visit verification, enhance caregiver-client communication, and deliver personalized care that makes a difference.

bluejetty:00161527:ios.developer: SAYATGYI U BA KHIN MEMORIAL TRUST OF MASSACHUSSETS, INC
bluejetty:00161527:ios.summary:
This is the official DhammaOrg iOS mobile App for Vipassana Meditation as taught by S.N. Goenka in the tradition of Sayagyi U Ba Khin.
Vipassana Meditation
Vipassana, which means to see things as they really are, is one of India's most anc
bluejetty:00161527:ios.description:
This is the official DhammaOrg iOS mobile App for Vipassana Meditation as taught by S.N. Goenka in the tradition of Sayagyi U Ba Khin.
Vipassana Meditation
Vipassana, which means to see things as they really are, is one of India's most ancient techniques of meditation. It was taught in India more than 2500 years ago as a universal remedy for universal ills, an Art of Living. Vipassana is the process of self-purification by self-observation. One begins by observing the natural breath to concentrate the mind. Then, with a sharpened awareness, one proceeds to observe the changing nature of body and mind and experiences the universal truths of impermanence, suffering and egolessness. This truth-realization by direct experience results in mental purification.
Courses
The technique of Vipassana Meditation is taught at 10-day residential courses during which participants learn the basics of the method, and practice sufficiently to experience its beneficial results. There are no charges for the courses - not even to cover the cost of food and accommodation. All expenses are met by donations from people who, having completed a course and experienced the benefits of Vipassana, wish to give others the opportunity to also benefit.
Locations
Courses are given in numerous Meditation Centers and at Non-Center course locations. Each location has its own schedule of courses. In most cases, an application for admission to these courses can be completed online using this App. There are numerous Centers currently in operation and more in development around the world, including Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, and Oceania.
Features of this App
- Learn more about Vipassana Meditation.
- Find locations near you that offer Vipassana Meditation courses from a complete worldwide listing or map of over 300 locations spread across 80+ countries.
- Locate Vipassana Meditation courses using search criteria such as dates, regions, and instruction languages.
- Apply and register to attend a Vipassana Meditation course.
- Download or listen online to audio resources in different languages, including 10-Day Discourses and instructions for Mini- Ānāpāna meditation.
- Stream videos in different languages, including 10-Day Discourses, Talks, Interviews, and Q&As by S.N. Goenka, Documentaries about Vipassana for adults and children, Vipassana for business executives and Vipassana in prisons, and a Mini-Ānāpāna Introduction and Practice.
- Support for creating and maintaining individual user account
- Pre-fill course application forms with profile information from user account
- Sync user account with updated information provided on application forms
Old Students
- One hour group sitting recordings in 25+ different languages.
- Play group sitting recordings with an option to log your daily sittings. All logged data is only stored locally on your device.
- Turn on group sitting counter to join and see how many Old Students are currently meditating.
- Find information about group sittings and other events hosted near you or hosted online.
- Additional audio resources, including discourses for Mahāsatipaṭṭhāna Sutta, 1/2/3-day, and 7-day teenager courses; Morning Chantings and Dohas for 10-day courses; Special Chantings; Talks, Interviews, and Q&As by S.N. Goenka; Pāḷi Training; and Gong Sounds.
- Additional video resources, including Mahāsatipaṭṭhāna Sutta Discourses, Benefits of Dhamma Service, Talks, Interviews, and Q&As by S.N. Goenka for Old Students and Dhamma Servers, and Special Chantings in the Gem Set in Gold.
- A wealth of written resources including the Old Student Guide, Course Formalities and Pāḷi Passages, Group Sittings Chantings, the 10-Day Discourse Summaries, Glossary of Pāḷi Terms, FAQs about doing a Self Course, information about the Chain of Teachers in this Tradition, information about Dhamma Service, and Dāna.
- Administer standard or customized self courses

Courses are given in numerous Meditation Centers and at Non-Center course locations.  Each location has its own schedule of courses. In most cases, an application for admission to these courses can be completed online using this App. There are numerous Centers currently in operation and more in development around the world, including Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, and Oceania.

Features of this App
- Learn more about Vipassana Meditation.
- Find locations near you that offer Vipassana Meditation courses from a complete worldwide listing or map of over 300 locations spread across 80+ countries.
- Locate Vipassana Meditation courses using search criteria such as dates, regions, and instruction languages.
- Apply and register to attend a Vipassana Meditation course.
- Download or listen online to audio resources in different languages, including 10-Day Discourses and instructions for Mini- Ānāpāna meditation.
- Stream videos in different languages, including 10-Day Discourses, Talks, Interviews, and Q&As by S.N. Goenka, Documentaries about Vipassana for adults and children, Vipassana for business executives and Vipassana in prisons, and a Mini-Ānāpāna Introduction and Practice.
- Support for creating and maintaining individual user account
- Pre-fill course application forms with profile information from user account
- Sync user account with updated information provided on application forms

Old Students
- One hour group sitting recordings in 25+ different languages.
- Play group sitting recordings with an option to log your daily sittings. All logged data is only stored locally on your device.
- Turn on group sitting counter to join and see how many Old Students are currently meditating.
- Find information about group sittings and other events hosted near you or hosted online.
- Additional audio resources, including discourses for Mahāsatipaṭṭhāna Sutta, 1/2/3-day, and 7-day teenager courses; Morning Chantings and Dohas for 10-day courses; Special Chantings; Talks, Interviews, and Q&As by S.N. Goenka; Pāḷi Training; and Gong Sounds.
- Additional video resources, including Mahāsatipaṭṭhāna Sutta Discourses, Benefits of Dhamma Service, Talks, Interviews, and Q&As by S.N. Goenka for Old Students and Dhamma Servers, and Special Chantings in the Gem Set in Gold.
- A wealth of written resources including the Old Student Guide, Course Formalities and Pāḷi Passages, Group Sittings Chantings, the 10-Day Discourse Summaries, Glossary of Pāḷi Terms, FAQs about doing a Self Course, information about the Chain of Teachers in this Tradition, information about Dhamma Service, and Dāna.
- Administer standard or customized self courses

bluejetty:00017166:ios.name: Solitaire Classic Gold
bluejetty:00017166:ios.summary: Enjoy the gold standard for solitaire card games with Solitaire Classic Gold. It's perfect for a quiet moment, to get your brain started in the morning or a relaxing activity to pass the time. Our take on this classic game also includes our
bluejetty:00017166:ios.description:
Enjoy the gold standard for solitaire card games with Solitaire Classic Gold. It's perfect for a quiet moment, to get your brain started in the morning or a relaxing activity to pass the time. Our take on this classic game also includes our Daily Double Challenge, the only solitaire challenge where you must win two rounds so you can start your day like a champion!
Based on traditional Klondike solitaire, the rules are simple and easy to learn. If you’ve never played before you just need to arrange the cards, alternating between red and black and disregarding suit, in descending order. Get out your aces and organise them into suits to complete the game. If you get stuck, flip the deck to search for more cards to help you out. There’s even a handy undo button which is great for peeking under a card and then putting it back! 
You can relax with the soothing sound effects and simple backgrounds, or you can inject a bit of competitiveness by trying to beat your previous score by winning more rounds in a row. Get even more points with round completion and time bonuses. Naturally those bonuses really rack up if you ever become a solitaire expert.
Features:
·      Keep on playing whenever you win a round! Winners complete more than one solitaire!
·      Intuitive controls with both tap and drag and drop options.
·      Daily Double Challenge - win two rounds in a row each day!
·      Step by step tutorial (optional because you probably don't need it!)
·      Crisp and clearly designed cards
·      Pick from 1 card and 3 card options for the standard or hard difficulties
·      Undo button to rectify mistakes or try different options
·      Atmospheric sound and music (independently turn these on or off)
·      Statistics for those who love to know how they're playing
·      Cards with class with your own personal solitaire card dealer
·      Improved design and user friendly layout for either iPhone or iPad
Enjoy the best solitaire with Solitaire Classic Gold!

产品特色：
1、时政要闻
澎湃新闻专注报道中国时政，动态跟踪政坛风云，解析经济时局变化；
2、原创匠心
澎湃原创品质保障，坚持新闻创作本心，深度调查呈现更多事件真相；
3、思想争鸣
澎湃新闻精于分析思想动态，紧扣脉搏普及新知，坦率争论碰撞思想；
4、视频专区
感受第一视角记录真实现场，实时了解最新进展，精彩专题深度剖析；
5、澎湃号
汇聚各领域专业创作者，湃客、政务、媒体，为您提供更丰富的优质内容；
6、澎友圈
聚集天下澎友精彩观点，每一次思想的碰撞，让您看世界更清一点；
7、澎湃问吧
明星专家澎湃入驻等您来问，专业问题明星八卦，问吧解答所有疑问；
8、质量报告
澎湃质量报告平台，打假除劣，破套防坑，时刻保障您的权益；
9、澎湃早晚报
每天早晚两次推送当天小编精选的国内外新闻大事件，与当前时事同步；
================用户评价================
@穷不穷你别怂乐正：
超好啦，没有毫无营养的娱乐稿和见缝插针的小广告，板块划分很清楚啊，很喜欢其中关于时政方面的新闻，还可以一直追踪一个专题比较不会烂尾了啊，总之是三观超正的，个人觉得比****好，很多社论有自己独特角度，不官方。很多可以用到公务员面试中去，还摆脱了培训机构的千篇一律，希望能坚持做新闻的本心，那我就会一直支持。我非常喜欢这里面的“社论”。在这个模块，可以看到大家对一件事和自己不同的看法，然后发现：“哇！原来还有这个角度！”真的很适合我这个即将参加高考的高三狗！
@EagleGorge：
第一时间对政策和要闻的深度跟踪报道。内容很有质量，不像很多互联网媒体，大部分的不知所云的抄袭文。
另外，新闻问答的方式非常不错，能够与权威人士进行沟通解答。
唯一让我感动不足的就是没法关闭新闻推送时的抖动。另外针对当地的本地新闻尚显不足。
再次祝福澎湃能够越办越好。
@高物房老师：
两年前，一直看其他媒体的文章，但偶然间发现，很多好的文章都来自于澎湃新闻，它们文笔优秀、态度端正、有广度又有深度。在很多媒体靠低俗的内容、爆眼球的标题而混迹于媒体界的时候，澎湃新闻像一位刚正不阿的有为青年，不随波浊流，撑起了自己的一片天。中国就缺少像澎湃新闻这样充满职业精神的好企业。澎湃加油！
@毁心伤肺溪涧：
我不明白那么好的软件为什么不是最多人用的，广告几乎没有，界面干净，没有那些乱七八糟的新闻，这就是我要的新闻。
更多精彩内容等你来发现！
官方微博：@澎湃新闻 http://weibo.com/thepapernewsapp
官方微信：澎湃新闻 thepapernews
意见反馈：support@thepaper.cn

bluejetty:00098805:ios.name: Number Tiles - Match Numbers
bluejetty:00098805:ios.summary: Number Tiles is a fun logic puzzle that pairs simple rules with a sneaky streak of strategy. Match pairs of identical numbers or pairs that add up to ten to clear the grid and collect coins. Supercharge your progress with epic boosters, and
bluejetty:00098805:ios.description:
Number Tiles is a fun logic puzzle that pairs simple rules with a sneaky streak of strategy. Match pairs of identical numbers or pairs that add up to ten to clear the grid and collect coins. Supercharge your progress with epic boosters, and give your brain a joy workout anytime, anywhere!
Why You’ll Love Number Tiles:
One of the best things about Number Tiles is how it keeps you hooked with its fun and addictive gameplay. Each level brings a fresh number puzzle, keeping you engaged as you match pairs - either identical numbers (like 3 and 3) or numbers that add up to 10 (like 4 and 6).
The fun doesn’t end when you clear the board. Each completed level rewards you with coins which you can spend on epic boosters or hints. These special add-ons further enrich your game journey, ensuring that there’s always a new way to complete the level!
How to Play
- Spot Matching Pairs. Look for tiles with the same number (e.g., 5 and 5) or pairs adding up to get ten (like 7 + 3) to clear them from the grid.
- Tap and Remove. Removing pairs frees up space and brings you closer to success.
- Climb the Levels. Each time you clear the board or reach the level goal, you’ll move on to the next level, unlocking even trickier puzzles.
- Collect Coins. Earn shiny coins after every win, then head to the store for boosters or hints to stay on a winning streak!
Your journey through Number Tiles is more thrilling with the addition of powerful boosters:
- Hammer. Smash away a tile that’s blocking your winning move.
- Bubble. Swap out the usual numbers for colorful rainbow bubbles that can pair up with other numbers on the grid.
- Tornado. Shuffle the board and reveal fresh pairing opportunities.
- Extra Plus. Get numerical rows with the remaining numbers to solve tough number puzzle grids.
Strategies for Success
- Plan Ahead. Always look for pairs that sum to 10 first, so you can blast through those tough spots and keep the fun rolling.
- Save Boosters. Your Hammer, Bubble and Tornado are precious resources, so use them only when you really need that extra push.
- Stay Flexible. If you’re stuck, consider alternative matches or use helpful hints and keep the game exciting.
- Practice Daily. Сonsistent play may help refine your skill and speed, turning each session into an even more addictive good time!
Number Tiles is more than a number game - it’s a playful way to strengthen your mind.
Dive into the excitement of matching identical tiles, chase that perfect match 10, and enjoy a never-ending blend of fun and learning of number games. Let the next big match be yours!

bluejetty:00134942:ios.name: Tiny Robots: Portal Escape
bluejetty:00134942:ios.summary: Tiny Robots: Portal Escape is an exciting 3D puzzle escape the room game set in a robot world full of curious characters, colorful levels, and exotic alternative realities. Collect items, look for hidden objects and clues, and solve tricky
bluejetty:00134942:ios.description:
Tiny Robots: Portal Escape is an exciting 3D puzzle escape the room game set in a robot world full of curious characters, colorful levels, and exotic alternative realities. Collect items, look for hidden objects and clues, and solve tricky mechanical puzzles. Oh, and don’t forget to save your grandpa from the bad guys! 
Slip into the metal shoes of a young, smart robot named Telly. One day, as you are walking to your grandpa’s house, you witness his kidnapping. His garage is left thrashed, his inventions are broken, and all you have is a radio station connecting you to Grandpa. Who did this? What do they want? You must unveil this mystery full of brain-scratching riddles, powerful enemies, and unusual worlds.
Play mini-games
Connect to different machines and hack their mechanisms by playing classic mini-games wrapped in robot clothes. Complete hundreds of levels in our Arcade escape room and earn exciting rewards.
Epic Boss Encounters
All bad guys know that a well-placed killer mega bot here and there greatly enhances their chances of executing their plan for world domination. They don’t know that this just makes your journey more challenging and fun!
Craft Artefacts
Collect hidden fragments and combine them into artefacts on a cozy table in your very own garage. A neatly crafted artefact is a must when dealing with boss bots!
Unlock fun characters
If you must go out there and outwit your enemies, at least do it in style. Customize your robot with hundreds of different combinations! A shark head connected to a jet engine instead of legs makes your journey much more personal.
Enchanting Audio 
The immersive sound effects and music create an unforgettable atmospheric journey!
Languages
Tiny Robots: Portal Escape is available in English, French, German, Italian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, and Chinese.

bluejetty:00130837:ios.description:
Akhbar Egypt is your personal electronic newspapers. This is the best way to keep abreast of the current economic, financial, political, social and sporting news in Egypt.
• All contents of Egyptian electronic newspapers at hand, booth in Arabic and English
• Enjoy a completely revised navigation, optimized to offer a seamless experience through a streamlined interface
• Access all articles contents and view videos without ever leaving the app
• Receive news alerts in real time and share content you like in a few clicks with your family
• Find essential news in a flash and stay informed in real time
SELECTION OF INFORMATION SOURCES
You can choose your preferred sources of information among those managed by the application. We regularly add new information sources, so do not hesitate to send us your wishes.
SEARCH AND FILTER ARTICLES
Search for articles simply by typing a few keywords. Filter articles to show only unread, videos, most popular...
FAVOURITES
Mark your favorite articles to keep them on your device and find them in one click.
SPEECH SYNTHESIS
Listen to your favorite articles in one click.
NIGHT MODE
Activate night mode to improve reading comfort when you are in a dark environment.
ACCESSIBLE ANYWHERE, EVEN OFFLINE
Once the items are loaded in Akhbar, you can access them even when you're offline. Akhbar automatically saves text content and images of your articles.
SUPPORT
We're listening.
If you have a question or encounter technical problems, please write us through the "Contact us by email" available from the application.
Your feedback is valuable and is read carefully in order to constantly improve the application.
Do you have any questions? Contact us by e-mail: ikad.apps.team@gmail.com
__________
أخبار مصر صحيفتك اليومية الشخصية. إنها أفضل وسيلة لمواكبة الأخبار الاقتصادية والمالية والسياسية والاجتماعية والرياضية بمصر.
• جميع مقالات الصحف الإلكترونية المصرية باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية بين يديك
• كامل محتوى المقالات وأشرطة الفيديو دون ترك التطبيق
• تنبيهات فورية، وإمكانية بعث مقالاتك المفضلة إلى أفربائك
اختيار مصادر المعلومات
يمكنك اختيار مصادر المعلومات المفضل لديك. نضيف مواقع إخبارية بانتظام، فلا تتردد في إرسال رغباتك إلينا.
البحث عن المقالات وتصفيتهم
ابحث عن المقالات ببساطة عن طريق كتابة بعض الكلمات الرئيسية. يمكنك أيضا تصفية المقالات لعرض الغير مقروءة، أشرطة الفيديو، الأكثر شعبية ...
المقالات المفضلة
ضع علامة على المقالات المفضلة لديك لحفظها على جهازك والعثور عليها في نقرة واحدة.
تركيب الكلام
استمع إلى مقالاتك المفضلة بنقرة واحدة.
الوضع الليلي
شغل الوضع الليلي لقراءة مريحة في الأماكن المظلمة.
متوفرة في كل مكان، حتى بدون الأنترنت
عندما يتم تحميل المقالات في التطبيق، يمكنك مطالعتها حتى بدون الأنترنت. أخبار تحفظ نصوص وصور المقالات تلقائيا.
نحن في الاستماع
إذا كان لديك سؤال أو تواجه مشاكل تقنية، يرجى الاتصال بنا من خلال التطبيق.
ردود الفعل مهمة لنا إذ تساعدنا من أجل تحسين التطبيق باستمرار.
لديك أسئلة؟ اتصال بنا عن طريق البريد الإلكتروني: ikad.apps.team@gmail.com

Istanbul Senin is serving all Istanbul r
bluejetty:00021208:ios.description:
What is Istanbul Senin?
It is a new generation smart city application where the people of Istanbul can easily access all the services they would need.
Super City’s Super Application: Istanbul Senin
Istanbul Senin is serving all Istanbul residents with dozens of features that would make your life easier.
Applications That Make Your Life Easier in One Application!
We gathered the services that the people of Istanbul need the most and filled them into İstanbul Senin. Thus, you will be able to access all these services from a single point, free of charge and easily, and make your life easier by handling the transactions you have been dealing with for days on your smartphone in a few steps. Moreover, you can enjoy the contents of Istanbul's historical texture, tastes, cultural and artistic events.
Access to All Services with Digital Identity
With Istanbul Senin, you can safely, easily and seamless access nearly 100 mini apps that offer various services through digital identity.
With QR Code Payment in Transportation and Many More Services
Your credit cards, Istanbulkart and identity card that you will add to your electronic wallet in the application will be with you all the time safely. You can perform your transactions safely and quickly with our mini apps such as İSKİ, İGDAŞ and İstanbulkart. In addition to making bill payments through Istanbul Senin, you can also make your shopping and transportation payments quickly and practically.
Fast and Easy Support About Istanbul
With Canlı Destek, where you can access detailed answers to your questions and complaints, Istanbul Senin will enable you to easily communicate with IBB.
Free and Unlimited Internet Connection
With IBB Wi-Fi you can connect to the internet free of charge and unlimitedly in public transportation and thousands of connection points in the city.
Free Event Tickets and Entrances
Through the Istanbul Senin superapp; with İBB Kültür and IBB Etkinlik mini apps, you can get hundreds of free concerts, tours, workshops, theaters and movie screening tickets in thousands of locations at many points of the city and you can also enter many of İBB spaces free of charge.
