Welcome to Idle Weapon Shop– where weapon crafting, business empi
bluejetty:00141756:ios.description:
As beasts overrun the forests, brave hunters need weapons to survive. YOU are the strategic mastermind building the last armory empire in this apocalyptic idle tycoon game! 
Welcome to Idle Weapon Shop– where weapon crafting, business empire building, and true idle progression collide! Start with a primitive forge and grow your weapon trade into a continent-spanning tycoon empire. Automating your idle business to earn 24/7!
As an aspiring weapon tycoon, dominate this idle game by:
BUILDING YOUR TYCOON EMPIRE (Idle Business Simulator)
Tycoon Economics: Research and forge diverse weapons to fulfill hunters’ dynamic orders and negotiate deals to maximize profits.
Empire Expansion: Start with a basic weapons shop in the forest, then upgrade and expand as you gain resources and profit，unlock deserts, mines, and volcanoes – then build idle income-generating empire! 
COMMANDING THE ULTIMATE IDLE WEAPONS NETWORK
Idle Game Production: Automate crafting pipelines! Your workshop forges weapons non-stop, earning idle cash while you sleep.
Customize Your Look: Unlock and equip fantastical outfits for your shopkeeper to attract elite clientele! Rare visitors offer tycoon-tier deals when your shop idles at night!
RPG ADVENTURE CLICKER GAME
Auto-Dispatch Hunters: Equip adventurers and send them on automated expeditions. Battle beasts and return with loot, rare resources, and gold—your core idle game income!
Pet Companion: Tame and nurture unique pets in this harsh world! Feed them to gain practical idle game perks.
Why players call this Business simulation and idle tycoon games：
1.TRUE IDLE GAME MECHANICS: Profit 24/7 with offline rewards, auto-battles, and hands-free crafting.
2.TYCOON EMPIRE SCALE: Grow from a shed to a multi-region weapon monopoly.
3.ADDICTIVE TYCOON STRATEGY: Balance automation vs. expansion in this business sim.
In "Idle Weapon Shop," every decision shapes the destiny of your empire. Craft with precision, trade with wisdom, and build your legacy, one weapon at a time.Become the ULTIMATE ARMAMENT TYCOON!

bluejetty:00150640:ios.name: Folk Alley Player
bluejetty:00150640:ios.summary: Listen to the best in hosted folk, Americana and roots music with the Folk Alley App. The completely new version allows you to listen to great music live, pause and rewind the live audio, and explore a variety of other great content from F
bluejetty:00150640:ios.description:
Listen to the best in hosted folk, Americana and roots music with the Folk Alley App. The completely new version allows you to listen to great music live, pause and rewind the live audio, and explore a variety of other great content from FollyAlley.com. Now, wake up to Folk Alley with an alarm clock feature!
FolkAlley.com is the “coffee house that never closes,” offering fans music from their favorite artists while helping them discover new music that fits their tastes. Professional DJs Elena See, Barb Heller, Matt Reilly and Cindy Howes host the Folk Alley stream. 
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch that great part again!
• Listen to streaming music from FolkAlley.com even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite stream starts playing.
• One click stream switching – flip from the main stream to Fresh Cuts or a seasonal stream with a single click.
• Enjoy the Folk Alley stream in the background while browsing the web, using your workout app or catching up on your emails!
• Access additional great content like videos, blogs, performance interviews or purchase music you hear through iTunes.
• Easily share music and videos with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to streaming music from Folk Alley.
Since September 2003, Folk Alley has brought the best of folk, Americana, and roots music to an international audience – listeners excited to finally find “their” music available 24 hours a day online. Listener-supported Folk Alley is dedicated to a beloved musical genre that is often overlooked by commercial radio networks.
Please support Folk Alley and become a member today!

bluejetty:00187347:ios.description:
When time is limited and bandwidth is nonexistent, leverage PitchBook Mobile on iPhone or iPad to stay informed about what’s important and collaborate without friction. 
With the PitchBook Mobile app, the entire VC, PE and M&A world is at your fingertips, providing instant access to insights on the global capital markets, industry news tailored to your sector and collaboration tools. Use PitchBook Mobile to track financial data and activities across your space, conduct due diligence and connect with dealmakers. Instantly get in depth information from wherever you are, including:
• VC and PE firms
• Limited partners
• Funds and performance
• Deals, valuations and exits
• Private and public company financials 
• Strategic acquirers 
• Series terms and debt terms
• Active advisory firms
• 2.6+ million professionals
• and more!
Plus, discover opportunities before your competitors and get immediate access to new reports and newsletters with customizable mobile alerts.

• “Great extension of the full platform. When on the go and you hear about a company that just raised a big round or a deal that just happened, it's great to jump into the app and see what PitchBook has on it.”

 Addictive match gaming experience that can relax your brain
 Colorful painted cubes, golden piggy bank, and shining in game provide a better game experience!
 Brand new play game with a pretty screen, sweet graphic and visual effects
 Deliciously sweet supply of candy crushing power - ups and combos
 Complete tons of challenging levels and unlock new episodes!

 Game OFFLINE & FREE whenever and wherever possible!

 Relaxing and satisfying gameplay.

 Play by matching to blast 2 or more cubes of the same color.
 Tap on the boosters to trigger the cool explosion effects!
 Swap 5 or more cubes will to make a special toy combos
 Smash the boosters and CRUSH ALL THE CUBES!

bluejetty:00071399:ios.description:
Keeping fit and active is a great way to de-stress, stay positive and keep motivated during times of uncertainty. The Echelon Fit App provides studio experience in your home with live, on-demand and scenic classes. Cycling, Rowing, Running, Strength Training, Yoga and more!
Choose to pedal, row, run or FitPass to beat your own personal best or track your performance against the greater Echelon community by viewing the global leaderboard updates for live, on-demand, scenic and FitPass classes.
LIVE CLASSES - Get a fantastic LIVE workout with your peers in our community to get a diverse stream of popular workout classes.
ON-DEMAND CLASSES - Take engaging high octane classes any time to fit your schedule. On-Demand classes updated every day.
SCENIC RIDES - Ride through the countryside, city scene or next to a beautiful ocean, get a great workout while you escape to another destination.
FITPASS - is a mix of off the strength, core, and yoga that will keep you working out everywhere.
ELITE INSTRUCTORS - Train with elite instructors from multiple studios teaching multiple modalities at different training levels. Stay engaged with our supportive community of members.
AMAZING SUPPORTIVE COMMUNITY - Join the global online community. On the Echelon Riders Facebook community, thousands of global riders share their stories, inspire each other towards their fitness goals and support each other with tips, tricks and positivity during this challenging time. We are helping to bring together, build friendships and defy physical distances by connecting people across states and even across countries.
ECHELON CHALLENGES - Looking to level up your fitness game? Introducing new challenges in our Echelon Fit App! Race against friends and family members to see who can complete these challenges the fastest and earn a badge every-time you complete a new challenge. Who’s in?
STRIDE TREADMILL - Patented Auto Folding Stride Treadmill lets you run with upbeat instructors live, on-demand and scenic classes.
ROW - Experience a total body workout with toggle control resistance on the handle. Enjoy daily live and on-demand studio instruction from world-class instructors, plus on-demand scenic rides from some of the best waterways in the world.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION - Connect Apple Health to your account and sync your workout data.
HEART RATE MONITOR - Connect your Bluetooth-enabled heart rate monitor view BPM and HR zones.
BLUETOOTH HEADPHONE & SPEAKER INTEGRATION - Connect bluetooth headsets, Apple Air Pods and wireless bluetooth speakers for an immersive experience.
ECHELON UNITED: One plan for all products - up to four family members per account.
APPROACHABLE FITNESS FOR ALL: We have classes for any skill level including beginner classes.
For app questions and support please visit https://echelonfit.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new
EULA
https://echelonfit.com/pages/eula
Privacy Policy
https://echelonfit.com/pages/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00120279:ios.summary:
Do you want to learn Spanish quickly and have fun doing it? Learn Spanish + by Vidalingua is the first language app of its kind with a Virtual Tutor you can chat with on any topic, using advanced AI with ChatGPT.
The New York Times says “
bluejetty:00120279:ios.description:
Do you want to learn Spanish quickly and have fun doing it? Learn Spanish + by Vidalingua is the first language app of its kind with a Virtual Tutor you can chat with on any topic, using advanced AI with ChatGPT.
The New York Times says “Apps from Vidalingua are hugely popular... they're free and they work offline, handy when you're actually abroad."
Immerse yourself in real-life situations that you can use in the classroom or on a trip. Learn Spanish + includes 101 lessons, 1,190 phrases and 5,277 exercises to help you become proficient in Spanish in record time.
Vidalingua is a leading developer of language apps with over 15 million users. See what others have to say.
"Great for students! I teach at a bilingual school and it’s challenging to keep the students' attention. Apps are the best way to go and this offline app is one of my favorites."
"I downloaded several free apps. Some are like games but I’m not sure I’m learning things I can use. This app has lessons that are immediately useful for talking to real people in real situations.”
"Lingidy is a super fun way to learn Spanish. It steps you through lessons you will need for a trip then throws in a few unexpected ones. Fun app. Bravo!"
The Vidalingua Method
Real-life Learning
Other apps waste time on vocabulary and grammar you’ll rarely ever use. Learn Spanish + jumps right to lessons that you can use immediately. Start by learning Greetings, Essentials and Questions to get a conversation started. Progress to helpful lessons such as Airports, Hotels and Directions. Make the most of your travels with lessons such as Museums, Movies and Making Friends.
Understanding & Speaking
Understanding Spanish is a good start but speaking is critical. Learn Spanish + provides advanced speech recognition to help you master pronunciation. Practice speaking at your own pace until you build the confidence to talk to others.
Engaging Experience
Some of the lessons in Learn Spanish + teach the basics such as telling Time, using the Subway or Eating Out. Others are unique and amusing such as Limousines, Hot Tubs, Pick-up Lines and Rejections. Interactive exercises keep your attention and improve retention. Meerling the meerkat provides help and encouragement.
Learn as you Like
Other apps force you to learn in a specific order. Lingidy allows you to move through lessons, phrases and exercises freely.
Features
• 101 lessons for real-life situations like taking Taxis, arriving at a Hostel or asking about the Weather. Fun lessons such as Flirting and Swearing.
• 1,190 useful phrases such as “Can you speak slowly?” and “Where is the closest cash machine?”.
• 5,277 exercises to master vocabulary, pronunciation and comprehension.
• Vocabulary exercises to help you master Numbers, Menus, even Cocktails.
• Audio pronunciations. Choose accents and speed.
• Select favorites to create your own study list.
• Word Jumble Exercises challenges you to order words in a phrase correctly.
• Pronunciation Exercises with advanced speech recognition to know if you say a phrase correctly.
• Picture Exercises to choose the image that matches a word.
• Write Exercises teaches you to understand spoken words & write them correctly.
• Multiple Choice Exercises to recognize the correct translations of a phrase.
• Set goals for yourself and track your learning progress.
• Notifications for Daily Phrases & Streaks.
Learn Spanish fast and have fun doing it. Download Learn Spanish + today!
Terms & Conditions
• Learn Spanish + includes 12 free lessons and 101 lessons with a subscription.
• Payment charged to iTunes Account at the end of the trial period.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off 24-hours before expiring.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user by going to Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when user purchases a subscription.
Terms of Service
https://vidalingua.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00023632:ios.description:
Use tabiori to manage the story of the journey.
tabiori is an app that makes travel itinerary and leaves memories conveniently and happily.
Manage travel schedules, belongings, photos, notes, souvenirs, and more with the app.
You can also collaborate by adding a companion to your travel plan.
A simple app with exciting excitement like a travel itinerary created for everyone on a school trip
Share your travel memories
Show off your travel memories to everyone
Let's share the fun memories and moments with everyone and get comments
□ Recommended for people □
“I want to manage my schedule together”
“I want to create and share travel itinerary ”
“I want to share my travel photos”
“I want to pass on important photos with the original ultra-high quality”
""I want to check my inventory""
""I want to assemble a travel plan with a couple""
“I want to work with my smartphone, computer and PC”
""I'm looking for a itinerary template""
It is the best app for those who want to enjoy such a trip.
□ I have everything I need. □
A schedule book that can be seen at a glance, not just to record schedules, it can be used freely and shared with an alarm function. It makes your trip enjoyable.
It is easy to manage your inventory list, and you can manage your personal belongings as well as your personal belongings with your friends and boyfriend, so you can reduce your forgotten items to zero!
It makes your trip more enjoyable than managing souvenir lists and exchanging notes.
□ FEATURES □
○ Everything you need is available.
○ Itinerary creation and sharing function
○ Schedule alarm function
○ Storage and sharing function for ultra-high-quality photos that do not deteriorate
○ Checklist
○ Memo function
○ Off-line browsing function that is safe even in the absence of radio waves
○ Online ordering of photo books (tie-up with camera Kitamura)
○ Travel itinerary printed at affiliated convenience stores (Lawson, Family Mart, Seiko Mart)
□ Share travel itinerary □
Share itinerary with a single tap of the QR code reading or URL
□ Edit on PC □
Access https://tabiori.com/
An account must be linked to your email address or Facebook.
□ tabori premium □
Unlimited use of all tabiori functions.
This is a monthly service that allows you to use ad removal, video sharing, printing at a convenience store's multi-copy machine, gift stickers and other functions. You will be charged for your iTunes after purchase and monthly updates.
-Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- It will be updated automatically unless you cancel it 24 hours before the end of the registration period.
-If you want to cancel tabiori premium. you can cancel "Setting" -> iTunes & App Store -> View Apple ID -> Manage".
□ Contact □
We want to make the app better with you.
Contact us for feedback
mail: info@tabiori.com
twitter: @tabiori
Official site: https://tabiori.com/
We are waiting for you.
■ Terms of use:
https://tabiori.com/termofservice/
■ Privacy Policy:
https://tabiori.com/privacypolicy/

bluejetty:00137365:ios.description:
Heartwell: Track Wellness
Heart Rate & Wellness Tracker
Track your heart rate and wellness trends with a simple camera-based scan.
Heartwell helps you record and review wellness-related data in a clear, easy-to-read way. Use your phone’s camera to start a quick scan, view estimated heart rate results, and follow your personal trends over time.
Camera-Based Heart Rate Tracking
Use your device’s camera to estimate heart rate in seconds. Heartwell presents your results in a simple format so you can review your readings and better understand your daily wellness patterns.
Clear Wellness Summaries
Health data can feel complicated, so Heartwell keeps things simple with:
- Easy-to-read results
- Clear trend charts
- Personal wellness records
Track Your Progress Over Time
Your wellness can change day by day. With built-in trend tracking, you can:
- Review heart rate history
- Monitor changes over time
- View simple charts
- Keep a record of your personal wellness data
Clean and intuitive charts make it easy to see your data at a glance.
Privacy Comes First
Your data is yours.
- No data shared without your permission
- Secure processing and storage
- Built with privacy-first principles
You stay in control of your information.
Subscription Information:
- Annual: $39.99/year
- Weekly: $9.99/week
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. To cancel, go to your Account Settings and turn off auto-renew.
Terms & Agreements:
Privacy Policy: https://art-widgets.com/heartwellprivacy
User Terms: https://art-widgets.com/heartwellTerms
Subscription Terms: https://art-widgets.com/heartwellSub
Important Disclaimer
This app is intended for general wellness and informational purposes only.
Heartwell is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or disease prevention. Measurements and summaries are estimates and should not be used as a substitute for professional medical care. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for any medical questions or health concerns.
Start Tracking Your Wellness
Keep your wellness data simple, clear, and easy to review.
Start your first scan today.

Our eDr
bluejetty:00073530:ios.description:
Thinking about travelling? Are you looking for a cheap flight? Download our app and make the trip of your dreams! We will also do the check-in for you, as soon as it is available, so you only have to worry about enjoying your trip.
Our eDreams travel app is the best rated in the travel industry; it has more than 2 million reviews and 18 million users! We'll take care of everything: Finding cheap flights, showing you the best hotels and other accommodations for your stay, negotiating great deals on your rental car or arranging your ride from the airport to your destination. We've got you covered!
Cheap flights
Find cheap flights among our more than 600 airlines, for one way, return or multi-city!
Our wide variety of flights offers you from long distance flights to cheap low cost flights with airlines such as Ryanair, Easyjet, British Airways, United Airlines, Air Europa and more. Book your flights with us and you will be able to download your boarding passes directly from the app, in addition to tracking the status of any flight in real time. You will find the ideal flight and tickets at the cheapest price in our travel app.
Hotels
Take a look at our more than 2 million hotels and other accommodations for all budgets and types of trips. Search, book and compare hotel offers very easily.
You can book hotels like Melià Hotels and Resorts, Marriott, Eurostars, NH, Catalonia Hotels & Resorts and much more. Cancellation is free if you change your plans. We also offer discounts of up to 40% less in hotels if you book a flight with us.
Car rental 
Do you want to complete your booking with a car rental? We offer cars from companies such as Hertz, Avis, Europcar, Alamo, Budget and up to 800 car rental agencies. Rent a car anytime, anywhere and travel at your own pace.
Sounds good, right? And that's not all!
Our travel app not only offers you cheap flights, hotel deals, and car rentals for your trips ... download the app and:
- Order your boarding passes for all your flights, and we will check-in as soon as it is available
- follow the status of any flight in real time with our new flight tracker feature
- Create an account and receive real time flight status notifications: gate numbers, baggage belts, delays or cancellations and more
- Check your flight itineraries, booking references or baggage allowances in the My Trips section, even without an internet connection!
- download our free travel guides and discover what to do at your destination, even if you don't have an internet connection
eDreams helps you to find the best deals on flights, hotels and car rentals. Search, compare and book flight + hotel tickets in our travel app to enjoy a 40% discount.
We strive every day to make your travel dreams come true. If you had a positive experience with our app, would you mind rating us with 5 stars in the App Store? Thank you!

bluejetty:00089359:ios.description:
Unlock a whole new experience of story making with all-in-one tool for creators, bloggers, content and news makers.
PHOTOS
Publish photos to Instagram Stories directly from Photo Albums or Camera on your iPhone 10x faster! The simpliest workflow you can imagine. No more complicated searchings for photos or videos via Instagram.
PHOTO COLLAGE
Choose 2-6 photos and share it via toStories. The app automatically generates a nice looking photo collage.
VIDEO
The fastest way to trim and share a video on the go. We promise! Forget about multiple editing apps, saving video copies or overwriting the original. Now it's easy to cut and share even a very loooooong video!
YOUTUBE VIDEO
Share a Youtube video and the app will generate a nice preview with a cover, video name and channel name. A better alternative than making a screenshot.
TWEETS
You can make a nice story sharing a tweet and applying multiple formats. Works well for tweets with photos.
WEBSITES
Nice article, shocking news, personal website, a cool gadget – share any piece of content from the internet. There are 5 formats to choose from!
TEXT
The magic happens when you share a piece of text a from a website or any app. Play around with fonts, multiple colors and gradients! 
COPY & GO to INSTAGRAM
Want to add a sticker to your photo? Look for «Copy & Go to Instagram» option under the share button. It allows you to add a tweet, youtube video preview or website stiker made by our app on top of your story.
WIDGET
You can track your Instagram followers and weekly growth right on the homescreen! Track multiple accounts at the same time. Combine multiple widgets, small and medium – to track more than one accounts. Go check it right now!
HOW TO SET UP:
0. No account required
1. Open Share menu on any photo
2. Scroll right and find "More" button
3. Click “Edit”
4. Add to Stories icon to Favourites
5. Move it up so you can easily find it. All set!
Terms of Use: https://tostories.app/terms

bluejetty:00184009:ios.description:
Genisys Card Controls – Full control over your debit and credit card usage in a way you’ve never had before.
• Manage how, when and where your cards are used—on your own terms. Genisys Card Controls enables you to set controls regarding the transaction types, geographic rules, and the merchant types where your card can be used.
• Turn any card on, or off—in seconds. It’s as simple as a toggle. Perfect for safety, security… and those scary moments when you’re not quite sure where your card might be.
• Ensure you are the only person using your cards. GPS capabilities can either limit where your card is used—or assure it’s only able to be used when with you.
• Turn your cards into active budget participants. Set dollar limits for transactions, and receive alerts when those limits are being reached. No more worrying about going over budget!
• Receive alerts when suspicious activity is suspected. 
• Stop fraudulent activity before it even happens with the alert feature. Based on your preferences, Genisys Card Controls can send you a real-time alert when your card is used outside of your chosen preferences, giving you the power to deny the transaction or turn your card off. Alert preferences can be set by:
• Location – based on where the transaction occurs 
• Transaction type – based on type of transaction at point of sale
• Merchant type – based on the type of merchant where the transaction occurred
• Threshold – based on the threshold amount set by the user (i.e. – transactions over $500 receive an alert)

bluejetty:00157716:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone into "Mobile Ears" with AI-powered hearing enhancement! Whether in a noisy café, attending a lecture or watching TV, Mobile Ears helps you hear better in any setting. With support for Bluetooth and wired earphones, including free wired earphones with every yearly subscription, you can enhance your hearing whenever you need it.
New Features You'll Love:
- Hearing Test (Audiogram): Check your hearing with our built-in test. Easily assess hearing loss and get personalized sound settings.
- Custom Sound Adjustments: Fine-tune audio balance with easy-to-use sliders. Whether you need more sound in your left or right ear.
- Bluetooth Compatibility: Enjoy wireless convenience with Bluetooth earphones or switch to our wired premium earphones for top-quality sound and low latency.
- AI Noise Filter: Our intelligent noise reduction technology helps block out background noise so you can focus on the sounds that matter most.
Why Choose Mobile Ears?
- Smart AI Technology: Our AI noise filter and speech enhancement deliver clearer sound in challenging environments.
- Wired & Wireless Options: Get wireless freedom or enjoy superior sound with free premium wired earphones included with every subscription.
- On-Demand Hearing Help: Open the app anytime for a boost in hearing clarity.
- Tailored Sound: Adjust sliders for balanced, personalized audio.
- Easy Setup: Plug in your wired earphones or connect Bluetooth, adjust the sliders, and hear better instantly – no extra devices needed.
Get Our Best Subscription Offer Now!
- Free Premium Wired Earphones: With any subscription, receive high-quality wired earphones at no extra cost, designed and tuned to deliver the best sound.
- Weekly Subscription: Pay a flat shipping fee for your free earphones. *
- Monthly Subscription: Pay a flat shipping fee for your free earphones. *
- Yearly Subscription: Get free earphones with free shipping when you choose the annual plan.
Subscribing to Mobile Ears gives you more than just better hearing – it gives you the tools to make every conversation crystal clear.
How it Works:
Using Mobile Ears is simple. Start by adjusting the Speech Enhancer slider to make voices and conversations clearer in any environment. Our AI Noise Filter helps reduce unwanted background sounds – slide it towards "High" for stronger noise reduction and clearer speech. For extra customization, the Audio Balance slider lets you decide which ear should get more sound. You can move the slider to make the audio louder in your left or right ear, depending on your needs.
Perfect For:
- Conversations in Busy Places: Our AI helps you hear voices clearly in noisy environments.
- Meetings & Lectures: Never miss a word in important meetings or classes.
- Watching TV: Enjoy clearer dialogue while watching your favorite shows.
Important Disclaimers:
- Bluetooth Latency: Bluetooth earphones may have sound delays. For best real-time accuracy, use our premium wired earphones included with your subscription.
- Non-Medical Audiogram: The audiogram helps assess your hearing, but isn't a substitute for medical advice. Use our wired earphones for best results; other earphones may affect accuracy.
- Not a Medical Device: Mobile Ears is designed to enhance your hearing, but isn't a medical device and shouldn't replace doctor-prescribed hearing aids.
*Shipping fee is non-refundable.

bluejetty:00187692:ios.name: Great Tafsirs التفاسير العظيمة
bluejetty:00187692:ios.developer: The Prince Ghazi Trust for Quranic Thought
bluejetty:00187692:ios.summary: Great Tafsirs is a non-profit application for the sciences of the holy Qur’an; where users from all around the world can effectively access a large database of Qur’anic Commentary (tafsir) for the most important and accredited Sunni, Shi’it
bluejetty:00187692:ios.description:
Great Tafsirs is a non-profit application for the sciences of the holy Qur’an; where users from all around the world can effectively access a large database of Qur’anic Commentary (tafsir) for the most important and accredited Sunni, Shi’ite, and Sufi scholars in the Muslim world such as Al-Zamakhshiri, Al-Tabari, Al-Qurtubi, Al-Razi, and Ibn Kathir, etc. The application covers the seven Islamic schools (madhabs): Shafi’i, Hanafi, Maliki, Hanbali, Ja’afari, Zeidi, and Ibadhi, and does not adopt a certain school or support one without the other; as it aims at providing all relevant sciences and the users have the freedom to choose what they want without being directed to one.
It also provides access to several works of Qur’anic translations, recitations, and other essential resources of meanings, syntax, and revelation reasons, etc. Moreover, it provides an advanced user-friendly search engine that enables users to search for words and text within Qur’an.

bluejetty:00080859:ios.description:
Welcome to My Dream Store – the ultimate idle arcade game that lets you build, manage, and expand your very own supermarket empire! Step into the exciting world of store management where you can stack and organize goods, work as a cashier, manage shopping carts and baskets, and transform your mini mart into a mega retail company. Whether you're a fan of store simulators or just looking for a fun and easy game to play, My Dream Store offers a unique and engaging experience.
■ Stack & Organize Goods: Keep your shelves fully stocked and neatly organized to attract more customers. From fresh produce to household essentials, ensure your store is always ready to meet the needs of your shoppers.
■ Work as a Cashier: Experience the thrill of running the cash register. Scan items, handle transactions, and provide excellent customer service to keep your customers happy and coming back for more.
■ Manage Carts & Baskets: Keep your store running smoothly by managing shopping carts and baskets. Make sure they are readily available for customers, and organize them efficiently to maintain order in your supermarket.
■ Expand Your Mini Mart: Start small and watch your business grow. Expand your mini mart into a bustling mega retail company. Unlock new sections, add more products, and upgrade your store to attract a larger crowd.
■ Meet Various Mart Styles: Discover and design different types of marts, each with its own unique style and charm. From cozy convenience stores to grand supermarkets, personalize your store to create a shopping experience that stands out.
My Dream Store combines the best elements of store management and simulator games, offering a fun and addictive experience for players of all ages. The Connections app offers 24/7 confidential recovery support to help individuals achieve their treatment, health, and quality of life goals. The app features peer-moderated discussion forums, virtual support meetings, and a variety of resources for building coping skills. The Connections app password is available through your provider, health plan, or health agency.  
Connections provides engagement, ongoing encouragement, and support throughout a recovery journey. The app is used in a variety of settings including residential and in-patient programs, outpatient care and medication treatment programs, and in aftercare. 
The app is available in English and Spanish. For the Spanish version, see Conexiones.  
Connections is anonymous, safe, and HIPAA compliant. 
With Connections, you can:  
- Track recovery goals and stay motivated. 
- Connect, encourage and interact with peers in recovery.  
- Share achievements. 
- Conduct daily check-ins, report and build confidence.  
- Explore a robust library of coping and recovery support tools.  
- Earn rewards for app usage (available with select program sponsors).  
- Complete digital CBT modules (available with select program sponsors)

bluejetty:00090742:ios.description:
Приложение создано опытными врачами акушерами-гинекологами в простой и удобной форме с учетом особенностей ведения беременности в России. 
В приложении вы найдете:
• Календарь - калькулятор беременности с напоминаниями о важных событиях
• Нормы, сроки и правила сдачи анализов
• Разделы о питании во время беременности
• График динамики веса и давления с показателями нормы
• График изменения размера живота ребенка и потребления жидкостей
• Счетчик толчков и счетчик схваток (таймер схваток)
• Чек-лист необходимых действий для каждого триместра
• Сотни статей о беременности и видео о беременности, разработанных специально для BabyLenta
Мы поможем рассчитать точный срок беременности. Вам будут доступны хорошо структурированные, разбитые по неделям и триместрам профессиональные видео и статьи о беременности, которые разработаны опытными акушерами-гинекологами, психологами, косметологами и тренерами для беременных.
Дневник беременности BabyLenta охватывает важные темы от планирования беременности до развития плода, подготовки к родам и роды. Статьи о беременности по неделям, советы и рекомендации BabyLenta уже просмотрены более 14 миллионов раз.
В разделе Чек-листы мы собрали рекомендации акушеров-гинекологов по каждому триместру и упаковали в продуманный чек-лист, который позволит вам не пропустить сдачу анализов и другие важные действия в каждом триместре.
В разделе Измерения вы найдете удобные графики изменения веса, артериального давления, размера живота и объема жидкости. В приложении также доступны счетчик схваток и счетчик толчков.
После родов вы сможете почитать полезную информацию о грудном вскармливании.
Ваш путь к материнству с приложением BabyLenta будет максимально комфортным!
Ресурс BabyLenta более 10 лет разрабатывает рекомендации будущим мамам для правильного ведения беременности. Беременные женщины доверяют нам самое главное – заботу о будущем малыше и здоровье мамы.
Наша цель - давать только информацию от опытных врачей в интересной и простой форме.

Resimler hangi kelimeyi anlatıyor?
Dört resme bak ve ortak kelimeyi bul!
Bağımlılık yaratan bu eğlenceli kelime oyunu ile hem eğlen hem de zihnini dinç tut.
Sakin ve rahatlatıcı bir tasarıma sahip bu oyunda, kendi temponda ve rekabetten uzak, seviyeleri birer birer geçerken zamanın nasıl geçtiğini anlamayacaksın.
4 Resim 1 Kelime formatındaki bu oyun, saatler süren eğlence sunar ve kelime bilgini test eder.
Özellikler:
• Binlerce eğlenceli seviye
• Görsellerle desteklenen kelime bulmacaları
• Zeka ve dikkat geliştirici oyun deneyimi
• Basit, akıcı ve bağımlılık yaratan oynanış
• İnternetsiz oynanabilme
• Tamamen Türkçe içerik
HARF ELE
• Kelimede bulunmayan harfleri kaldırır.
HARF AÇ

İPUÇLARI

Amacımız kimseyi reklama boğmadan, güzel, keyifli bir oyun deneyimi yaşatmak. Mümkün olduğunca kendi isteğinle, ihtiyaç duyduğunda ve karşılığını alarak reklam izlemeni isteriz.
Reklam izlemek istemezsen oyun için satın alımları da erişilebilir ve makul seviyede tutmaya özen gösterdik. 
Oyunumuzu değerlendirip, yorum yapman bizim için çok değerli.

bluejetty:00147079:ios.description:
Traveling in China? MyChinaTaxi helps international visitors book taxi rides, airport pickups, train station transfers, and city transfers with dedicated human support.
Every rider gets help from a real support team for common travel problems in China: finding the driver, confirming the pickup point, communicating when the driver cannot speak English, and getting help if something is left in the car.
MyChinaTaxi uses AI-optimized dispatch and expert vehicle selection to shorten waiting time and improve ride quality. Vehicles are selected for cleanliness, and drivers are expected to be polite and professional.
There is no surge pricing. The price you see is the price you pay, with consistent year-round fares and good value for travelers who want reliable service without last-minute price jumps.
Pay online with global credit cards and other supported international payment methods.
Available in major cities across China, including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Chongqing, Hangzhou, Wuhan, Xi'an, and more.

bluejetty:00023436:ios.description:
Ball Sort - Color Sorting Puzzle Game is a challenging sorting game centered around colorful balls. In this exciting game, your sorting skills will be put to the test as you meticulously sort and arrange balls into the correct bottles, cups, and drinking bottles to conquer each level.
How to Play:
●Tap the tube to move the ball.
●If there are two or more balls of the same color, you can only stack balls of the same color on top of each other.
●The primary rule is to place all balls of the same color into one tube, cup, or drinking bottle to successfully complete the sorting level.
●Additionally, if you encounter any difficulties in the sorting levels, you can backtrack to the previous step or add more tubes, cups, or drinking bottles to assist you in mastering the art of sorting.
Features:
-Play offline! No need for Wi-Fi.
-Explore new rewards in our exciting Holiday Event!
-A game perfect for color sorting enthusiasts!
-Enjoy a sleek and visually appealing interface.
-Customize your sorting levels and containers to master your skills!
-A captivating way to pass the time while honing your expertise in sorting colorful balls, cups, and drinking bottles!
Classic sorting challenges meet innovative gameplay, creating a world of SORT! Enjoy the Ball Sorting Game, challenge yourself with color sorting, and immerse yourself in the thrilling world of sorting challenges!

bluejetty:00174331:ios.description:
The official app for Indego, Philadelphia's favorite bike share! Indego offers a variety of affordable pass options to access over 1,600+ bikes (including electric bikes) and 200+ stations throughout the city - and is still growing! 
With the Indego app, you can: 
• Purchase a pass or access your account
• View real-time bike type and dock availability
• Unlock a bike
• Check your ride history and trip duration
• Manage your payment method
• Track billing history
• Rate your ride or report a trip issue
• Contact customer service
• Earn free days using IndeHero
• Receive system notifications and updates
With Indego you get round-the-clock access to public transportation on your schedule. Riders can choose between three different pass types to fit their needs. Discounts are available for riders with a PA ACCESS card. 
You must be 14 and over to ride Indego classic bikes and 16 or over for Indego Electric. Visit rideindego.com for more information. 
Indego is sponsored by Independence Blue Cross and an initiative of the City of Philadelphia.

bluejetty:00188211:ios.name: Little Critter Collection #1
bluejetty:00188211:ios.summary: Dive into 10 exciting Little Critter interactive book apps that lovingly address all the major issues of growing up! Explore pictures, learn new vocabulary, and personalize each story with your own narration. Children will easily identify w
bluejetty:00188211:ios.description:
Dive into 10 exciting Little Critter interactive book apps that lovingly address all the major issues of growing up! Explore pictures, learn new vocabulary, and personalize each story with your own narration. Children will easily identify with Little Critter's adventures as he maneuvers through childhood one day at a time.
Explore the Story:
- ENCOURAGE literacy skills with highlighted narration
- LEARN new vocabulary with tappable words and pictures
- RECORD your own narration & share it with others
- SELECT a scene with easy-to-use navigation
- KEEP kids in the story with parental controls 
Play a find-the-creature mini game! Can you can spot every creature throughout the story? Tap to tally them up!
Designed for children ages 2-5
-All By Myself: Little Critter doesn't always do everything perfectly, but he always does the best he can.
-I Just Forgot: On rainy days he remembers his raincoat but forgets his boots. At home he takes a bath but forgets to use soap. Poor Little Critter!
-I Was So Mad: He wanted to keep frogs in the tub but his mom said he couldn't. He wanted to paint the house but his Grandpa said no. Little Critter was SO mad.
-Just Me and My Mom: Little Critter enjoys a special day in the city with his mother. He means well, but gets himself in trouble all along the way.
-Me Too!: Little Sister tags along wherever he goes. Whether he's playing football with friends or hiding in his secret tree house, she always finds him. "Me too!," she says.
-The New Potty: This light-hearted story of common potty training frustrations encourages children to keep trying, just as Little Sister does.
-Just Grandma and Me: Little Critter becomes a good helper when he and grandma decide to spend a day at the beach!
-Just for You: Sweet Little Critter wants to do something special for his mom, but he's a little too little and a lot too silly to get anything quite right.
-The New Baby: At first, getting along with the new baby seemed like an impossible task, but soon enough Little Critter learns how to be a good big brother.
-When I Get Bigger: Little Critter day dreams about all the exciting things he'll do when he gets bigger like having a paper route and staying up late watching movies.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
The Reviews Are In:
- "The child narration is superb!" - The iMums
- "Highly Recommended!" - Digital Storytime
------------------------------------------------------------------------
We'd Love To Hear From You!
- Please share your thoughts in a review! Your experience matters to us.
- Need tech support? Contact us at support@omapp.com
- Say hello to us on FB! facebook.com/oceanhousemedia
Official Mercer Mayer licensed app: www.littlecritter.com

bluejetty:00032564:android.name: Village Business Simulator
bluejetty:00032564:android.summary: Welcome to the fascinating world of life in the Russian countryside! In our simulator you will plunge into the atmosphere of rural life, where you can develop your businesses, perform exciting tasks and solve life problems of villagers and
bluejetty:00032564:android.description:
Welcome to the fascinating world of life in the Russian countryside! In our simulator you will plunge into the atmosphere of rural life, where you can develop your businesses, perform exciting tasks and solve life problems of villagers and city dwellers.
Develop your businesses:
Start small and build your economic empire! Various businesses are available in the game, such as a bakery, scrap metal recycling center, store and more. Buy and develop your businesses so that they bring in more profits. Over time you can improve your businesses, automate processes and turn small village businesses into real money machines.
Fascinating plot:
You're not just developing a business - you play as the main character who finds himself in a difficult situation. The chairman of the collective farm ran away with the money, and now you need to pay off a huge debt for your collective farm. Perform story missions, help the villagers and the town. For example, help the local police catch a dangerous criminal or solve other life issues. Each quest immerses you in a unique story filled with Russian flavor.
Realistic atmosphere:
The game meticulously recreates village life, including the Russian car fleet! Buy legendary domestic cars use them to do your chores. Experience the dynamic change of day and night as the morning sun changes to evening lights and the stars illuminate the village streets.
Survival System:
Not only do you have to run a business, but you also have to keep an eye on your character. The game has a hunger and sleep system that forces you to take care of yourself. You need to eat on time, rest and keep an eye on your energy levels. You can have lunch at a local cafe or cook a meal at home. Everything is just like in real life!
Key features:
Develop businesses: bakery, scrap metal reception, store and others
Realistic Russian cars
Fascinating quests and help the villagers
Main storyline: pay off the debt for the collective farm
Day and night change
Hunger, sleep and nutrition system
Beautiful graphics, conveying the atmosphere of the Russian countryside
Join the game and try yourself as a successful businessman in a Russian village! Will you be able to pay off your debt and restore the kolkhoz? Solve life challenges, manage time and resources, help the locals and become a true village legend!
Download right now and start your advent

bluejetty:00040012:ios.description:
Installment loans, consumer loans, and get instant disbursement with the CUB Vietnam App.
CUB Vietnam App – A Comprehensive Financial Solution that is Fast, Convenient, Reliable, and 100% Online. Choose an easy and stress-free loan designed just for you, skipping the rigid multi-step approval process with the CUB Vietnam App. Features include:
--- APP FEATURES---
• Apply for a 100% online consumer loan with just Citizen ID (CCCD or CC), with attractive interest rates.
• Quick loan approval.
• Fast loan disbursement with simple steps.
• Online credit limits up to 40 million VND.
• Flexible installment terms from 3 to 36 months.
• Flat yearly interest rate is 22.92%.
---LOAN REQUIREMENTS---
• Product is only applied for Vietnamese citizen.
• Age between 22 and 55 years old.
• Have a Citizen ID (CCCD or CC) with embedded chip.
• Have a registered phone number under your name.
---ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE---
• Online credit limit amount: 40,000,000 VND
• Loan term: 24 months
• Flat yearly interest rate: 22.92% (based on flat interest rates and may differ slightly from actual rates). This interest rate is for reference only, kindly check the CUB's Fee and Interest Rate Schedule from time to time for more details.)
• Monthly payment: 2,447,509 VND (equivalent to 81,584 VND/day)
---DATA SECURITY FEATURES---
CUB Vietnam is a fully secured mobile application developed by Cathay United Bank– Ho Chi Minh City Branch. The app is approved by Apple App Store with international FIDO certification, offering dual protection against unauthorized access.
• Biometric authentication: Enable fingerprint or Face ID unlock for enhanced security.
• One-Time Password (OTP): Enter the OTP sent to your registered phone number for an extra security layer.
• Regular security checks: Improve account security and minimize risks of unauthorized access.
Customer privacy is CUB Vietnam's top priority. We strictly comply with the provisions of the law on personal data protection, ensuring your data is safeguarded. Learn more about CUB Vietnam's privacy policy on our website.
________________________________________
REQUIREMENTS FOR USING THE CUB VIETNAM APP
• Camera: Required to capture your ID and facial image.
• Turned on Location services: Mandatory for disbursement and signing electronic contracts.
• NFC-enabled phone: Used to scan Citizen ID cards with embedded chip.
• Biometric login: Enable biometric login for faster app access.
You can revoke or modify access permissions anytime via your device settings, including disabling features and removing CUB Vietnam app permissions.
________________________________________
ABOUT US
Cathay United Bank (CUB), established in 1975, is a subsidiary of Cathay Financial Holdings (CFH). With a vision to become a leading financial institution in the Asia-Pacific region, CUB operates 233 branches and offices across Asia-Pacific, including China, Vietnam, Hong Kong, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Laos, Cambodia, Myanmar, and Indonesia, with a workforce of over 10,000 employees.
________________________________________

Website: https://www.vn.cathaybk.com/home 
Email: contact.CUB@vn.cathaybk.com
Hotline: 028 3622 6836
(To ensure the safety of your account, please install security software on your mobile device.)

Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you

bluejetty:00131749:ios.description:
Your story lives in Omaha. Get in-depth stories and read breaking news for Omaha, and the Midlands Region of Nebraska and beyond – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics. From reporting on the Huskers and Bluejays to the news that matters most in your community, we cover it all. 
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts. Support local journalism by subscribing today for unlimited digital access.
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Continue watching – pause a video and pick up where you left off across devices
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access to breaking news updates, analysis, and more.
Get the Omaha World-Herald in Your Inbox
Get convenient, curated updates delivered to your Inbox. Sign up for Breaking News updates as they happen, the Afternoon Update for a roundup of the latest local top stories, Creighton Basketball or Nebraska Prep Zone for the latest sports headlines, Food & Drink for foodies, Garage Sales for bargain hunters and many more.
Visit https://omaha.com/newsletters/ to view and subscribe to all of the Omaha World-Herald Newsletters.
Keep Up with the Omaha World-Herald
Follow us on Facebook and other social platforms:
https://x.com/owhnews
https://www.instagram.com/omahaworldherald/
https://www.facebook.com/WorldHerald/

About the Omaha World-Herald
The Omaha World-Herald is a daily newspaper, available in print and on-line, in the midwestern United States, the primary newspaper of the Omaha-Council Bluffs metropolitan area.
We'd love to hear what you think! For any technical issues or questions, contact us at webmaster@omaha.com

HIREAPP connects reliable professionals with gig opportunities across the United States. Browse available gigs, express interest in opportunities that match your skills and experience, and get matched based on your location, qualifications, and standing on the platform.

Check in and out directly from the app for accurate time tracking and streamlined payment approvals.

Download HIREAPP today and discover a smarter way to find flexible work.

bluejetty:00071173:ios.description:
India’s leading travel app - Yatra enables you to plan your travel without any hassles.
With over 10 million downloads, Yatra has become the preferred choice for travellers to
book flights, hotels, bus, cabs, trains, holiday packages and more.
1. Flight Bookings
• Search and book cheap flight tickets on Domestic and International Airlines
• Book One-way/Round Trips through a single window display. View flight fares and
enjoy special discounts with the Flight Booking App.
• Get the best price on all Domestic Airlines and book flight tickets for Indigo, Spice
Jet, Go Air, Air India, Air Asia, Air India Express, Vistara etc. Get flight deals while
booking through Yatra mobile app.
• Make cheap flight ticket booking for all International Airlines including British
Airways, Virgin Atlantic, Lufthansa, Jet Airways, Emirates, Etihad, Singapore Airlines,
Malaysian Airlines, Cathay Pacific. Get numerous flight offers with the online flight
booking app.
• You can modify your search directly on the search results page by selecting fresh
dates on the airfare calendar through Yatra air ticket booking app
• After successful flight ticket booking, view hotels at your chosen destination via the
online hotel booking option
• Online payment for cheap flights and online hotel booking is conveniently and
easily available through multiple ways on this travel app
2. Hotel Bookings
• Book hotels from a network of 70,000+ Domestic & 5,00,000+ International hotels
• Enjoy great discounts on hotels with Yatra app
• Search hotel rooms by city, area, hotel name, and filter them by star ratings,
amenities, price, TripAdvisor rating, location etc.
• Read user ratings and reviews before making a hotel booking
• Check images of hotels and rooms along with their location on the map
• Book premium, budget or cheap hotels on the Yatra app as per your choice, and pay
directly at the hotel
• Choose a hotel basis Free wifi, Free breakfast, Free Cancellation, Pay@hotel etc.
• Save your favourite hotels to a list and share it with your friends & family to plan
your stay together
3. Bus Bookings:
• Search and book bus tickets from a wide network of bus operators that cover over
15,000 routes across India
• Choose from different bus types - Seater, Sleeper, AC, Non-AC Deluxe, AC Volvo
• Choose your boarding, drop points and other amenities in the bus
4. Cab Bookings:
• Book cab rides from 100+ cities across India
• Search and book Outstation and Hourly Cabs
• Compare availability and fares of various car rental companies
• Book Self-drive Cars
5. Book Holidays
• Choose a holiday package from a range of Domestic & International packages
• Explore holidays by theme - Hills stations, Beach, Adventure, Weekend trips,
Luxury, Wildlife and more
• Select your travel plan and get a call back from our travel experts
6. Train Bookings
• Search & book Indian Railways train tickets
• Check PNR status, train running status and more with the Yatra app
• Use eCash on train bookings and save money
• IRCTC officially authorises Yatra app for train bookings
7. SME Bookings
• Book cheap flights with Yatra SME App
• Low or nil cancellation on flights and hotels
• Avail special rates on bus and train bookings with SME App
8. E-tickets for Monuments
Book online tickets to 178 heritage monuments of India using Yatra App
 7. My Bookings
• Save your travel plans in My Bookings. You can view them later in offline mode.
• Get booking details, request e-tickets and other travel details via SMS
• Add your tickets to Passbook, and opt for eco-friendly and smart travel
8. More in store for you!
• Redeem Yatra eCash on your travel bookings
• Refer the app to your friends & earn eCash
Write to us for any queries/suggestions at apps@yatra.com. Book your trips using the
Yatra app on your iPhone or iPad & get the best travel deals!

bluejetty:00141639:ios.description:
Do you love nature and have an interest in the plant world? Do you want to learn how to recognize plants and learn about their characteristics? Then our app "Plantica" is the perfect solution for you!
With "Plantica", you can quickly and easily identify the name of the plant you are interested in. To do this, simply take a photo of the flower, leaf, or tree, and our app will quickly recognize it and provide detailed information about that plant species.
But that's not all. "Plantica" offers even more opportunities to explore the plant world. You can browse beautiful photos from other users, study the description and features of each species, and save images and information to your personal library for future use.
Our team is constantly working to improve the app and add new features. We are confident that "Plantica"will become your reliable assistant in exploring the world of plants, and you won't be able to imagine your life without our app!
Features:
-Identification of over 10,000 species of plants, flowers and trees
-Learn the plants around you, including similar plants, other names, and scientific classification
-Point your camera at a plant and our app will tell you everything you need to know about that plant
-Store all identified plants in a simple user interface
-Get inspiration from similar plants and recommendations.
Terms of Use: http://plantid-in.tilda.ws/terms
Privacy Policy: http://plantid-in.tilda.ws/policy

bluejetty:00041114:ios.description:
FastCast:
A terrific APP for mirroring or media sharing.
It helps you to cast your phone, tablet, or PC to the large TV screen in high picture quality, real-time response, and stability.
And you can also play your phone's video, music, or picture on the TV set.
Youtube casting and AirPlay are also supported here in the FastCast TV APP.
FastCast, cast your joyful life!
【KEY FEATURES】
--Mirroring: Project your phone's screen to a large-screen TV, go online lessons, play games, watch movies, let you feel the thrill of the large screen!
--Local files cast: Support projecting photos, music, and videos from your phone to the large screen, make the large-screen TV in the living room become a home-sharing center, to share happiness with family and friends!
【Tips for usage】
--Make sure your smart TV and iPhone device support wireless display and screen mirroring functions.
--Make sure your smart TV and phone/tablet are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
--It is recommended to turn off the VPN in order to connect the device correctly. 
【Contact us】
Thanks for downloading FastCast. Any other feedback, please feel free to contact us at smartdisplayapple@gmail.com.
FastCast VIP is an auto-renewable subscription (weekly, monthly, or yearly) that removes ads and unlocks unlimited casting. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscription auto-renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Privacy Policy: https://privacy-policy.mokads.com/fastcast/en/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00091658:ios.description:
Soothe is the largest and most trusted on-demand wellness platform in the world. Soothe empowers massage therapists, estheticians, and cosmetologists (whom we call Soothers) with opportunities to earn, work, and live.
As a Soother, you can be your own boss and enjoy the flexibility of choosing when, where, and how much you earn. All you need is your license/certification, supplies, a mode of transportation, and a smartphone to start making money. It’s that simple.
MAXIMIZED EARNINGS
Earn more with hourly rates up to 3x that of brick-and-mortar locations, with the ability to offer service enhancements and receive tips through the app. Payments are deposited directly into your bank account within 48 hours of completing each appointment.
FLEXIBILITY
Freedom to work when and how often you want. The Soothe platform helps maximize your revenue by using your location and availability to connect you to a steady stream of clients to grow your business.
EASE OF USE
Our app makes managing your appointments fast and simple, and our platform helps fill your schedule automatically, letting you focus on what you do best – taking care of your clients.
YOUR OWN PERSONAL ASSISTANT
Soothe’s team is there to help you and your clients book, reschedule, handle payments, and much more – freeing up your time to take more appointments and increase your revenue.
SAFE & TRUSTED
Soothe verifies the identity of your clients, and our award-winning Trust & Safety support teams are there for you around the clock, 24x7 to answer questions and ensure your experience as a Soothe Provider is safe, healthy, and professional.
EDUCATION & SUPPORT
Soothe provides business tools, access to education, tips from experts and a peer network to help you succeed. 
INDUSTRY-LEADING PARTNERS
Get access to special pricing and products with Soothe’s network partnerships. By joining the Soothe community, you’ll have special access to top brands like Theragun by Therabody, Skin Authority, PCA, Hydropeptide, and more to help you maximize your revenue potential, and offer your clients the best products on the market.

Welcome to the NEW mobile banking application for Ridgedale Federal Credit Union members.
With a great new look and feel, we’ve made the mobile app easier to find information on your accounts and transactions. 
Features: 
• Safe and Secure. Access your accounts 24 hours a day.
• Use your fingerprint to see your balances quicker. 
• Easier to find information on your accounts, including transaction details and running balance.
• Make internal or external transfers through one easy process.
• Bill Pay for making payments on the go.

• Transfer payments directly to your credit union loans.
• View and manage statements

bluejetty:00094599:ios.description:
Welcome to Domino Ocean!
Match tile patterns to activate powerful boosts in this fresh puzzle experience that blends the best of Dominoes & Solitaire!
▶ PLAY & MATCH
Dive into Domino Ocean—a fresh puzzle game that combines the logic of Dominoes with the smooth flow of Golf Solitaire.
Match domino tiles instead of cards to clear the board. In each level, match more tiles of the shown pattern to charge up powerful boosts!
It's the familiar, strategic fun we all love—with a new twist of pattern collection!
▶ GAME-CHANGING BOOSTS
Match patterns to activate one of three special boosts:
Aqua Twister – Clears random tiles.
Half Wild – Matches with one of two patterns.
Tile Shift – A magic tile that keeps your streak going.
Each level offers a different boost—so plan your moves and play smart!
▶ SIMPLE YET STRATEGIC PUZZLE FUN
Domino Ocean is easy to pick up—and its rich strategy and satisfying challenges will keep you coming back for more!
Make streaks, activate special tiles, and time your boosts to master each level!
▶ AN UNDERWATER EXPLORATION
Explore through puzzle-filled maps with your sea friends—Ollie the hermit crab, Bubbles the yellow tropical fish, and Finn the shark.
Discover hidden treasures and surprise encounters in a vibrant underwater world!
▶ MAIN FEATURES
A fresh puzzle experience combining Dominoes & Solitaire
Pattern-matching missions and level-specific boosts
Special tiles that shake up your strategy
A mysterious and colorful underwater world
Adorable sea friends to join you on your journey
Play now and send waves through the deep with every match!

bluejetty:00153851:ios.summary: Get ready for an addictive and timeless gaming experience with Mahjong Match! This traditional yet captivating game brings the classic charm of mahjong tiles to your fingertips. Your mission is simple yet engaging: collect pairs of identica
bluejetty:00153851:ios.description:
Get ready for an addictive and timeless gaming experience with Mahjong Match! This traditional yet captivating game brings the classic charm of mahjong tiles to your fingertips. Your mission is simple yet engaging: collect pairs of identical mahjong tiles to eliminate them from the board. With stunning graphics and an intuitive interface, Mahjong Match is perfect for players of all ages.
Core Gameplay:Find and pair identical tiles to clear the board!
HOW TO PLAY:
- Simply tap on the Mahjong tiles and they will automatically collect in the box. Two of the same tiles match.
- When you have collected all the tiles, you have completed the level!
- If there are 4 tiles in the box, you fail!
Features:
- Classic Gameplay: Enjoy the authentic mahjong matching experience. Find and pair identical tiles to clear the board.
- Large Tile Designs: Immerse yourself in a visually appealing world with intricately designed mahjong tiles.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support allows you to enjoy Mahjong Match anytime, anywhere without Internet connection.
- No Timer: You can enjoy free classic Mahjong games with no timer and no pressure to score.
- Helpful Props:Our game has many useful props to help you complete challenging levels.
- Daily Challenge: Complete daily challenges to earn rewards and trophies. Practice every day to improve your classic Mahjong skills.
- Custom Background: Support players to upload custom backgrounds so that you can have the most comfortable playing experience.
Why Choose Mahjong Match?
- Cultural Heritage: Experience the rich cultural history of mahjong in a modern and interactive way.
- Brain Training: Sharpen your memory and strategic thinking skills as you search for matching tiles.
- Ad-Free Fun: Enjoy a smooth and uninterrupted gaming experience with no annoying ads.
Download Mahjong Match today and embark on a delightful journey of tile matching and cultural discovery. Challenge yourself, relax, and have fun with this timeless classic!

bluejetty:00013660:ios.summary:
The Mishnah Study app features online Mishna Sdura & Mishnayot in Hebrew & English with Bartenura and more interpretations for each tractates. Offered free to download as public service with all Jewish Sedarim.
Clicking on a masechet direc
bluejetty:00013660:ios.description:
The Mishnah Study app features online Mishna Sdura & Mishnayot in Hebrew & English with Bartenura and more interpretations for each tractates. Offered free to download as public service with all Jewish Sedarim.
Clicking on a masechet directs to a page with commentaries, Jewish philosophy, cantillation, Mishnah, torah, halakha, gemara, Jewish blessings, Rambam and more biblical text sources study & Sedarim scripts.
The search button allows navigation through sedarim.
The Mishnah texts and Jewish commentaries are provided in Hebrew and English. It is highly useful if you are interested in Jewish bible studies, torah, Jewish biblical scripts.
The app is also highly recommended for Theology & Chazal studies & pilpul.
The Mishnah (Mishna) consists of six orders are:
1. Seder Zeraim ("Seeds"), dealing with prayer and blessings, tithes and agricultural laws 11 tractates - Berakhot, Peah, Demai, Kilayim, Sheviit, Terumot, Maasrot, Maaser Sheni, Challah, Orlah, Bikkurim.
2. Seder Moed ("Festival"), pertaining to the laws of the Sabbath and the Festivals 
12 tractates - Shabbat, Eruvin, Pesachim, Shekalim, Yoma, Sukkah, Beitzah, Rosh Hashanah, Taanit, Megillah, Moed Katan, Chagigah
3. Seder Nashim ("Women"), concerning marriage and divorce, some forms of oaths and the laws of the nazirite
7 tractates - Yevamot, Ketubot, Nedarim, Nazir, Sotah, Gittin, Kiddushin
4. Seder Nezikin ("Damages"), dealing with civil and criminal law, the functioning of the courts and oaths 
10 tractates - Bava Kamma, Bava Metzia, Bava Batra, Sanhedrin, Makkot, Shevuot, Eduyot, Avodah Zarah, Pirkei Avot, Horayot
5. Seder Kodashim ("Holy things"), regarding sacrificial rites, the Temple, and the dietary laws
11 tractates - Zevachim, Menachot, Chullin, Bekhorot, Arakhin, Temurah, Keritot, Meilah, Tamid, Middot, Kinnim
6. Seder Tohorot ("Purities"), pertaining to the laws of purity and impurity, including the impurity of the dead, the laws of food purity and bodily purity
12 tractates - Kelim, Oholot, Negaim, Parah, Tahorot, Mikvaot, Niddah, Makhshirin, Zavim, Tevul Yom, Yadayim, Oktzin
Suitable for all streams of Judaism: Rebbe Akiva, Rebbe Nachman & Rebbe Lubavitch.
More biblical sources:
Commentary:
Bartenura on Mishnah Pesachim,Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Mishnah Nazir, Exodus, Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Mishnah Sotah, Bartenura on Mishnah Bikkurim, Bartenura on Mishnah Shabbat, Bartenura on Mishnah Eruvin, Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Mishnah Yoma, Bartenura on Mishnah Yoma, Bartenura on Mishnah Ketubot, Rambam on Mishnah Bava Kamma, Bartenura on Mishnah Bava Metzia, Rambam on Mishnah Bava Metzia, Yachin on Mishnah Bava Batra, Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Mishnah Sanhedrin, Rambam on Mishnah Sanhedrin, Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Pirkei Avot,Bartenura on Pirkei Avot, Rabbeinu Yonah on Pirkei Avot, Tosafot Yom Tov on Pirkei Avot, Rambam on Pirkei Avot, Yachin on Pirkei Avot,Avodat Yisrael,Derech Chaim, Rashi on Avot, Bartenura on Mishnah Menachot, Bartenura on Mishnah Chullin, Bartenura on Mishnah Mikvaot, Bartenura on Mishnah Berakhot, Bartenura on Mishnah Peah, Siftei Chakhamim, Bartenura on Mishnah Makkot, Bartenura on Mishnah Horayot, Rambam on Mishnah Horayot
Term of use: https://mishnah.app/en/about/documents/term_of_use

Clicking on a masechet directs to a page with commentaries, Jewish philosophy, cantillation, Mishnah, torah, halakha, gemara, Jewish blessings, Rambam and more biblical text sources study & Sedarim scripts.

The search button allows navigation through sedarim.

The Mishnah texts and Jewish commentaries are provided in Hebrew and English. It is highly useful if you are interested in Jewish bible studies, torah, Jewish biblical scripts.
The app is also highly recommended for Theology & Chazal studies & pilpul.

The Mishnah (Mishna) consists of six orders are:
1. Seder Zeraim ("Seeds"), dealing with prayer and blessings, tithes and agricultural laws 11 tractates - Berakhot, Peah, Demai, Kilayim, Sheviit, Terumot, Maasrot, Maaser Sheni, Challah, Orlah, Bikkurim.

2. Seder Moed ("Festival"), pertaining to the laws of the Sabbath and the Festivals 
12 tractates - Shabbat, Eruvin, Pesachim, Shekalim, Yoma, Sukkah, Beitzah, Rosh Hashanah, Taanit, Megillah, Moed Katan, Chagigah

3. Seder Nashim ("Women"), concerning marriage and divorce, some forms of oaths and the laws of the nazirite
7 tractates - Yevamot, Ketubot, Nedarim, Nazir, Sotah, Gittin, Kiddushin

4. Seder Nezikin ("Damages"), dealing with civil and criminal law, the functioning of the courts and oaths 
10 tractates - Bava Kamma, Bava Metzia, Bava Batra, Sanhedrin, Makkot, Shevuot, Eduyot, Avodah Zarah, Pirkei Avot, Horayot

5. Seder Kodashim ("Holy things"), regarding sacrificial rites, the Temple, and the dietary laws
11 tractates - Zevachim, Menachot, Chullin, Bekhorot, Arakhin, Temurah, Keritot, Meilah, Tamid, Middot, Kinnim

6. Seder Tohorot ("Purities"), pertaining to the laws of purity and impurity, including the impurity of the dead, the laws of food purity and bodily purity
12 tractates - Kelim, Oholot, Negaim, Parah, Tahorot, Mikvaot, Niddah, Makhshirin, Zavim, Tevul Yom, Yadayim, Oktzin

Suitable for all streams of Judaism: Rebbe Akiva, Rebbe Nachman & Rebbe Lubavitch.
 
More biblical sources:
Commentary:
Bartenura on Mishnah Pesachim,Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Mishnah Nazir, Exodus, Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Mishnah Sotah, Bartenura on Mishnah Bikkurim, Bartenura on Mishnah Shabbat, Bartenura on Mishnah Eruvin, Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Mishnah Yoma, Bartenura on Mishnah Yoma, Bartenura on Mishnah Ketubot, Rambam on Mishnah Bava Kamma, Bartenura on Mishnah Bava Metzia, Rambam on Mishnah Bava Metzia, Yachin on Mishnah Bava Batra, Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Mishnah Sanhedrin, Rambam on Mishnah Sanhedrin, Ikar Tosafot Yom Tov on Pirkei Avot,Bartenura on Pirkei Avot, Rabbeinu Yonah on Pirkei Avot, Tosafot Yom Tov on Pirkei Avot, Rambam on Pirkei Avot, Yachin on Pirkei Avot,Avodat Yisrael,Derech Chaim, Rashi on Avot, Bartenura on Mishnah Menachot, Bartenura on Mishnah Chullin, Bartenura on Mishnah Mikvaot, Bartenura on Mishnah Berakhot, Bartenura on Mishnah Peah, Siftei Chakhamim, Bartenura on Mishnah Makkot, Bartenura on Mishnah Horayot, Rambam on Mishnah Horayot

bluejetty:00030688:ios.description:
Australia Snow Map lets you quickly view and compare snow report information for all Australian ski resorts in a single glance by showing the information on a map. With Australia Snow Map, you can: 
- View currently reported 24-hour snowfall totals, 3-day totals, and 7-day totals across all resorts. 
- View snow base statistics across all resorts.
- See the same statistics for past dates by swiping left or right on the map. This lets you see how much snow each resort received yesterday, two days ago, etc. 
- View resort webcams and each resort's feeds from Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter.
- Review detailed snow history for each resort by clicking on the resort to view the resort-specific page within the app, letting you see many days of snowfall history. 
- See how snowfall amounts can vary, even among neighboring resorts, letting you find the best snow for your days on the mountain. 
- See the last date each resort reported snow by clicking on the "Last Snowfall" button.

BlaklistEd – Audiobooks
Discover Black stories. Listen to Black voices.
BlaklistEd is the premier destination for discovering full-length audiobooks and book summaries by Black authors, Black narrators, and creators from across the African diaspora. Explore thousands of full-length audiobooks and book summaries across fiction, nonfiction, children's books, and more—all in one place.
Whether you're looking for bestselling fiction, Black history, memoirs, business, self-help, romance, fantasy, science fiction, mystery, faith, politics, poetry, literature, or children's books, BlaklistEd makes it easy to discover your next great listen.
Unlike general audiobook platforms, BlaklistEd is thoughtfully curated to help you discover Black voices faster. Browse collections organized by genre, theme, and cultural interests so you can spend less time searching and more time listening.
Why You’ll Love BlaklistEd
• Explore a growing collection of full-length audiobooks.
• Discover concise book summaries that help you learn from more books in less time.
• Listen to books by Black authors and Black narrators across dozens of genres.

• Save favorites and build your personal audiobook library.
• Enjoy an intuitive audiobook player with playback speed controls that automatically remembers where you stopped.

Black History • Biographies & Memoirs • Business & Money • Children's • Fantasy & Afrofuturism • Faith & Spirituality • Health & Wellness • Historical Fiction • Horror • Literature • Mystery, Thriller & Suspense • Poetry • Politics • Romance • Science Fiction • Self-Help • Street Lit • Women's Fiction • Young Adult (YA) • and many more.
Our Mission
BlaklistEd exists to connect listeners with stories that celebrate the richness, diversity, creativity, and lived experiences of Black communities around the world.
We believe great stories deserve to be heard, and we're committed to making them easier to discover through one dedicated audiobook destination.
Get Started Today
Download BlaklistEd, create your account, start your free trial, purchase individual audiobooks, and discover your next favorite listen.

bluejetty:00144787:ios.description:
We began our journey in the health space over ten years ago, working out of a Garage! We helped professional athletes, celebrities, and just about anyone dealing with complex health issues. We were a welcome alternative to people who wanted to feel good in their bodies. But, no matter how many people we helped, we couldn’t keep up. We could see the problem getting worse. 
And, it was happening FAST!
We could see it everywhere.
Young women and children were coming into our clinic with issues that we would normally see in 50—and 60-year-olds.
Chronic disease, mental health, and suicide were on the rise. 
We KNEW that something had to CHANGE…..
It was time for us to try something new. 
If we were really going to make a positive impact on the world, we needed to find a way to help people heal themselves.

Youmeal helps you save and organize every recipe you love from Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and more. Build grocery lists, plan your weekly meals, and get instant nutrition facts for any recipe.
MAIN FEATURES
Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook – Instantly import recipes from social media and get them neatly formatted with ingredients and clear step-by-step instructions.
Add recipes from anywhere – Bring in your favorite recipes from Paprika, Notes, Notion, Google Docs, or even type your own. Everything stays organized in one place.
Smart grocery lists – Generate shopping lists in one tap. Sort items by recipe or by supermarket aisle to save time at the store.
Weekly meal planner – Plan your breakfasts, lunches, and dinners with ease.
Nutrition info – Instantly see calories, protein, carbs, and fats for each recipe.
Cookbooks – Group your recipes by meal type, cuisine, or diet, and design your own personalized cookbooks.

Attach links or notes to keep track of sources.
Paste a list of ingredients directly into your grocery list.

Youmeal offers a free version and an optional premium upgrade.

Save unlimited recipes from social media.

bluejetty:00038293:android.description:
Easy and convenient access to essential insurance services for Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance customers!
[Overview] 
This app consists of key insurance services, including MY Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance, insurance claims, premium payments, loan applications/repayments, and auto accident reporting.
[Main Functions] 
- Contract confirmation/change/certificate issuance
- Insurance claims
- Insurance contract loan application and repayment
- Credit loan application and repayment
- Premium payment
- Car breakdown dispatch request/accident reporting
- Branch/Service Network locator
- Consultation request
[Supported OS]
- Android 7.0 or higher
[Supported Resolutions]
- Optimized for 1280 x 720 resolution (1920x1280, 2560x1440)
- The landscape screen may not be fully displayed at resolutions lower than 1280 x 720.
[Supported Devices]
- Optimized for Samsung and LG smartphones. Tablets are not supported.
[Access Permissions]
We provide information on the access permissions required to use the service.
Access permissions are divided into required and optional permissions.
Optional permissions require consent to use the corresponding function.
Even if you do not grant permission, you can still use the service.
□ Required Permissions
- Storage: Photos, joint certificate, security program (V3)
□ Optional Permissions
- Camera: Scanning insurance claim QR codes, taking photos of documents
- Location Information: Confirming location for emergency dispatch, service network, etc.
- Phone: Digital ARS
- Apps displayed over other apps: Digital ARS
- Contact Information: Electronic signature authentication
[Security]
For safe financial transactions, the service cannot be used on devices that have been modified, such as those rooted.
For modified devices, please reset the device by contacting the manufacturer's A/S center or other authorized service center before use.
* Rooting: Obtaining administrator privileges on a smartphone running the Android operating system. This means that the device's OS has been modified, either by tampering with it or by malware.
