bluejetty:00068723:ios.description:
Discover what to see, plan a day around your interests, and explore on foot with walking itineraries and an interactive city map. Less time planning. More time enjoying the trip.
- Personalized day plans based on your interests and available time.
- Walking itineraries with clear stops and estimated walking times.

KNOW MORE BEFORE YOU GO
Find out what makes each place worth a visit, check practical details and estimated visit times, and decide where to spend your time.
Download your travel companion and make your next day out your own.

bluejetty:00134086:ios.description:
PLEASE NOTE: This is a reference guide for keyboard shortcuts used in the desktop version of Blender. You CAN NOT create 3D models or animations inside this app.
No matter if you are a new Blender user or have been using Blender already for a while, it comes with a lot of keyboard shortcut. If you know them you can improve your workflow and work much faster. This app was built to help you get to know the different keyboard shortcuts.
This app contains more than 100+ keyboard shortcuts for the 3D software Blender version 2.8 and up. All keyboard shortcuts are available offline and are sorted by various categories. We also added some helpful descriptions to each shortcut explaining it. Additionally, the app offers the possibility to search for keyboard shortcuts.
There are two different versions of the app available. The free version contains Ads, but for a small amount, you can get an Ad-Free version of the App. In the free version you can unlock a limited number of shortcuts. The ad-free version with all shortcuts you can buy as In-App Purchase in the App whenever you like. This means you can try out the app as long as you want without paying anything and if you like it and do not want to see advertisements or want all the shortcuts you can buy the Ad-Free version.

bluejetty:00166894:ios.summary: Welcome to the world of Valentia! Build your deck of cards and prepare for strategic CCG battles against monsters and the Guardians of Chaos. Download FREE* Card Guardians: Deck Builder and embark on a great roguelike adventure game to save
bluejetty:00166894:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of Valentia! Build your deck of cards and prepare for strategic CCG battles against monsters and the Guardians of Chaos. Download FREE* Card Guardians: Deck Builder and embark on a great roguelike adventure game to save Valentia from the Magic of Chaos.
The Land of Valentia was at peace for thousands of years, until the Day of Chaos came and spread mysterious magic that corrupted the living creatures of all realms. As the hero, you have to build the best CCG card deck, set up battle strategies, and free all enemies overtaken by Magic of Chaos and threatening the peace of Valentia. Download Card Guardians, have fun in this RPG adventure, and discover a story of epic war!
In Card Guardians, you need to win battles against monsters and build a battle card deck to defeat the Guardians of Chaos. Choose the hero of your RPG adventure, create CCG battle strategies, and discover various unexplored realms throughout the Valentia. And beware of dangers! There are dungeons, castles, forests, and deserts that harbor dangerous enemies, with the difficulty of roguelike games.
Restore peace to Valentia and become the master duel of the deck of battle cards. Download Card Guardians now and explore a roguelike world with dangers and epic stories!
CARD DECK BUILDING
To free Valentia from the Magic of Chaos, you need the best deck of battle cards. The more levels you advance, the more cards you get to build your RPG strategy. Remember to think about each choice! They will determine whether you can free the world of Valentia from the Magic of Chaos. Choose your hero, set up your battle strategy, and defeat all the Chaos Guardians! Play for free* Card Guardians and take part in an epic adventure and war battles.
RPG STRATEGY BATTLES
Beware the Chaos Guardians! At the end of each kingdom, you will encounter powerful bosses, in the style of roguelike games, who will require the best battle card deck. Explore your enemies' weaknesses and build the best RPG strategy to achieve victory and unlock the realms of Valentia from the Magic of Chaos. A tactical error can spell your doom in this roguelike world. Defeat your enemies, earn new battle cards and defend the world of Valentia!
*Card Guardians: Deck Builder is a free game. However, the game has extra features and additional items that are optional for gameplay.

bluejetty:00040056:ios.summary: Using the Text Reader application, you can instantly convert any text into speech in a simple and fast way. Therefore, you can listen to an excerpt from a book, a study booklet or a verse from the Bible on the way to work, while taking a wa
bluejetty:00040056:ios.description:
Using the Text Reader application, you can instantly convert any text into speech in a simple and fast way. Therefore, you can listen to an excerpt from a book, a study booklet or a verse from the Bible on the way to work, while taking a walk or preparing for a test.
The Text Reader application uses innovative algorithms and features to provide you with the following functionalities:
- Reading text in the device's default language, providing multiple voices.
- Parameters such as text reading speed and narration tone of voice can be modified.
- Text recognition in PDF, TXT and image files (PNG, JPG, etc.).
- Export the text in WAV audio to be shared or listened to at a later time
- The text read is saved in a list, which serves as a reading history.
- You can minimize the app while listening to the reading. A player is available so you can control the audio while the app is minimized.
- Pause or resume content using wired or Bluetooth headset buttons.
- The application works without the need for an Internet connection!
We hope this application helps you and improves your productivity.
Have a good time!

bluejetty:00062047:ios.name: Camera1 - Black & White Camera
bluejetty:00062047:ios.summary:
Camera1 is the dedicated Black & White manual camera for iPhone. No colour, no compromise — just pure monochrome photography with full creative control.
DEVELOP YOUR CREATIVITY
Learn to "see" in Black & White through Camera1 unique simulta
bluejetty:00062047:ios.description:
Camera1 is the dedicated Black & White manual camera for iPhone. No colour, no compromise — just pure monochrome photography with full creative control.
DEVELOP YOUR CREATIVITY
Learn to "see" in Black & White through Camera1 unique simultaneous contrast and exposure adjustments. Explore the infinite black and white image possibilities in real-time, such as high-key/low-key right in the viewfinder, before taking the shot. Use the Zen mode to focus all your creative attention on the picture, and not the camera or technique.
TAKE CONTROL
Take control of the camera, with manual overrides of exposure and focus. Super easy access to focus lock using the manual focusing slider, for ultra-fast shooting - as the camera won’t need to re-focus between shots.
PROFESSIONAL OUTPUT
Camera1 takes full advantage of your camera hardware and saves in a variety of different file formats, including JPEG, TIFF, RAW & ProRAW / DNG, allowing for maximum editing flexibility in applications like Photoshop and Lightroom later in your workflow. Advanced iOS image processing such as Deep Fusion and Smart HDR is used on supported devices.
Live histograms, flash, grid views and a range of manual controls allow you to get the perfect shot, every time. 
Features
• Black & white photography only: commit to Black and White at shooting time.
• High-quality image processing engine. Take full advantage of your device camera hardware. 
• Manual focus (with magnification of the center focusing area), focus lock, spot focus, auto-focus 
• Manual exposure compensation, or use Auto exposure
• Live histogram, when adjusting exposure, optional over-exposure warning indicator (zebras)
• 6 contrast/color filters for Black & White: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, infrared (simulated) 
• Manual contrast control
• High-resolution capture (48MP) (*)
• Support for multi-lens devices - standard, telephoto and ultra wide-angle (*)
• ProRAW, RAW, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF file formats. DNG files contain colour information, allowing later editing. A full-resolution JPEG, processed to Black and White by Camera1 is saved alongside the DNG file, to the camera roll
• Support for iOS Deep Fusion and Smart HDR (*)
• Tap on the picture to take the shot
• 5 crop formats: 3:2, 4:3 (native), 1:1, 16:9, 2.35:1 (panorama)
• Zen mode: all controls disappear, leaving only the viewfinder on the screen for the ultimate picture-taking experience
• 3 flash modes: On, Off, Torch
• 2 framing grid types: Rule of Thirds and Golden Triangles
• Live view of all controls above
• iOS Widget - quickly launch the app from your lock or home screen
• Camera Control: use hardware camera control to launch Camera1, or to take shots (iPhone 16 Pro & Pro Max)
• Black and White camera roll, image viewer at full resolution
"The most brilliant Camera App in recent years" -- Keisuke Takahashi
"I like the results-a bit like film (Tri-X) with a slight grain pattern. Lots of latitude" -- Eric Mencher @emencher
Don't forget to tag your pictures with #camera1app !
Privacy-first
• Camera1 does not embed any tracking / third-party SDKs
(*) Compatibility Notes
Camera1 features depend on the capabilities of your iOS device:
• High-resolution (48MP) capture: iPhone 14 Pro and later Pro models
• ProRAW capture: iPhone 12 Pro and later Pro models
• RAW capture: iPhone 6S and later, iPad Pro
• Smart HDR & Deep Fusion: iPhone 11 and later
• Multi-lens support (standard, telephoto, ultra wide): devices with multiple rear cameras
• Ultra Wide lens may not support RAW or manual focus/exposure on some devices

 • Power M
bluejetty:00160274:ios.description:
iAntiTheft: The Ultimate Anti-Theft Alarm App for Your Phone
Protect your phone from theft with iAntiTheft, a powerful app packed with features designed to keep your device secure.
Key Features:
Four Powerful Protection Modes:
 • Power Mode: Triggers an alarm when the lightning cable is unplugged.
 • Motion Mode: Activates an alarm if the device is moved.
 • Pocket Mode: Alerts you when the phone is removed from your pocket.
 • Earphone Mode: Sounds an alarm if the earphones are unplugged.
Smart Auto-Protection:
 • The smart mode automatically selects the most suitable protection setting with just one tap. Let the app choose the best mode for you effortlessly.
Seamless Call & Siri Detection:
 • The app detects when you’re on a call or using Siri, ensuring the alarm doesn’t activate during these moments. Once the call ends, simply return your device to the required state to resume protection.
Additional Features:
 • Fully integrates with your device’s passcode, Touch ID, and Face ID.
 • Automatically locks the volume at its maximum setting for added security.
 • Runs reliably in the background and lock mode.
 • Includes a convenient Today Widget in the Notification Center.
 • Designed with an optimized, user-friendly interface for a seamless experience.

bluejetty:00035069:ios.description:
-------------------------------
◇◆What's the game like?◆◇
-------------------------------
□ABOUT
An RPG where you go on adventures with pixel art versions of Disney characters!
Classic characters like Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck appear! Pooh, Baymax, Stitch, Aurora, Maleficent, and other fan favorites join the fun as well!
Dive into a never-before-seen Disney world where familiar characters get new looks themed around rhythm games, board games, and various other genres!
□STORY
The game worlds that the Disney characters call home have suddenly been invaded by strange programs, resulting in chaos.
Previously isolated game worlds have become connected... causing unexpected encounters between characters and throwing them into confusion.
Take on the role of a player of these games and join Disney characters as you embark on an epic quest across multiple game worlds to restore order!
□GAME SYSTEM
- Battles -
Simple battles that are fun for all!
Enjoy fast-paced battles alongside Disney characters that you can direct with simple commands.
You can also let the characters battle on their own with auto mode for even more ease of gameplay.
More experienced RPG players can delve deeper by strategizing and making use of the Attack, Defend, and Skill commands to seize victory!
- Avatars -
Combine your favorite hairstyles and outfits to make your own unique Avatar!
Disney-themed clothing items are featured!
Put together outfits that suit your mood.
- Expeditions -
Gather materials and power up characters while you're away.
Pixelated Disney characters can explore the game worlds even when you're not playing.
You'll obtain various items when they return from Expeditions.
□Great for players who:
・Are big fans of Disney
・Love pixel games
・Often play RPGs
・Are looking for a beginner-friendly RPG
・Like casual gaming apps
・Like cute art styles
・Like customizing avatars and outfits
□Featuring characters from Disney & Pixar Animation Films:
・Mickey & Friends
・Sleeping Beauty
・Tangled
・Mulan
・Aladdin
・Peter Pan
・Zootopia
・Lilo & Stitch
・The Aristocats
・Winnie the Pooh
・Big Hero 6
・Cinderella
・Hercules
・101 Dalmatians
・Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
・Beauty and the Beast
・Alice in Wonderland
・Moana
・The Lion King
・Wreck-It Ralph
・Toy Story
・Frozen
and more!

---------------------------------------
Follow Disney Pixel RPG's accounts for the latest info!
Facebook：https://www.facebook.com/PixelRPGofficialpage
Instagram：https://www.instagram.com/PixelRPG_official/

bluejetty:00017440:ios.description:
Welcome to Wildscapes – the new hit in the Scapes™ series by Playrix! Create your dream zoo with dozens of adorable animals by solving colorful puzzles!
Build spacious enclosures for animals and make your zoo visitor-friendly with cafes, fountains, playgrounds, hangout spots, and more! Learn about species from all over the world and create the best zoo ever! Ready for a wild ride? Then hop on!
GAME FEATURES:
● Enjoy your favorite gameplay: beat match-3 levels to restore the zoo! 
● Match juicy and fruity items to complete unique tasks and win rewards
● Unlock more areas to welcome new animals from different habitats
● Play with custom options to design your zoo the way you want
● Decorate your zoo with unique objects from around the world
● Complete tasks for zoo visitors by helping them with their specific needs and wants
● Bring together whole families of animals to get even more rewards! 
Wildscapes is free to play, though some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, simply turn off the purchase option in your device's "Restrictions" menu.

bluejetty:00039774:ios.description:
O que você tem nas mãos é um poderoso aplicativo para quem quer praticidade na hora de registrar suas vendas.
Rápido e ágil, o Meu Caixa garante um cadastro simples e prático de seus clientes e registros. Pronto! Simples assim. A partir disso:
- Acompanhe o histórico de suas vendas.
- Mantenha-se informado de qual cliente está com débito.
- Saiba quanto vendeu, quanto já recebeu de seus clientes e quanto ainda falta a receber.
- Filtre todas as informações por períodos de data.
- Saiba quanto cada cliente já comprou e quanto já pagou, com um relatório simples contendo descrição do serviço/produto, descrição de pagamentos, data e hora.
- E o mais importante, faça backup sempre que precisar!
Muitas funcionalidades ainda virão! Mantenha o Meu Caixa sempre atualizado, nos envie dicas, sugestões, críticas e pedidos.
Nos avalie (de preferência sempre bem) para que o app continue sempre em evolução.

It will NOT make you a better golf player!

bluejetty:00186764:ios.description:
Learn all things data and master AI skills with DataCamp.
Master in-demand data engineering, data analysis, AI engineering, data science, coding, and technology skills in Python, SQL, R, and more. Learn through interactive courses and real-world projects, and earn industry-recognized certifications. Whether you’re getting started with AI for work and data or learning advanced technologies, DataCamp’s diverse curriculum helps you learn programming languages such as Python and SQL, along with expert-led AI training, so you can stay ahead in the modern technology landscape.
Why learn with DataCamp?
Join over 19 million learners who trust DataCamp to become proficient in data and develop AI skills. 
With DataCamp, you don’t just learn; you apply, build, and certify your way into the data and AI career you want.
• Hands-on, interactive courses: Follow bite-sized lessons with short videos, code-alongs, and instant practice to reinforce your progress. 
• Real-world projects: Apply knowledge from Python, SQL, R, and AI to practical tasks. Work with real datasets, build dashboards, write effective prompts, and apply AI to real-world challenges through guided projects with step-by-step instructions.
• AI-assisted learning: Explore, learn, and code in Python or SQL with help from AI.
• Become a certified professional: Showcase your skills with certifications across Power BI, Tableau, SQL, and more. Whether you’re aiming to become a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or AI Engineer, DataCamp certification proves you're ready for the job. 
• Learn without limits: Master data and AI across mobile or desktop. Always in sync, wherever you go. Whether your goal is to learn to code in multiple programming languages like Python, SQL, or specialize in the latest AI technologies, DataCamp offers a robust learning experience anywhere, anytime.
Start learning data and AI in just 5 minutes a day.
• Discover top courses to kick-start your data and AI expertise: Introduction to Python, Introduction to SQL, Introduction to R, Understanding Data Science, and Understanding Artificial Intelligence. 
• Learn Python: Begin your journey with Python coding exercises and interactive lessons, from basic Python syntax to advanced data analysis and machine learning.
• Learn SQL: Master databases, SQL joins, and relational databases in our learning app. Develop data analyst skills for advanced analysis in PostgreSQL.
• Learn AI: Explore the fundamentals of artificial intelligence through hands-on courses in machine learning, generative models, prompt engineering, and more. Build real projects, use tools like ChatGPT more efficiently, and gain practical skills to apply AI in real-world scenarios.
• Unlock the power of programming and coding with AI: Courses like "Introduction to SQL with AI" and "Introduction to Python with AI" (coming soon) at DataCamp will guide you on how to code smarter and effectively collaborate with AI by writing prompts, generating queries, and analyzing data to solve real-world problems.
• R Programming: Learn statistics and data visualization with RStudio, exploring the tidyverse and real datasets essential for analytics roles.
• All opening course chapters are free: Access starter chapters on data engineering, machine learning, data visualization, database fundamentals, and cloud computing. Reinforce your data analysis skills with tools like Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, Python, and SQL, or build foundational knowledge in cloud computing with platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
Read Our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
Visit: https://www.datacamp.com/terms-of-use/ to learn about our policies.
Questions or Need Help?
Reach out at https://support.datacamp.com/.
Download DataCamp now to transform your career and stay ahead of the curve!

bluejetty:00015747:ios.description:
Invest with confidence—expert-built portfolios, guidance, and automation
Stash is the investing app that helps everyday Americans make their money work harder. Whether you're planning for retirement, building a safety net for the future, or investing for the first time, Stash combines expert-managed portfolios with powerful automation and personalized guidance to help you stay on track.
As a Registered Investment Advisor (RIA), we act in your best interest—like the financial pros wealthy people hire, but built for real working people. With Stash, you’ll invest smarter, not harder, using the same long-term strategies professionals trust.
Automated investing, managed by experts
Smart Portfolio takes the guesswork out of investing with expert advice. Stash builds and manages a diversified portfolio designed to build wealth over time. We automatically rebalance and optimize for your goals—so you can focus on living your life, not watching the markets.
Want to choose your own stocks and ETFs?
Build a portfolio that reflects your goals, values, and interests. With Stash, you get access to thousands of investments, plus tools and recommendations to help you invest with confidence—not complexity.
Set your investing on autopilot with Auto-Stash
Stash customers who invest on a schedule with Auto-Stash set aside 9x more than those who don’t.¹ Set it once, and add to your Stash in the background—no extra work needed.
Your personal Money Coach, always on
Finances can be overwhelming. Money Coach gives you fast, personalized advice tailored to your life—whether it’s understanding your next move or staying motivated toward your goals.
Turn spending into investing
Use the Stock-Back® Debit Card to earn stock with every eligible purchase—up to 3% back. It’s a simple way to build long-term wealth while buying what you need today.²
Invest in retirement
Plan ahead with a Traditional or Roth IRA. Designed for long-term growth, Stash helps you invest for a future with fewer financial worries—and potential tax advantages along the way.
Help the next generation start strong
Open a Custodial Account for a child in your life. You manage it today, they benefit tomorrow. It’s an investment in their future—and in your legacy.
Make your money work as hard as you do
With automated tools, expert support, and long-term investing guidance, Stash helps simplify the path to financial confidence.

bluejetty:00024116:ios.description:
Extract audio from QuickTime (.mov) and MP4 videos with this easy-to-use audio extractor app.
Select a QuickTime or MP4 video from the Photos app or Files app.
Set the start and end time for extraction, enter a custom audio file name, and choose your preferred output audio format.
Extract and save the audio clip in the format you selected.
You can also add custom artwork and artist metadata to your extracted audio files
when using formats like AIFC, AIFF, FLAC, M4A, MP3, MP4, or WAV.
Easily open or share your extracted audio files with other apps.
All extracted audio files are saved and accessible from the Files app:
On My iPhone/iPad → MovieToAudio → Audio
【Supported Audio Formats】
- AIFC
- AIFF
- CAF
- FLAC
- M4A (recommended)
- MP3
- MP4
- WAV

• Restart your device
• Move the video from the Photos app to the Files app, then open it from there
• If the issue persists, send the video file or a downloadable link to the support email so I can investigate and improve the app

Lots of tools and features:

bluejetty:00065015:ios.description:
With the ING App, your bank is always with you. A quick balance check, transfer to your savings or paying a bill: the app does it all. For personal and business accounts in the Netherlands.
Lots of tools and features:
• You can confirm orders with your mobile.
• Super simple transfers, withdrawal overview and scheduling of savings orders.
• Paid for your friends? Create a payment request and get your money back.
• If you want to, you can look ahead 35 days and see your future transactions.
• The app has its own daily limit, which you can set and change.
• It’s all there: you can pay, save, borrow, invest, get a credit card and even view your ING insurances.
• Want to fix something quickly? Like blocking your card or changing your address? Just do it in the app, it’s easy as pie.
 • Don’t have an ING account yet? Open one in the app. 
Are my details safe and secure in the app?
Yes, your banking is done via a secured connection. No personal details are stored on your phone or tablet. If you always use the latest version of the app, you enjoy optimal security and the latest features.
Activation only takes a moment
You don’t need much to activate the app. Just a Dutch current account at ING, access to My ING and a valid identity document. This can be a passport, an ID card from the EU, an ID card for foreign nationals, a Dutch residence permit or a driver’s license.
Please note: Dutch legislation is applicable to accounts and other products from ING

bluejetty:00073028:ios.description:
Telepromptr is your best solution for a simple, professional Teleprompter app.
No account needed... Just type, import or paste your text and start in seconds.
Over 11 years on the App Store, and featured on the App Store "Make a Film with iPad" promotion.
Now, re-imagined with a modern design and a suite of new features. 
Telepromptr is designed to be lightweight, reliable and versatile. Perfect for video production, presenting, speaking, meetings, music performances and more!
Key features
• Simple & intuitive design
• Portrait & Landscape support on all devices
• Record Video
• Mirroring (no upgrade required)
• Remote Control with a keyboard or any compatible controller
• Text: Adjust the colours, size, font and line spacing
• Easy Markdown formatting for bold/italic
• Import Word, PDF, plain text and Markdown documents
• Eyeline Mode aligns the text beside your camera for better eye contact
• Save and re-use Style Presets
• See your words per minute and time remaining
• Output to connected displays via AirPlay or HDMI
• Add a countdown timer before scrolling starts
The optional Pro upgrade is available as a one-time in-app purchase forever, or as a subscription. If you chose to subscribe (optional), you can cancel anytime within the app, or from your Apple ID settings.
Privacy policy: https://telepromptr.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00159262:ios.description:
Cal-AI: AI-Powered Calorie & Nutrition Tracker for Smarter Eating 
Track calories, scan meals, and monitor nutrients effortlessly! Cal-AI combines advanced AI meal recognition, a free barcode scanner, and smart nutrition tracking—simply snap a photo, describe your meal naturally, or scan a barcode to log your food instantly with our extensive database. Sleek, fast, and easy to use!
Features Breakdown:
· Effortless AI-Powered Food Tracking: Easily log your meals with a simple photo. Cal-AI’s AI-driven food scanner instantly analyzes your plate, providing calorie estimates and detailed nutritional breakdowns.
· Smart Nutrient Tracking: Monitor macronutrients like proteins, carbs, and fats with precision. Get AI-powered insights to help you stay balanced and reach your health goals.
· Seamless Barcode & Food Scanning: Scan barcodes or search our extensive database to track packaged foods and ingredients instantly. Fast, accurate, and effortless nutrition tracking at your fingertips.
IMPORTANT NOTICE
We do not offer medical advice. AI-generated data may not be 100% accurate. Please consult a professional for medical dietary needs.
HOW APP WORKS
Cal-AI App calculates your daily calorie goal based on your weight, height, and activity level, and adapts to it if your goal is to lose, maintain, or gain weight. Once you know your target, you just focus on eating within your calorie range, while the CaloAI sends gentle reminders to log your meals throughout the day. Best of all, there’s no need for any sign-ups or complicated registration!
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:
- You can choose from the following subscription options: $9.99 per month or $39.99 per year.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Free users can access limited food calorie recognition, calorie intake tracking, and healthy recipe.
- Subscribing unlocks more recognition attempts, and provides calorie burn estimates based on your food descriptions.
- You can manage or turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.privacypolicies.com/live/295ee4cb-cb6b-4767-92d5-400c2e56aeb0

Fight against other players in a free online 3D fighting game. Compete in 2 player PVP combats or brawl for fun with friends. Welcome to the ninja realm! FIGHT NOW!
Best Mobile Game of 2020 (DevGAMM Awards)
Shadow Fight games have been downloaded more than 500 million times
Cool 3D graphics
Top-level 3D graphics and realistic animations come together to provide you with the best-looking epic fighting action.
Easy controls
Control your hero like in best classical fighting games and get a console-level battle experience on your mobile device.
Fun multiplayer battles
- Make a team of 3 heroes and battle in online multiplayer mode. You score a victory in a fight, only if you can defeat all of the opponent's heroes in an epic battle. Or fight offline against advanced, machine-learning bots!
Epic heroes
- Build a team of the best warriors, samurai, and ninja. Collect and upgrade all the heroes — Each one has unique abilities that you can change and adjust to your style.
Hero talents
- Level up and unlock cool ninja talents. Choose the top talents that suit your playstyle, change them, and experiment to boost your battle winrate. Decide which style is the most fun! Fight the immortals!
Fight Pass
- A new season starts each month — get free chests and coins for winning! A subscription gets you access to the premium cosmetic items, and lets you collect free bonus cards without ads.
Brawl with friends
- Find out who the top Shadow Fight player is: challenge a friend to a PvP duel. Send an invitation or join a friend who's already playing — you can do some serious practice or just beat each other up!
Cosmetic items and customizations
- Cool hero skins — win with style
- Emotes and taunts — send them to your opponent during a fight to show your superiority or thank them for a good game
- Epic stances and ninja moves — celebrate your victory with cool 3D action animations
Become the top fighter
- Arena is easy to learn, but to become a true master in multiplayer mode, you'll need to watch tutorial videos, practice with friends, and be part of our active community. 
Online PvP tournaments
- Enter tournaments for rewards and cool new experiences. Top place will bring you fantastic prizes, but a few losses, and you're out. Enter another tournament to fight for the win again!
Communication
- Chat with other players on Discord, in our Facebook group, or on Reddit. Be the first to get all the latest news and learn the secrets of other players. Invite your friends and have fun!

— I've wanted to play a PvP or boxing games on mobile ever since Shadow Fight 2 came out. Arena made that dream come true.
— This is an action for everyone. If you're feeling up to it, you can brawl for rating, and when you need a break, you can play offline and just fight with shadows of immortals for fun.
— You would feel like an epic ninja straight from Naruto. And also it's free!

bluejetty:00187663:ios.name: Foodliner Mobile
bluejetty:00187663:ios.summary: Foodliner Mobile is Foodliner Inc’s mobile scanning solution to help drivers easily submit their documentation right from their smartphone or tablet. This app gives drivers the flexibility to submit paperwork wherever is most convenient for
bluejetty:00187663:ios.description:
Foodliner Mobile is Foodliner Inc’s mobile scanning solution to help drivers easily submit their documentation right from their smartphone or tablet. This app gives drivers the flexibility to submit paperwork wherever is most convenient for you! Not only does Foodliner Mobile help drivers improve productivity, but it also helps you get paid faster by getting paperwork submitted faster.
With Foodliner Mobile you'll get notified of assigned loads on your smartphone or tablet. We've included the ability to view destinations on the map and view truck stops along the way to better help drivers plan their day.
Drivers can easily submit documents to human resources and safety using Foodliner Mobile. Foodliner Mobile also allows accident and/or damage photos to be sent directly to the safety department for review. 
Drivers can review key scorecard information on Foodliner Mobile.
Drivers can also easily find the closest TRANSFLO Express truck stop location within Foodliner Mobile. This interactive map allows you to locate not only the closest location but help find locations anywhere on your route.
Drivers can also easily find the closest Foodliner approved fuel stop within Foodliner Mobile. This interactive map allows you to locate all approved fueling locations nearest you and along your route.
With all of this information and functionality made available at the tip of your fingers, drivers who use this app are ahead of the game! Foodliner Mobile from Foodliner Inc. Get wired for success.
Foodliner Mobile is powered by TRANSFLO Mobile+ from Pegasus TransTech.
##############
Registering with Foodliner Mobile is easy! Simply follow the on-screen registration process and make sure to enter in the Fleet ID for the carrier you drive for and a valid email address. You will receive a confirmation email with an activation link. Click on the link in the email to complete the registration process.
You are now ready to start using Foodliner Mobile!
##############
TIPS:
• For best auto-border detection, put document on a dark background that contrasts with the page. 
• Make sure you have good ambient light to get best results.
• You can toggle between the built-in camera and any other camera app you have on your phone by going to the Settings icon from the top right corner of the main menu screen. This way you can choose the camera that works best with your phone.
• Review the image carefully. After sending all the documents, you will also receive an email confirmation. Click on the link in the email and review the images another time.
• The images are transformed to drop background colors and shading as well as change document content to black. The high compression keeps your data plan to a minimum.
###############
Foodliner Mobile reports accident & claims submission location, document scan submission location and load pickup and delivery locations. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00040393:ios.summary:
Uzum Tezkor
Uzum ekotizimidan kafe va restoranlardan taomlarni yangi tezkor yetkazib berish servisi. Uyga va ofisga yetkazib berish bilan nonushta, tushlik va kechki ovqat uchun tayyor taomlar. KFC’dan mazali Shefburger, Broccoli’dan tushli
bluejetty:00040393:ios.description:
Uzum Tezkor
Uzum ekotizimidan kafe va restoranlardan taomlarni yangi tezkor yetkazib berish servisi. Uyga va ofisga yetkazib berish bilan nonushta, tushlik va kechki ovqat uchun tayyor taomlar. KFC’dan mazali Shefburger, Broccoli’dan tushlik yoki Сыроварня’dan sirniklar deysizmi? Yetkazib berishni buyurtma qiling – uyingiz eshigigacha tezkor yetkazib beramiz. Yangi foydalanuvchilarga birinchi 3 ta buyurtmani mutlaqo bepul yetkazamiz!
OZIQ-OVQATlLARNI TEZKOR YETKAZIB BERISH
Manzilingizni kiriting, buyurtma bering va taxminan 30 daqiqadan so'ng dasturxoningizda ' taomlar tayyor.
NARXLAR XUDDI JOYIDAGIDEK
Biz Uzum Tezkor'dagi narxlar joylardagi narxlarga mos kelishini kuzatib boramiz. Maxsus to'plamdan taom va mahsulotlarni buyurtma qiling — agar servisimizdagi narx yuqori bo'lsa, farqini promokod ko'rinishida qaytaramiz.
BITTA ILOVADA RESTORAN VA KAFELARNING KATTA TANLOVI
KFC, EVOS, Oqtepa Lavash, Max Way, Yaponomama, Bon!, Les Ailes va boshqa mashhur muassasalardan ovqat buyurtma qilishingiz yoki yangi ta’mni kashf qilishingiz mumkin. Palov, pitsa, sushi yoki burgerlar – o‘z didingizga qarab tanlang.
MAHSULOTLARNI UYGA YETKAZIB BERISH
Nafaqat taomlarni, balki do'konlardan mahsulotlarni ham tez yetkazib berish bilan buyurtma qiling. Supermarketdan mahsulotlar, gullar, hayvonlar uchun ozuqa, shirinliklar va yana ko'plab narsalarni ilovadan izlang. Mahsulot va tovarlarni buyurtma qiling, biz esa ularni eshigingizgacha tez yetkazib beramiz. 
O'ZBEKISTONNING KATTA SHAHARLARI BO'YLAB YETKAZAMIZ
Sevimli taomlar va mahsulotlarni yetkazib berish Toshkentning barcha tumanlari bo'ylab, shuningdek, Samarqand, Buxoro, Namangan, Farg'ona, Navoiy va Andijon shaharlarida mavjud. Restoranlar va hamkorlar qatoridan mamlakatimizning 1000 dan ziyod mashhur joylari o'rin egallangan.
QULAY VA OSON TO'LOV
To'lov avtomatik ravishda ilovaga bog'langan bank kartasidan yechib olinadi, birinchi buyurtma vaqtida uning rekvizitlarini kiriting. Shuningdek buyurtmani qabul qilayotganda naqd pul bilan to'lov qilishingiz ham mumkin.
BARCHA BOSQICHLARDA BUYURTMA HOLATINI KUZATISH
Ilovada onlayn buyurtma holatini kuzatish imkoniyati mavjud. Buyurtmangiz restoranga topshirilgani yoki kuryerdaligini bilib turasiz.
TEZ QAYTA ALOQA
Bizning qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmatimiz mutaxassislari o'zbek yoki rus tillarida tez javob berishadi va buyurtmani yetkazib berish bilan bog'liq har qanday muammolarni hal qilishda yordam berishadi.
Uzum tezkor – oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari va taom yetkazib berish xizmati. Ilovada restoran va kafelardan uyingizga taom yetkazib berishni buyurtma qilishingiz mumkin.
700 dan ortiq hamkorlar har qanday didga mos tayyor taomlarni, shuningdek, do‘konlardan mahsulotlarga buyurtma berish va yetkazib berishni taklif etadi.

bluejetty:00165341:ios.name: Metronome Beats Pro
bluejetty:00165341:ios.summary: An interactive Metronome App , Speed Trainer, and Drum Machine designed by musicians. Metronome Beats is already used worldwide by over 25 million musicians for solo and group music practice, teaching and live concerts. It is also used to k
bluejetty:00165341:ios.description:
An interactive Metronome App , Speed Trainer, and Drum Machine designed by musicians. Metronome Beats is already used worldwide by over 25 million musicians for solo and group music practice, teaching and live concerts. It is also used to keep a steady tempo during running, golf putting practice, dancing, and many other activities.
FEATURES
- Select any tempo from 1 to 900 beats per minute.
- Subdivide the beat with up to 16 clicks per beat – so you can practice the timing of your triplets.
- Don’t know how many beats per minute you need? Then use the tap tempo button to select a tempo.
- Master your rhythm with the Tempo Trainer
- Option to keep the metronome playing when you exit allowing you to use it with other apps
- Set a timer to stop the metronome after a certain number of bars
- Displays Italian tempo markings – handy if you’re not sure how fast Vivace should be.
- Choose whether to accent the first beat of the bar.
- Visual beat indication - mute the sound and use the visualisations to follow the beat.
- Change the pitch of the sound to make the metronome easier to hear over your instrument.
- Save your settings as Presets
- Create songs with different tempo settings
- Organise your favourite songs in to setlists and play through these in “Live” mode
- Advanced rhythms including Polyrhythms and Swing
- Integrated Drum Machine
ADJUST THE TEMPO WITH ONE TOUCH
Designed with ease of use in mind, Metronome Beats has controls for easily increasing and decreasing the tempo in small increments by one touch of the screen. The visual beat indicators help you to keep track of where you are in the bar and enable you to mute the metronome whilst still monitoring the tempo visually. You can also create your own custom sound settings or simply change the pitch to make Metronome Beats easier to hear over your instrument.
RHYTHM AND TEMPO TRAINING
Metronome Beats has a tempo trainer to help you master your rhythm. Set the metronome to speed up over time or mute every few bars to test your playing.
Only need a few bars lead in? Use the timer function to stop Metronome Beats when you want. You can also use Metronome Beats at the same time as other apps, allowing you to read sheet music off your Tablet whilst playing the metronome to check your tempo.
ADVANCED RHYTHMS AND INTEGRATED DRUM MACHINE
The advanced rhythms section allows you to program in more complex rhythms including polyrhythms and swing. There is also an integrated drum machine. Use this to generate a backing track to practice against, or simply have fun generating different rhythms.
SAVE YOUR SETTINGS AND CREATE SETLISTS AND SONGS
In the pro version of Metronome Beats you can save your Settings as Presets to access later. You can use these to create song of varying tempos or generate setlists of songs and play through these one by one – useful for solo and group practice as well as playing live on stage.
CONTACT US
If you need any help or have any questions about Metronome Beats you can always contact us at support@stonekick.com.

bluejetty:00095189:ios.description:
Your Personal AI Tanning Assistant
Tan AI helps you build a safe, personalized tanning routine using AI skin analysis, real-time UV tracking, and smart timers — so you can glow smarter, not harder.
How It Works
1. Snap a selfie — AI analyzes your skin tone and undertone
2. Set your goal (gradual glow or deeper bronze)
3. Follow a custom routine with flip reminders, SPF alerts, and UV warnings
4. Track your progress with photos and tone comparisons
5. Ask your AI assistant anything — available 24/7
Key Features
• AI Skin Tone Scanner — Personalized analysis from a single selfie
• Real-Time UV Index — Live readings, 16-day forecast, and exposure alerts
• Smart Tanning Timer — Session timers with flip and SPF reminders
• Progress Tracking — Photo comparisons to see your glow evolve
• AI Tanning Assistant — Chat anytime about routines, sun safety, or tips
• UV Notifications — Get notified when tanning conditions are perfect
• Product & Food Suggestions — Recommendations to support your tan naturally
• Privacy First — All data stays on your device
Frequently Asked Questions
What does Tan AI do?
Tan AI is a personal tanning assistant that uses AI to analyze your skin tone, create a custom tanning routine, track UV conditions, and help you tan safely.
How does the AI skin scanner work?
Take a selfie — our AI analyzes your base shade and undertone, then builds a tanning plan tailored to your skin type.
Does Tan AI track the UV index?
Yes. Real-time UV readings, a 16-day forecast, and alerts when conditions are ideal or when you should take a break.
Can Tan AI help prevent sunburn?
Tan AI includes SPF reminders, flip timers, and exposure alerts based on your skin type so you can enjoy the sun without overdoing it.
Is Tan AI free?
You can use Tan AI for free with ads. A subscription removes ads and unlocks the full experience including unlimited AI scanning, advanced UV tracking, and personalized routines.
Is my data private?
All your photos and personal data stay on your device. We don't store selfies on any server.
Can I use Tan AI at the beach or pool?
Absolutely! Tan AI is designed for outdoor use — beach, pool, park, or your backyard. The UV tracker works wherever you are.
Does Tan AI recommend sunscreen?
Yes — Tan AI suggests SPF levels based on your skin type and current UV conditions, plus reminds you when to reapply.
What makes Tan AI better than other tanning apps?
Tan AI combines AI skin analysis, real-time UV data, smart timers, product suggestions, and a 24/7 AI assistant — all in one app.
Does Tan AI help with vitamin D?
Tan AI helps you track sun exposure and understand how it relates to vitamin D, so you can get the benefits of sunlight safely.
Note: Tan AI does not provide medical advice. Always consult a dermatologist for skin health concerns.
Have questions? Reach us at heytanaiapp@gmail.com
Terms: https://usetanai.com/terms
Privacy: https://usetanai.com/privacy

Welcome to Disney Solitaire, the ultimate card game that transforms classic tripeaks solitaire into an exciting experience filled with magic!
Step into the enchanting realm of Disney Solitaire, where every postcard recreates an iconic scene from the worlds of Disney and Pixar!
From the moment you start playing, you’ll find yourself immersed in colorful scenes featuring some of your favorite characters like Aladdin, Elsa, Moana and Woody.
This isn’t just another solitaire game; it’s a vibrant experience packed with excitement, strategy, and whimsical charm.
Disney Solitaire redefines the solitaire experience with innovative gameplay features. Collect unique power-ups and special cards that can change your strategy.

With stunning visuals, engaging gameplay, and heartwarming moments, Disney Solitaire is your ticket to a magical escape. 
Don’t miss out - your adventure awaits!

Disney Solitaire does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items. You can disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. Disney Solitaire may also contain advertising.
You may require an internet connection to play Disney Solitaire and access its social features. You can also find more information about the functionality,
compatibility and interoperability of Disney Solitaire in the above description and additional app store information.

 Fish activities are related to many weather conditions. The influence of water temperature and atmospheric pressure is most ob
bluejetty:00024945:ios.description:
Fishing Index - Fishing Weather App is a app that helps fishermen to fishing scientifically and reasonably.
 Fish activities are related to many weather conditions. The influence of water temperature and atmospheric pressure is most obvious, but the influence of temperature on water temperature is lagging behind and slow, and the change of atmospheric pressure is more intuitive. The higher atmospheric pressure, the higher dissolved oxygen in water, the more active fish activities. Wind speed and direction are also an important factor. The breeze blowing Buddha water surface increases the dissolved oxygen of water. Cold blowing south wind and hot blowing north wind are very beneficial for fishing. Finally, rainfall and humidity also have a certain impact on fishing.
 According to some research, fish activities are most active in about one hour before and after the moontransit (upper or lower), and are also active within half an hour before and after the Moonrise or Moonset. In addition, within one month, fishes is most active at the full moon or the new moon , least active at the first quarter or the last quarter.
Weather : Hourly Weather Forecast for 10 days 
Solunar: Sunrise, Sunset, Moonrise, Moonset and Moon Phase
Weather Map: Temperature,Air pressure, wind
Marine Map: Wave,Current,Sea surface height,Water temperature,Salinity
Mine:
『Fishing Index Membership』
10 days 24 hours fishing weather forecast, 10 days 24 hours daily and monthly analysis and prediction, 10 days 24 hours fishing index analysis and calculation,All Weather map and marine map

bluejetty:00182912:ios.name: Classic German Whist
bluejetty:00182912:ios.summary:
Classic German Whist — play offline vs a computer opponent.
No internet required. No sign-up. Just a focused two-player trick-taking card game that rewards planning, timing and card sense.
German Whist, also known as Hamburg Whist, is based
bluejetty:00182912:ios.description:
Classic German Whist — play offline vs a computer opponent.
No internet required. No sign-up. Just a focused two-player trick-taking card game that rewards planning, timing and card sense.
German Whist, also known as Hamburg Whist, is based on classic Whist but designed for two players. Each round has a distinctive two-phase structure: first you build your hand by playing tricks and drawing from the deck, then you play out the final hands in a tense endgame.
Why you’ll enjoy Classic German Whist:
• Offline play — no account required
• A true two-player Whist experience
• Easy or Hard computer opponent
• Classic German Whist with a full 52-card deck
• Small Whist option using a quicker 28-card deck
• Choose Last 13 or Every Trick scoring
• Set the win target to 10, 25 or 50
• Track your stats over time
• Review previous tricks
• Replay hands from any round
• Claim winning tricks faster
• AutoPlay options for smoother play
• Customize card faces, themes and suit colors
How the game works:
German Whist is played in two phases. In the first phase, each trick decides who wins the face-up card from the deck. In the second phase, both players use their final hands to win as many tricks as possible.
Players must follow suit if they can. If they cannot follow suit, they may play any card, including a trump card.
Scoring depends on your chosen mode. In Last 13 scoring, only the endgame tricks count. In Every Trick scoring, the whole round matters.
Whether you know German Whist already or want a compact two-player card game to learn, Classic German Whist gives you a clean offline version you can play at your own pace.

bluejetty:00186229:ios.description:
* Listed in the top 3 of educational apps in the Dutch App Store!
‘Set the clock’ can help your child to learn to tell time and revives old times by reintroducing the wooden clock on the iPad, iPhone or iPod Touch!
You can practice together with your child, or let him/her perform assignments on his/her own using the nine game types in the App: "Set the clock’, ‘Tell the time’, ‘Adjust the clock’ and more. The assignments are clearly pronounced in English.
Besides English, it is also possible to have the assignments spoken in Dutch, German, French, Spanish and even Chinese. This makes that "Set the clock" can provide enough challenge even for older children. 
Each game type, has five levels of difficulty. When enough correct answers are given, you are rewarded with a bronze, silver or gold medal!
The app is fully usable even without the Multiple Profiles option.
Features:
- Beautifully designed wooden clock.
- Earn medals and shows that you are a real time telling champion!
- Multiple game modes (nine in total; analog and digital):
> Learn to set the clock to the correct time.
> Choose which clock displays the correct time.
> Learn to set the clock ahead or back.
- Tap the clock’s digits to hear what number it is.
- English spoken, so your child can practice independently.
- Different levels: hours, half hours, per quarter and per 5 minutes.
- Also suitable for older children / pupils, because of the ability to tell time in other languages.
In short: a great educational app for both young and old. Learn telling time is just as fun as ever!

bluejetty:00180238:ios.description:
HOME DESIGN 3D OUTDOOR & GARDEN - DESIGN YOUR DREAM GARDEN IN 3D
Bring all your outdoor design projects to life with the ultimate garden design app, and share your creations with a community of more than 90 million users worldwide.
Transform your outdoor design idea into stunning reality: design your garden, plan your ideal backyard, create a play area, organize your open-air wedding and more. Perfect for landscape planning, patio and terrace layouts, and rapid iterations across every outdoor space, from concept to completion.
PLAN & DESIGN YOUR OUTDOOR SPACE IN 3D
• Draw your garden plan in 2D, then instantly view it in immersive 3D
• Import your own blueprint and draw over it to recreate your land
• Create your garden using the exact dimensions of your fences
• Mark out the different areas on the ground and include your house
• Automatic surface calculation of your land and areas
• Build your multi-level garden with a simple, quick and powerful planner
• Intuitive interface for a highly ergonomic user experience
FURNISH & DECORATE EVERY OUTDOOR SPACE
• Over 100 items tailored to outdoor design: garden furniture, trees, flowers, swimming pools, greenhouses, fences and more
• Just drag and drop 2D or 3D items and edit dimensions to meet your needs
• Make it unique! Choose from thousands of different textures for your own personal project
• Test layouts with the landscape planner before starting your backyard makeover
• No more mistakes thanks to the Undo/Redo feature
VISUALIZE & WALK THROUGH
• See the result of your garden design instantly in 3D
• Visit your project in Augmented Reality (on compatible iOS devices)
• Real-time 3D exploration of your outdoor design and landscaping plans
SHARE YOUR GARDEN DESIGN
• Share your outdoor creations with the Home Design 3D community
• Get decorating tips and feedback on your garden design, then iterate

- Duration: weekly or yearly
- Free trial: on selected subscriptions only
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account once you confirm the purchase
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase
- Your subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The renewal cost is charged to your account within the 24 hours before the end of the current period
- When you cancel a subscription, it remains active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal is turned off, but the current subscription is not refunded
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription

bluejetty:00141841:android.description:
Backpack Fury - Wild Survivor is a game filled with crazy animal fusion, bizarre creatures, and strategic combat. In this wild world, you’ll face various quirky creatures and enemies, combining different monsters and gear to create the ultimate survival force and embark on a thrilling life-or-death battle!
Game Features:
1.Bizarre Animals, Strange Combinations: Turkey Dragon, Crocodile Shark, Capybara Cat, Cow Lion, Colorchange Sheep, Hippo Goat, Turtle Elephant, Platypus Sheep... you never know what crazy animal combination you'll create! The wild fusion brings endless possibilities.
2.Diverse Environments, Surprises Everywhere: Each wild scene has its own unique challenges and surprises, immersing you in a world filled with unexpected adventures!
3.Awakened Power, Wipe Out Enemies: Once you unlock your awakened abilities, enemies stand no chance. Unleash your full power and obliterate everything that stands in your way!
4.Strategic Fusion, Brainstorming Required: Every life-and-death battle tests your wisdom and strategy. Fuse wisely and pick the best combinations to defeat enemies and survive!
5.Weird Species Incoming, Prepare for Battle: Various strange species will attack continuously, and you’ll need to devise different strategies to counter their threats!
6.Magical Evolution, Quirky Creatures: Creatures evolve in magical ways, and after evolution, they’ll become even stronger, assisting you in battle as powerful allies!
Backpack Fury - Wild Survivor is not just a thrilling adventure but a battle of strategy and creativity. Brave survivors, are you ready to face the madness?

 - Competitive Ranked System: Progress through the ranks, from beginner to legendary, and showcase your strategic genius. Earn chests containing valuable cards and resources to upgrade your units and enhance your tactical advantages.
 - Handcrafted Offline Maps: Enjoy a unique solo experience with meticulously designed maps. Perfect your strategies and prepare for the challenges of PvP battles.

Constant Updates & New Content: We’re committed to adding new game modes, units, and features based on your feedback. Your journey to domination is just beginning! Download Domination Wars now and lead your tiny army to epic victory! Will you rise to the challenge and conquer the islands? Your army awaits your command, my Lord!

bluejetty:00017864:ios.description:
Enroll today in Fidelity’s Online Banking. Enjoy the features of online banking — right at your fingertips. Track your account, make deposits, and more.
BANK WITH CONFIDENCE 24/7
• Secure, simple, easy and fast banking at any time, day or night
• Build personalized budgets across all of your accounts, in and not in our bank
• Deposit checks from anywhere
• Pay bills and send money quickly through Bill Pay
• Earn rewards each time you swipe your debit card
• Get paid early – 2 days early with direct deposit
• Access more than 37,000 surcharge-free ATMs1
OUR FIDELITY BANK APP GIVES YOU:
• Fast, free, and secure service for customers enrolled in online banking2
• Easily keep track of your finances — even on the go:
o View account balances
o Review account and transaction history
o Transfer funds between your Fidelity accounts3
o Pay bills
o View and activate your cash back offers
• Available via any web-enabled cell phone or device
• Utilize this service three convenient ways:
o Web browsing
o App download (see links above)
o Text banking
• Save valuable time and effort; avoid an extra trip to a branch
MOBILE DEPOSIT - Deposit checks in just 1, 2, 3 using the Fidelity mobile app! 
• Deposit your check in just a few quick clicks:
o TAP – Open Fidelity's mobile banking app
o SNAP – Take a picture of the front and back of the check you're depositing
o DEPOSIT – Securely deposit your check!
• Deposit checks anytime, anywhere from your mobile phone
• Free service for customers with a Fidelity Bank checking account
• Save time, avoid unnecessary trips to a branch
• Mobile Deposit is subject to deposit limits and funds are typically available by next business day. Deposit limits may change at any time. Other restrictions apply. 
MY REWARDS
This rewards program lets you earn rewards by using your Fidelity Bank debit card to purchase merchandise and services. 
• Available to all debit Cardholders. 
• There is no limit to the rewards you can earn so the more you use your Fidelity Bank debit card, the more rewards you can earn!
When you join, you will be able to:
• Activate offers against the checking account you used when joining. 
• Shop at those merchants – whether online or instore or both – depending on the offer. 
• After making a qualifying purchase, the offer will automatically be applied, and you will receive cash back in your checking account 30-45 days after the offer is redeemed. 
• For Hotel offers, the 45 days starts from the time you have completed your stay, not 45 days from the time of booking.
FIND US – Locate your nearest Fidelity branch or ATM quickly and easily.
CONTACT US – Talk to our customer service representatives; they’re just a touch away. If you do not remember your Online ID or password, simply call 1-800-220-2497
HERE FOR GOOD
Our mission, vision and values define Fidelity Bank's foundation. Our core values are our promise to our clients. When we live the mission, “Here for Good”, and our values we enrich our strong heritage and ensure our longevity as a financially stable and operationally sound institution.

3) Transfers are subject to balances available in linked accounts.

bluejetty:00170298:ios.description:
Access a wide range of academic textbooks and books with Perlego — the digital library that helps students, researchers, and lifelong learners study on their own terms. Perlego gives you access to over 1 million academic titles across hundreds of subjects, all in one easy-to-use app. Whether you’re revising for exams, writing an essay, or carrying out research, Perlego helps you find, read, and use the resources you need.
Why students choose Perlego:
A large library of academic books
- Explore more than 1 million books and textbooks across 950+ topics, including Business, Psychology, History, Medicine, and Law. You’ll find essential course texts, non-fiction and fiction favourites, and key supplementary readings — all in one place.
Listen to books with text-to-speech
- Need to give your eyes a break? Use our built-in read-aloud feature to listen to books while you commute, exercise, or unwind. It’s a flexible way to keep learning when you don’t have time to sit and read.
Study tools designed to help you focus
- Highlight important passages, add notes directly on the page, and save bookmarks for quick reference. Whether you’re preparing for exams or researching an assignment, Perlego helps you stay organised and make meaningful progress.
Read offline, anywhere
- No WiFi? No worries. Download your books for offline reading, so you can study on the subway, in a café, or wherever you need to concentrate.
Sync across all your devices
- Start reading on your phone and pick up where you left off on your laptop or tablet. Your library stays with you, so you never lose momentum.
Discover a smarter way to learn
Join thousands of learners saving money, finding reliable academic content, and studying more efficiently. 
Download Perlego today to access the books you need — whenever and wherever you need them.
https://www.perlego.com/tac

Unlock Endless Audio Entertainment with PlaydioCast
Discover, download, and enjoy your RSS favorite podcasts, audiobooks, eBooks, and online radio shows in one convenient app. With PlaydioCast, you'll experience a personalized listening journey tailored to your preferences.
[Key Features]
- Advanced Podcast Player: Intuitive controls, customizable playback speeds, sleep timer, skip chapters, and seamless episode organization.
- Live Transcription & Translation: Real-time transcription and translation in 24+ languages, perfect for language learners and international content.
- Custom Playlists & Bookmarks: Create playlists, bookmark episodes, and share with friends and family.
- Offline Listening & Media Imports: Download podcasts and audiobooks for offline listening and import your own media files or sideload online videos.
- Online Radio & Shazam Support: Discover online radio stations and identify songs with Shazam integration.
- Cross-Platform Syncing: Seamless syncing across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Apple Watch, and Vision Pro devices.
- Enhanced Audio Features: Customize playback settings with silence trimming, volume boost, and leveling.
- Visual Chapters & Picture-in-Picture Mode: Navigate podcasts with visual chapters and enjoy video content in Picture-in-Picture mode.
- Automatically offloading downloaded podcast files assists in minimizing the device’s storage footprint.

bluejetty:00129256:ios.description:
Mahjong by Brainium has elevated the relaxing tile match game you know and love with a clean, modern design, smooth animations and calming sounds.
Unwind and reward yourself with this classic Mahjong game from the studio behind the most beautiful, trusted, and top-rated casual games in the App Store. We make learning Mahjong fun, so all you have to do is sit back, relax and challenge your mind.
With Mahjong by Brainium, you can explore a wide variety of puzzles perfect for every skill level. Our intuitive controls bring you the most user-friendly and visually appealing way to play your favorite game.
Relax and unwind as you solve puzzles and earn crowns to unlock new tilesets, game boards, and backgrounds. Personalize your tilesets and mix and match them to your liking. Create your own Mahjong sanctuary with just a few taps. Sharpen your mind and relax in a space that is completely your own.
Explore new boards, earn crowns, and unlock achievements by completing the Daily Puzzle. Unlock and play using the captivating Color Tileset for a truly unique Mahjong experience.
All of our Mahjong games are winnable. We designed a fast and fun undo system that makes retracing your path through the game a delight. Challenge yourself and find the solution with our helpful hints and undos by your side.
How to play Mahjong:
Match identical tiles. A tile is playable if it is open on the left or right and isn’t covered by another tile. A season tile can be paired with any other season tile. Similarly, a flower tile can be paired with any other flower tile. Continue paring tiles to clear the board and your mind!
Mahjong by Brainium Features:
RELAXING MAHJONG GAMES
• Enjoy classic, calming mahjong gameplay
• Make your way through 26 brain training board shapes
• Solve daily puzzle challenges to train your brain
• Level up as you play to unlock content
• All mahjong games are generated randomly – and all are winnable!
EASY TO LEARN. EASY TO PLAY
• Every puzzle is solvable
• Undo slider to retrace your steps when you reach a blocked path
• Hint button to help with challenging puzzles
• Use our timer option to test your skills and your speed
• Toggle the playable tiles option for more casual play
PERSONALIZATION
• 8 gorgeous tilesets, including traditional Mahjong styles
• Choose from 12 tranquil backgrounds to ease your mind
• Dark Mode compatible, perfect for unwinding before bed
• Play from your iPhone or iPad
More Fun & Free Classic Card and Logic Games from Brainium:
• Solitaire
• Sudoku
• Spider Solitaire
• FreeCell
• Pyramid
• Blackjack

bluejetty:00183409:ios.description:
Tous les jours c'est la même question qui revient: « on mange quoi ce soir »/ Avec l’appli Cuisine Actuelle la question ne se pose plus, trouvez la recette de cuisine qui vous plait. Que vous aimiez la cuisine gastronomique, la cuisine saine / vegan, ou bien la cuisine simple avec une recette facile et rapide à réaliser, notre application est faite pour vous.
Cuisine Actuelle, c’est des nouvelles idées recettes chaque jour, des conseils de préparation pour ne plus rater votre cuisson, des suggestions en fonction de ce qu’il y a dans votre frigo, ou encore des listes de courses pour cuisiner les plats qui vous donnent envie…
• RECETTES 
Retrouvez des milliers d'idées recette avec la possibilité de sauvegarder vos coups de cœur, d’ajouter les ingrédients nécessaires à leur réalisation à votre liste de courses, et bien sûr nos conseils pour un menu réussi !
• MON FRIGO
Dans cette rubrique, cochez les ingrédients présents dans votre frigo (viandes, légumes, poissons, fromages…) et on vous proposera un échantillon de recettes faites à partir de ces mêmes ingrédients. De quoi vous inspirer de délicieuses recettes digne d'un grand marmiton !
• FAVORIS
Ici, retrouvez toutes vos idées recettes sauvegardées pour les réaliser plus tard…ou tout simplement vous mettre l’eau à la bouche !
• LISTE DE COURSES
Une quiche vous a tapé dans l’œil mais il vous manque les œufs nécessaires à sa préparation ? Aucun souci, à partir de la recette, cochez les ingrédients qu’il vous manque et retrouvez-les dans votre liste de courses.
Un veritable livre de cuisine en ligne ? Bien plus que cela ! Maintenant que vous vous faites une idée de notre application, vous n’avez plus d’excuse pour ne pas cuisiner. Alors à vos marques… prêts… à vos marmites !
N’hésitez pas à nous contacter 
Nous améliorons l’application Cuisine Actuelle régulièrement afin de répondre à vos attentes et vous proposer un service toujours plus performant. Pour toute remarque ou suggestion d’amélioration, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter à l’adresse suivante : savmobile@prismamedia.com

bluejetty:00157892:ios.name: Track Attack! Lap timer & maps
bluejetty:00157892:ios.summary:
GPS lap timer, video recorder, and driving telemetry in one simple app. Record laps, analyze performance, and instantly share videos with data overlays, ghost laps, and lap battles with friends.
Unlike traditional lap timers, Track Attack
bluejetty:00157892:ios.description:
GPS lap timer, video recorder, and driving telemetry in one simple app. Record laps, analyze performance, and instantly share videos with data overlays, ghost laps, and lap battles with friends.
Unlike traditional lap timers, Track Attack makes video, telemetry, and sharing effortless in one polished app. No syncing, no external tools, no setup. Built for track days, racing, autocross, and canyon drives. Start recording in seconds: no accounts, no setup, just hit record and drive.
GPS lap timer and driving analysis
• Turn your phone into a high-precision GPS lap timer with real-time driving data
• Accurate GPS lap timer for track days, racing, autocross, and hill climbs
• Live delta tracking to see where you’re gaining or losing time
• Sector times with grid view and HUD display inspired by Formula-style racing
• CarPlay support with live lap times, delta, and critical driving data
• Create, name, and share custom tracks and circuits in seconds
• Heart rate and fatigue tracking to understand driver performance
NEW: Ghost laps and lap battles
• Compare laps side-by-side with dual video, telemetry overlays, and 2D/3D maps
• Ghost laps: race against your best lap like a video game
• Lap battles: compare sessions with friends and see who’s faster
• Share sessions via AirDrop, link, or message, then export videos for social
• Multi-driver and multi-car profiles
• Detailed stats organized by driver, car, track or road, and time period
Capture and relive every session
• Record dual camera video (front + rear) with picture-in-picture
• Import and sync external video (GoPro, DJI, Insta360, Meta smartglasses, and more)
• Export full sessions or highlights
• Social-ready portrait video for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts
• Add maps, ghost laps, or lap battles with dual video and overlays
• Customize overlays: select from lap time, delta time, sectors, speed, RPM, throttle, GPS, heart rate, and more
• Advanced camera stabilization and adjustable focus lock
• Videos save directly to Photos for instant sharing
Sensors, OBD, and external GPS
• OBD BLE support for RPM, throttle, wheel speed, boost pressure, temperatures, and more (not all vehicles support all values)
• Brake meter (requires OBD) to analyze threshold braking and trail braking
• Capture full sensor data from your device (accelerometer, gyroscope, and more)
• External Bluetooth GPS up to 25 Hz (RaceBox Mini, Mini S, Micro) for high-precision GPS and IMU tracking and analysis. Use code TRACKATTACK15 for 15% off RaceBox devices
• Improved sensor reliability and failure handling
• Access and export raw session data for deeper analysis, then share instantly via AirDrop, email, or message
Routes and navigation (road driving)
• Plan, create, and drive routes with unlimited waypoints
• Perfect for canyon drives, road trips, and scouting new driving routes.
• CarPlay support for navigation, recording, and live driving data
• Capture video and data as you drive
• Create routes by searching or tapping directly on the map
• Create, name, and share routes
• Clear waypoint info with icons, ETA, and live weather for better route planning and navigation
• Optimized for cars and motorcycles (portrait and landscape layout supported)
Apple Watch and Health
• Apple Watch app with heart rate and calorie tracking per lap, session, and track
• Health integration saves driving and racing workouts for deeper analysis
Trusted by enthusiasts
Trusted by the Porsche Club of America and thousands of performance driving enthusiasts worldwide.
The free edition includes up to 6 saved sessions and a 25-minute recording limit per session. 4K recording and external video import and sync require Track Attack Pro.
Track Attack Pro removes these limits and enables more frequent live weather updates.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00186020:ios.description:
3D Anatomy for the Artist!
Unlock the secrets of the human body and elevate your artistic skills with 3D Anatomy for the Artist — the ultimate reference tool for artists, illustrators, and art students who want to draw the human figure with confidence and accuracy.
Whether you're a beginner or a professional, this app gives you everything you need to understand how muscles, bones, and body structures work together, so you can bring your drawings to life with realism and depth.
Key features:
- 3D Models: Explore fully interactive skeletal and musculoskeletal 3D models. Rotate, zoom, and examine the human body from every angle to understand anatomy like never before.
- Anatomical Drawings: Browse a rich library of detailed anatomical drawings and artistic sketches of muscles, perfect for study and inspiration.
- Reference Pictures: Access high-quality anatomical picture references showing muscles, bones, and structures in stunning detail.
- Photo References: Study real human body photos of models in various poses, ideal for capturing proportions, muscle definition, and natural movement.

1. Choose your reference type: 3D models, drawings, pictures, or photos.
2. Explore and interact with the content to study anatomy from multiple perspectives.
3. Use the references as inspiration or direct visual guides while drawing.
4. Build a deeper understanding of the human body to improve your artistic accuracy.

bluejetty:00134053:ios.summary:
The Met Office app gives accurate forecasts 1 hour to 7 days ahead, with real-time warnings and interactive weather maps. 
Trusted by millions, the Met Office app helps you stay safe and plan with confidence. Whether it's a quick check bef
bluejetty:00134053:ios.description:
The Met Office app gives accurate forecasts 1 hour to 7 days ahead, with real-time warnings and interactive weather maps. 
Trusted by millions, the Met Office app helps you stay safe and plan with confidence. Whether it's a quick check before heading out or detailed forecasts for the week ahead, we provide the most accurate weather information for the UK.
Why choose the Met Office app?
Our forecasts are designed to keep you informed and prepared, from short-term updates to long-range outlooks. 
Key features 
* accurate forecasts from 1 hour to 7 days ahead for your chosen locations 
* UK National Severe Weather Warnings to help you stay safe during extreme conditions 
* instant notifications for UK National Severe Weather Warnings 
* interactive weather maps, including rainfall, last 6 hours of rain, and severe weather 
* video forecasts for the latest updates from our experts 
Accurate forecasts including: 
* probability of rain or snow 
* actual and 'feels like' temperature 
* wind speed, direction, and gusts
* sunrise and sunset times 
* air pollution
* regional pollen forecasts and notifications between March and September 
* UV Index, visibility, and humidity 
Ad free version 
There is an in-app purchase to remove adverts for £7.99 a year. 
Feedback
The Met Office is committed to delivering new features based on your feedback and the reviews we receive. If you love our app, rate and review it in the App Store. If you have any suggestions please email enquiries@metoffice.gov.uk 
Data compliance
The Met Office app uses your location information to give you the most accurate and localised weather forecast possible. To turn off location settings at any time, select 'Settings' on your device, then the Met Office App, then disable location. To get a local forecast you will need to search for locations within the app. For more information on how we use any personal information collected about you, please see our Privacy policy (https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/policies/app-privacy-policy) and Cookie policy (https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/about-us/help/cookies) 
About the Met Office 
The Met Office is the UK's national weather service. Recognised as a world leader in providing weather and climate services, and as one of the world's most accurate forecasters. We are also responsible for the UK National Severe Weather Warning Service, mandated by UK Government, which aims to give advance warning of extreme weather to the public. See www.metoffice.gov.uk for more information. 
Accessibility statement
We want as many people as possible to be able to use this mobile application. You can view our accessibility statement at https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/policies/app-accessibility
Consent to installation of the app
Under data protection laws we are required to provide you with certain information about who we are, how we process your personal information and for what purposes and your rights in relation to your personal information. This information is provided in the Met Office Privacy Policy. It is important that you read that information before installation of this App. 
How to withdraw consent
Once you provide consent by downloading the app and selecting ‘I Accept’, you may change your mind and withdraw consent at any time by uninstalling the App. That will not affect the lawfulness of any processing carried out before you withdraw your consent.
