bluejetty:00186789:ios.description:
Over 95,000 translations • Conjugates thousands of Italian and English verbs • Hundreds of usage notes and examples • No internet connection required
Carry a dependable Italian and English reference everywhere you go with the Collins Pro Italian-English Translation Dictionary. This app contains dictionary data from HarperCollins in our popular Ultralingua interface. Use our verb conjugation tool to find complete conjugations of thousands of verbs in all standard forms, and the number translator to convert numerals into Italian or English text instantly.
DICTIONARY:
• Over 70,000 entries with 95,000 translations
• Tap-and-hold any word or phrase and choose "Speak" from the popup menu to hear that word spoken using Apple's built-in text-to-speech feature.
• Noun genders
• Slang, technical language, and regional differences in spelling and usage
• Hundreds of usage notes about troublesome constructions
• Smart search results in case you misspell or mistype
• Search-as-you-go displays words and narrows your selection as you type
VERBS:
• Conjugations for thousands of Italian and English verbs
• Includes all standard tenses and forms
• Smart search finds infinitives and catches misspellings
• Must-have reference tool for any student or language professional
• On iPhone/iPod touch, conjugate a verb from the dictionary results by tapping it
MORE:
• Translate numerals into Italian and English text with the number tool
• Language swapper button to switch from Italian-English to English-Italian
• Tap the history button to view the 50 most recent dictionary definitions, verb conjugations, and more in one place. Sort the list alphabetically or by date, and choose to clear the list completely or delete one entry at a time.
• No internet connection required
• Change your device settings to view the app display in English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, or German
REVIEWS:
"The most useful language app for the iPhone - I've been using a number of iPhone apps to help me learn Italian. The dictionary is quite large. The at-a-glance conjugation tables are fantastic. And when I was learning numbers, the quick number pad was a brilliant help." -User review
"Buy it, it's the best - You get what you pay for in the AppStore. I tried all the other Italian translations tools as I'm learning Italian and living in an Italian speaking country. Prior to getting this tool I was frustrated to tears by the poor quality of the other tools." -User review
"This is an outstanding app, it has a deep database and you will leave your dictionary, phrase book and verb conjugation book at home when going to class or traveling (no need for an Internet connection either). Accurate translations, many idiomatic expressions given along with definitions."
This universal app will run on iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch, so you can purchase it once and load it onto all your devices. The iPad and iPhone/iPod touch versions look and behave differently to give you a great experience on every device you own. The interface will change, but you’ll always have the same outstanding language data and tools inside.
Dictionaries are available from Ultralingua for many languages, including combinations of English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, and more. See what else we have to offer by searching for Ultralingua in the App Store.

bluejetty:00091773:ios.summary:

MAKE AND RECEIVE ANY CALL
Rylo works like your native
bluejetty:00091773:ios.description:
Phone calls made accessible.
Rylo provides real-time, AI-powered call captions on every phone call for anyone who is deaf or has hearing loss. Captioned calls are private and accurate.
MAKE AND RECEIVE ANY CALL
Rylo works like your native phone app, but with speech-to-text call captions. If you prefer to type your responses, you can choose a voice and use our text-to-speech feature. No interpreters. No relay services. No strangers listening in.
LIVE CAPTIONS FOR REAL LIFE
Our built-in feature, Rylo Live Transcribe, captions in-person conversations instantly: family dinners, doctor's appointments, airports, or anywhere else you don't want to miss a word.
YOUR PRIVACY IS PROTECTED
Captions are generated with end-to-end encryption. No human involvement. No one reading your calls but you.
BUILT FOR THE DEAF COMMUNITY, BY THE DEAF COMMUNITY
Rylo was built with direct input from the Deaf and hard of hearing communities. Every feature exists because someone in the community needed it. Accessibility matters.
KEY FEATURES
■ Live caption calls with transcripts
■ Live captioning for in-person moments (Rylo Live Transcribe) 
■ Personal dictionary for custom words and phrases
■ Quick keyboard responses as needed
■ Visual voicemail
■ Save transcripts privately on your device
■ Multilingual captioning: English, Spanish, French, Japanese, Hebrew, Italian
■ Built-in spam filter and call blocking
■ Profanity blocker
■ FCC certified 
"Rylo is the true definition of a game-changer. Their goal is to ensure effective and smooth communication." — Verified user
"I was able to make a phone call myself. I set up my own appointment. I could clearly read every word the recipient was saying to me. I explained to her I was deaf and I was using closed captioning. It was amazing. Thank you Rylo for allowing me to be more independent." — Verified user
Download Rylo. Make calls with confidence.
For more: https://rylo.com/
Support: https://help.rylo.com/en/
FEDERAL LAW PROHIBITS ANYONE BUT REGISTERED USERS WITH HEARING LOSS FROM USING INTERNET PROTOCOL (IP) CAPTIONED TELEPHONES WITH THE CAPTIONS TURNED ON. There is a cost for each minute of captions generated, paid from a federally administered fund.
There are also eligibility requirements and a cost, paid by a federally administered fund for each minute of IP Relay service.
Emergency calling through Rylo works similar to, but not the same as, calling 911 directly through a landline. It is important to keep your Rylo Registered Location updated.

bluejetty:00069952:ios.description:
This app works with any storage device (SSD, SD card, etc) which can be connected to iPhone/iPad and is compatible with iOS 13 and above. To test compatibility, plug in your device (using an adapter) and make sure that its contents will show up in the Files app.
*** Exclusive: This app works with these versions of iXpand USB drives without requiring any adapter (in addition to other storage devices) ***
https://www.sandisk.com/home/mobile-device-storage/ixpand-go
https://www.sandisk.com/home/mobile-device-storage/ixpand-mini 
https://www.sandisk.com/ixpand
*** Exclusive: the app allows you to export all four videos (left, right, center, rear) in a single video file.
*** Exclusive: the app shows the location of the sentry event 
*** The app includes an AI-based algorithm which scans the Sentry Clips folder and marks events that are triggered by human movement in the scene (requires a one-time in-app purchase)
This app allows you to view Sentry videos and DashCam videos generated by your Tesla on your iOS device without needing a computer.
- Fully supports v10 features (SentryClips folder and rear camera footage)
- The left, right, center and rear videos are automatically shown next to each other.
- All clips are organized by date and time.
- You can see thumbnail of clips as you browse through videos.
- The app allows you to delete left, right, center, rear videos associated with a time that you choose
- You can also delete all the videos in the Saved/Recent folder in one shot and empty up space on the drive.
Your Tesla must be able to record Sentry/DashCam videos.
You can also obtain pre-formatted USB devices that work with this app here: https://puretesla.com/product/teslacam-for-ios-bundle/

bluejetty:00042644:ios.description:
Given today’s challenge of keeping one’s privacy private, Wispr is the present and future of secured communication. Each high-fidelity message, audio/video call or file transfer is fully private with no one, not even us, being able to interfere. 
FULLY PROTECTED : State-of-the-art technology ensures secured messages and file transfers to and from anyone at any time. You don’t have to worry about needing special features as having all things private and secured is normality for Wispr. 
BY NEW ENCRYPTION TECHNOLOGY: Having each and every element on the app (messages, audio and video calls, file transfers) encrypted is brought to you by VOBP (Voice Over Blockchain Protocol), which makes your communication bullet proof. 
FOR FREE : Privacy should not be perceived as a preference, but as a given and so Wispr should not be a choice, but a normality. 
WITH NO FURTHER EFFORT : Wispr is available for everyone through the simple use of their phone number and address book or through using Matrix ID that is one can directly access owners of Impulse K1, a phone taking encryption to a whole new level. However, Wispr’s future has much to hold in terms of taking privacy to a whole new level.
YET BEST QUALITY : Slow networks are not a show stopper for Wispr, which is optimized to perform equally successful in all kinds of environments all over the world. Top that with a user friendly, very intuitive design and low latency and you get your choice of privacy providing app.

S.MPLE is the centralized powerhouse built exclusively for SERHANT agents, powered by Dot — your AI Chief of Staff. Dot isn't trained on the internet; it's trained on SERHANT. Connected to your email, calendar, and CRM, Dot knows what's on your plate, plans your next move, and flags what deserves your attention. Behind Dot sits an orchestration layer of specialized agents, so every request gets routed to exactly the expertise it needs. Speak your requests into reality, watch your Pipeline and Metrics move in real time, and get deliverables back in minutes. 
Key Features: 
 • Dot, Your AI Chief of Staff: Voice or text requests, understood by AI trained on your business, not everyone else's. 
 • Connected Everywhere: Synced with your email, calendar, and CRM so Dot can plan ahead and surface what's worth your attention. 
 • Live Pipeline & Metrics: Real-time visibility into deals and performance, pulled from your actual feed, never a stale snapshot. 
 • Orchestrated Expertise: A full layer of specialized agents for copywriting, brokerage knowledge, Sell It courses, and more. 
 • MLS Integration: Search listings and attach them to requests without breaking your flow. 
 • Effortless Collaboration: Add team members or co-listing agents to requests for full visibility and smooth execution. 
 • Deliverables in Minutes: Receive finished materials directly through the app, instantly. 
S.MPLE puts time back in your hands by automating tasks, streamlining workflows, and learning your business with every use. Instead of juggling tools, hiring assistants, or coordinating outside help, S.MPLE frees you to manage everything from contacts to transactions directly from your phone, spend less time on busywork, and focus on what truly matters: your clients.

apple-macos:6784363523.description:
Your money, clearly.
Moneys brings every account, every currency, your investments and your crypto together on iPhone, iPad and Mac. No bank connection, no account to create, no ads. Your ledger lives on your device and, if you like, in your own iCloud: it never passes through our servers.
Log expenses, income and transfers in seconds, let recurring transactions record themselves and watch your net worth take shape, at today's value.
Features
• Every account at its true value
Checking and savings accounts, cards, cash, loans and mortgages, each in its own currency and converted at the day's rates, with each currency's own precision: up to eight decimals for crypto. For every account, see what it's worth today and how much you've put in.
• Investments and crypto
Holdings with quantity and average cost; coins on exchanges and in wallets, with buys, sells, staking and airdrops, prices updated during the day and coin logos. Their value counts toward your net worth, while your ledger stays exactly what you paid in, to the cent.
• A ledger for real life
Transactions split across categories, recurring transactions you can pause, tags, notes, value dates and attachments: photos, scans and PDFs. Filter by amount, tag and merchant, search everything, browse the spending calendar and review possible duplicates.
• The whole picture
The Summary shows your net worth, assets and liabilities, the period's cash flow, your spending pace and the categories that weigh the most. At the end of the year, Your Year in Moneys tells the story of your twelve months.
• Budgets and goals
Monthly budgets by category or overall, with live progress, and savings goals that can follow an account's balance on their own.
• Reminders
A heads-up for upcoming recurring transactions and for the day before a card is charged.
• Widgets, Siri and Spotlight
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: balance, net worth, portfolio, budgets, upcoming transactions and a new transaction in one tap. Ask Siri to add an expense, make a transfer or tell you what you've spent; find transactions and accounts with Spotlight.
• iPad and Mac
Lists beside their details, Split View and Stage Manager, keyboard and trackpad with shortcuts. On the Mac, Moneys is a native app with every section in the sidebar.
• iCloud and backups
Automatic sync across your devices through your own iCloud, automatic backups to iCloud Drive, export to JSON or CSV, and a restore that always saves a safety copy first.
• Private by design
Face ID or Touch ID lock, no account, no tracking, no ads. Crypto prices arrive the same for everyone: no one learns which coins you hold.
• Beautiful and accessible
A new black-and-gold look, in light and dark, in 11 languages, with Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and subtle animations.
Moneys Plus
Unlimited accounts, currencies and categories, account folders, advanced insights and a month-end forecast, budgets and goals, annualized returns and investment charts, each coin's history and gain, CSV import from your bank, PDF reports, interactive widgets, and icons in silver, rose gold, bronze and graphite. Monthly, yearly with a one-week free trial, or lifetime with a single purchase. Everything you've recorded stays yours, always.
Perfect for
• Anyone who wants to know where the money goes
• Households with more than one account or currency
• Stock and crypto investors
• Freelancers and travelers
• People who value privacy
From the first expense to a full picture of your wealth, Moneys keeps the numbers honest and the experience quiet.

fdroid:com.vitorhugo.sonicrelay.sonic_re.name: SonicRelay: PC Audio
fdroid:com.vitorhugo.sonicrelay.sonic_re.summary: Listen to your PC audio on your phone with low latency and easy setup.
fdroid:com.vitorhugo.sonicrelay.sonic_re.description:
Bring your PC audio to your phone.
SonicRelay lets you listen on your Android device to the audio playing on your Windows PC, with low latency and without complicated setup.
Want to follow a video away from your computer, listen to music, games, calls, or simply use your phone as a convenient way to receive your PC audio? SonicRelay connects your devices and streams audio in real time.
🎧 PC audio directly on your phone
SonicRelay captures the audio playing on Windows and sends it to your Android device using technologies designed for real-time communication.
⚡ Low-latency audio streaming
SonicRelay uses WebRTC and the Opus audio codec, establishing a direct connection between devices whenever possible to reduce delay during playback.
🔗 Simple connection
Create a session on your computer, connect your phone, and start listening. SonicRelay handles communication between your devices without requiring complicated network configuration.
📱 Main features
• Stream audio from Windows to Android
• Real-time, low-latency audio
• WebRTC with Opus audio codec
• Direct device-to-device connection when available
• Automatic relay when required by the network
• Secure sessions between devices
• Temporary connection codes
• Support for multiple devices
• Connection and session status
• Automatic reconnection after network interruptions
🖥️ Windows app required
To stream audio, you also need to install SonicRelay for Windows on the computer that will transmit the sound.
The Windows application works as the audio sender, while SonicRelay on Android receives and plays the stream.
Who is SonicRelay for?
SonicRelay is a simple solution for anyone looking to:
• listen to PC audio on a phone
• stream Windows audio to Android
• listen to music, videos, games, or calls away from the computer
• stream audio between devices with low latency
• avoid heavy streaming solutions for a simple task
Your PC plays it. Your phone hears it. SonicRelay connects them.
